7368d72fd220.zh: 這一章在講什麼：影像不該先被壓成一條長向量
7368d72fd220.en: What this chapter is about: an image should not first be squashed into one long vector

9b9b8d6529f9.zh: 影像是高維、又很有空間結構的資料：隔壁像素通常長得很像、彼此相關。如果你硬把一張圖丟進全連接網路（MLP），第一步往往是把 $H\times W$ 的影像拉平（flatten）成一條超長向量。這一拉，二維鄰居關係就沒了——網路把左上角和右下角的像素當成「同等距離、同等相關」，當然很難學會邊緣、紋理、物件部件這類局部特徵。
9b9b8d6529f9.en: Images are data that are high-dimensional and strongly spatially structured: neighboring pixels usually look alike and are correlated with each other. If you force an image into a fully connected network (MLP), the first step is usually to flatten the $H\times W$ image into one very long vector. That flattening throws away the 2D neighbor relationships—the network treats the top-left and bottom-right pixels as "equally far apart and equally related," so of course it struggles to learn local features such as edges, textures and object parts.

6eeecfede073.zh: 卷積神經網路（CNN）就是為了解這個痛而設計的：它直接在原本的二維格子上運算，用小小的濾波器在影像上滑來滑去，把局部圖案抓出來。更形式地說，CNN 可以看成全連接網路的特例，只是動了兩個結構開關：
6eeecfede073.en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) were designed to fix exactly this pain: they operate directly on the original 2D grid, sliding small filters across the image to pick out local patterns. More formally, a CNN can be seen as a special case of a fully connected network in which just two structural switches are flipped:

45778ffbceb9.zh: 稀疏連接（sparsity）：每個輸出單元只看輸入的一小塊鄰居，不是整張圖。
45778ffbceb9.en: Sparse connectivity (sparsity): each output unit looks only at a small neighborhood of the input, not the whole image.

514e19d7d4ae.zh: 權重共享（weight sharing）：每一小塊都用同一組權重去掃——左邊的邊緣偵測器和右邊用同一套。
514e19d7d4ae.en: Weight sharing: every small patch is scanned with the same set of weights—the edge detector on the left is the same one used on the right.

312e77ae69de.zh: 這樣做有三個立刻看得見的好處。參數量大幅下降；模型自帶先驗「邊緣、角落這類局部圖案到處都可能出現」；還會帶來平移等變性（translation equivariance）——輸入平移一點，輸出特徵圖也跟著平移一點（注意：這是「跟著走」，不是後面池化才講的「平移不變」）。
312e77ae69de.en: This brings three immediately visible benefits. The number of parameters drops sharply; the model carries a built-in prior that "local patterns such as edges and corners can appear anywhere"; and it brings translation equivariance—shift the input a little and the output feature map shifts by the same amount (note: this means "it moves along," not the "translation invariance" that pooling brings later).

5a09370b9ae8.zh: 從 neocognitron 到 LeNet：CNN 怎麼變成手寫數字的標準答案
5a09370b9ae8.en: From the neocognitron to LeNet: how CNNs became the standard answer for handwritten digits

0b83c21a0141.zh: CNN 的故事不是 2012 才開始。1980 年福島邦彥（Kunihiko Fukushima）提出 neocognitron，已經有「分層、局部感受野」的味道。大約 1989 年，Yann LeCun 帶領的團隊把這套想法改造成手寫數字辨識網路；1998 年 LeCun、Yoshua Bengio 等人再改進，模型以 LeCun 為名，叫做 LeNet。同一篇論文還交出機器學習界超有名的基準資料集：MNIST（Modified NIST）——28×28 的手寫數字 0–9。
0b83c21a0141.en: The CNN story did not start in 2012. In 1980 Kunihiko Fukushima proposed the neocognitron, which already had the flavor of "layered, local receptive fields." Around 1989, a team led by Yann LeCun adapted this idea into a handwritten digit recognition network; in 1998 LeCun, Yoshua Bengio and others improved it further, and the model was named after LeCun: LeNet. The same paper also delivered a benchmark dataset that became famous throughout machine learning: MNIST (Modified NIST)—28×28 handwritten digits 0–9.

f69315e5e39f.zh: 課本 Fig. 1 那條管線（這裡不貼圖，用尺寸把它講清楚）
f69315e5e39f.en: The pipeline in the textbook's Fig. 1 (no figure here; we explain it through the sizes)

c4542dadc3c7.zh: 課本 Fig. 1 畫的就是 LeNet。你可以把它背成一條「先抽特徵、再分類」的流水線：
c4542dadc3c7.en: The textbook's Fig. 1 shows LeNet. You can memorize it as an "extract features first, then classify" pipeline:

b8f1a16fff5d.zh: 卷積：輸入影像經過卷積，得到 $28\times 28$、6 個通道的特徵圖。
b8f1a16fff5d.en: Convolution: the input image is convolved, giving feature maps of $28\times 28$ with 6 channels.

5f655b2731d3.zh: 池化／下採樣：空間尺寸砍半成 $14\times 14$，通道數仍是 6。
5f655b2731d3.en: Pooling/downsampling: the spatial size is halved to $14\times 14$; there are still 6 channels.

a17202a9aa0e.zh: 拉平＋全連接：特徵圖 reshape 成向量，依序通過 120 → 84 → 10 顆神經元的全連接層。最後 10 維對應數字類別 0 到 9。
a17202a9aa0e.en: Flatten + fully connected: the feature maps are reshaped into a vector and passed in turn through fully connected layers of 120 → 84 → 10 neurons. The final 10 dimensions correspond to the digit classes 0 to 9.

669afab781df.zh: 口語版路線：$28\times 28\times 6$ → 池化 $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → FC 120-84-10。
669afab781df.en: The route in plain words: $28\times 28\times 6$ → pool $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → FC 120-84-10.

686bbcde8353.zh: 為什麼後世還在抄這張骨架
686bbcde8353.en: Why later generations still copy this skeleton

b59355b29488.zh: 「前面卷積＋池化抽空間特徵，後面全連接做分類」——這不是過時的考古，而是現代 CNN 的原型。後面你會看到 AlexNet、VGG 把這條管線加寬加深，但先局部掃描、再抽象決策的邏輯，幾乎都從 LeNet 這張圖長出來。
b59355b29488.en: "Convolution + pooling up front to extract spatial features, fully connected at the back to classify"—this is not outdated archaeology but the prototype of the modern CNN. Later you'll see AlexNet and VGG make this pipeline wider and deeper, but the logic of scan locally first, then make an abstract decision almost all grows out of this LeNet diagram.

dd488f78ca30.zh: 口語復盤：福島 1980 種下種子，LeCun 1989／1998 做成 LeNet 並帶出 MNIST；尺寸口訣 28×28×6 → 14×14 → 10×10×16 → 5×5 → 120-84-10。 下一張開始拆「卷積層裡面到底做了哪三件事」。
dd488f78ca30.en: Plain-language recap: Fukushima planted the seed in 1980; LeCun built LeNet in 1989/1998 and brought out MNIST along with it; the size mnemonic is 28×28×6 → 14×14 → 10×10×16 → 5×5 → 120-84-10. The next card starts taking apart "which three things a convolutional layer actually does."

2e102eb07921.zh: 回想傳統影像處理：不同任務用不同核——邊緣、角落、平滑、銳化。例如 Prewitt 濾波器的兩個 $3\times 3$ 核，分別抓水平邊緣與垂直邊緣（式 (1)）：
2e102eb07921.en: Recall traditional image processing: different tasks use different kernels — edges, corners, smoothing, sharpening. For example, the two $3\times 3$ kernels of the Prewitt filter detect horizontal edges and vertical edges respectively (Eq. (1)):

612b43223c9a.zh: 左邊那個核上下對比（上正下負），對水平向的邊緣敏感；右邊那個核左右對比，對垂直向的邊緣敏感。它們做的事情很明確：抽出跟邊緣有關的特徵。
612b43223c9a.en: The left kernel contrasts top against bottom (positive on top, negative on the bottom), so it is sensitive to horizontal edges; the right kernel contrasts left against right, so it is sensitive to vertical edges. What they do is very clear-cut: extract features related to edges.

b830c81f4f49.zh: 關鍵轉折：核不要人刻，交給反向傳播學
b830c81f4f49.en: The key turn: don't hand-craft the kernel, let backpropagation learn it

a717b19b6cd6.zh: 問題是：分類或迴歸、不同資料集，最好的核不會長一樣。與其工程師手調這 9 個數字，卷積層乾脆把它們當成可學習權重。怎麼學？就是 Chap. 03 的反向傳播（backpropagation）：損失對核權重的梯度一層層傳回來，用梯度下降把濾波器調成「對這個任務、這份資料最有用」的樣子。
a717b19b6cd6.en: The problem: for classification or regression, and for different datasets, the best kernels will not look the same. Rather than having engineers hand-tune these 9 numbers, the convolutional layer simply treats them as learnable weights. How are they learned? With the backpropagation of Chap. 03: the gradient of the loss with respect to the kernel weights is passed back layer by layer, and gradient descent tunes the filter into whatever is "most useful for this task and this data".

241e9f51ef52.zh: 口語小結：一層 CNN ≈ 卷積＋激活＋池化；Prewitt 只是手刻邊緣核的例子；現代做法是把核當權重，用 Ch03 的 backprop 學出來。 下一張進入離散卷積的定義，以及實務上常常「不翻核」的互相關。
241e9f51ef52.en: In plain words: one CNN layer ≈ convolution + activation + pooling; Prewitt is just an example of a hand-crafted edge kernel; the modern approach treats the kernel as weights and learns them with the backprop of Ch03. The next card moves on to the definition of discrete convolution, and to cross-correlation, which in practice often "does not flip the kernel".

54e0bf8d7235.zh: 離散卷積的定義長這樣（式 (2)）。輸出在位置 $t$ 的值，等於把訊號 $x$ 跟核 $w$ 對齊後逐點相乘再加總——注意課本把核寫成 $w$，求和指標 $a$ 只是「掃過所有位置」，跟輸出名稱 $a[t]$ 撞名，別被嚇到：
54e0bf8d7235.en: The definition of discrete convolution looks like this (Eq. (2)). The output value at position $t$ equals the signal $x$ and the kernel $w$ aligned, multiplied point by point, and summed — note that the textbook writes the kernel as $w$, and the summation index $a$ just "sweeps over all positions"; it clashes with the output's name $a[t]$, so don't let that scare you:

450f9be5e147.zh: $w[t-a]$ 裡的 $t-a$ 就是在做翻轉再平移：核先對時間軸翻過來，再滑到位置 $t$。
450f9be5e147.en: The $t-a$ in $w[t-a]$ is exactly a flip followed by a shift: the kernel is first flipped along the time axis, then slid to position $t$.

edc51d1d5ebb.zh: 二維影像：兩個方向都卷一次

08b56f07f7d7.zh: 影像 $I$ 搭配二維核 $K$，卷積就在高、寬兩個空間軸上進行（式 (3)）：
08b56f07f7d7.en: For an image $I$ with a 2D kernel $K$, convolution runs along both spatial axes, height and width (Eq. (3)):

ca3abe491b16.zh: 求和範圍理論上是 $(-\infty,\infty)$，實務上只加核蓋得到的那些格子；核外面可以想像成 0。核很小（例如 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$）時，這就是在每個 $(i,j)$ 做一次局部乘加。
ca3abe491b16.en: In theory the summation range is $(-\infty,\infty)$; in practice only the cells covered by the kernel are added, and everything outside the kernel can be thought of as 0. When the kernel is small (e.g. $3\times 3$, $5\times 5$), this amounts to one local multiply-add at each $(i,j)$.

288a16b5e263.zh: 理論要翻核；實務 CNN 通常不翻
288a16b5e263.en: Theory flips the kernel; practical CNNs usually don't

4b670b56ec8d.zh: 理論卷積會把其中一個訊號（通常是核）翻轉。但影像處理和 CNN 實作裡，核通常不翻——這個不翻的版本叫做互相關（cross-correlation）（式 (4)，$k$ 是核邊長）：
4b670b56ec8d.en: Theoretical convolution flips one of the signals (usually the kernel). But in image processing and CNN implementations, the kernel is usually not flipped — this non-flipped version is called cross-correlation (Eq. (4), where $k$ is the kernel's side length):

2706ee30ce57.zh: 對訓練來說這幾乎沒差：你若堅持翻核，網路就學會「翻過的那一版」；你若不翻，它就學會「沒翻的那一版」。梯度下降不在乎你的慣例叫卷積還是互相關，它只在乎這組數字能不能把損失壓下去。所以口語上大家還是說「卷積層」，程式裡多半在做互相關。
2706ee30ce57.en: For training this makes almost no difference: if you insist on flipping the kernel, the network learns "the flipped version"; if you don't flip it, it learns "the unflipped version". Gradient descent doesn't care whether your convention is called convolution or cross-correlation; it only cares whether this set of numbers can push the loss down. So in everyday speech people still say "convolutional layer", while the code is mostly doing cross-correlation.

561579d53815.en: Recap in plain words: convolution = flip the kernel, then slide and multiply-add; CNN frameworks mostly skip the flip and do cross-correlation instead; backprop will learn the kernel in the right orientation anyway. Later we'll see how sparsity and weight sharing turn this multiply-add into "a parameter-saving special case of a fully connected layer".

4358b812cb73.zh: 原理：CNN 實作多半做互相關（式 (4) 的不翻核版本），$2\times 2$ 核蓋在 $I$ 上逐點相乘再加總。 $0$-index 寫成 $s[i,j]=\sum_{u=0}^{1}\sum_{v=0}^{1} I[i+u,j+v]\,K[u,v]$。 預設 $I=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&0\\1&1&2\\0&1&1\end{bmatrix}$、$K=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}$ 時， $s[0,0]=I_{00}K_{00}+I_{01}K_{01}+I_{10}K_{10}+I_{11}K_{11}=1+0+0+1=2$。
4358b812cb73.en: Principle: CNN implementations mostly compute cross-correlation (the non-flipped version, Eq. (4)): the $2\times 2$ kernel is laid over $I$, multiplied point by point, and summed. With $0$-indexing this is written $s[i,j]=\sum_{u=0}^{1}\sum_{v=0}^{1} I[i+u,j+v]\,K[u,v]$. With the defaults $I=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&0\\1&1&2\\0&1&1\end{bmatrix}$ and $K=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}$, $s[0,0]=I_{00}K_{00}+I_{01}K_{01}+I_{10}K_{10}+I_{11}K_{11}=1+0+0+1=2$.

4f5222f68cf3.zh: 上一節把離散卷積的公式講完了，現在問一個很實際的問題：為什麼不用全連接層硬幹影像，而要改用卷積？ 答案有兩半——稀疏連接跟參數共享。原文 Fig. 2 把這兩種層畫在一起：左邊是密集層，右邊是卷積層。
4f5222f68cf3.en: The previous section finished the formula for discrete convolution; now we ask a very practical question: why not just brute-force images with fully connected layers, and switch to convolution instead? The answer comes in two halves: sparse connectivity and parameter sharing. Fig. 2 of the source text draws the two kinds of layer side by side: on the left a dense layer, on the right a convolutional layer.

04e7fe738b7d.zh: 全連接層裡，每一個輸出神經元都跟每一個輸入神經元相連。輸入有 $m$ 個、輸出有 $n$ 個，權重矩陣就是 $m\times n$ 那麼大，每個位置用一次就丟。影像一放大，這個數字會爆炸。
04e7fe738b7d.en: In a fully connected layer, every output neuron is connected to every input neuron. With $m$ inputs and $n$ outputs, the weight matrix is $m\times n$ in size, and each entry is used once and then thrown away. Once the image gets bigger, this number explodes.

1dc58ea7ea71.zh: 卷積層不這麼做。每個輸出神經元只看輸入的一塊局部區域（kernel 蓋到的那一小塊），所以連線是稀疏的。這件事剛好對上「賭稀疏會贏」（betting on sparsity）、也符合 Occam's razor：能用較少參數解釋資料，就不要用較多。稀疏權重矩陣的秩通常也比全連接來得低。
1dc58ea7ea71.en: A convolutional layer doesn't do this. Each output neuron looks only at a local region of the input (the small patch the kernel covers), so the connections are sparse. This fits exactly with “betting on sparsity”, and it also agrees with Occam's razor: if fewer parameters can explain the data, don't use more. A sparse weight matrix also usually has lower rank than a fully connected one.

769a6695f0cf.zh: 複雜度：$m n$ 對上 $k n$

3b06c3095cea.zh: 令 $m$、$n$ 分別是輸入、輸出神經元數，$k$ 是 kernel 大小（且 $k\lt m$）。三種成本——執行時間、記憶體、參數個數——可以一起比：
3b06c3095cea.en: Let $m$ and $n$ be the numbers of input and output neurons, and $k$ the kernel size (with $k\lt m$). Three costs (running time, memory and number of parameters) can be compared together:

493aa4e0175c.zh: 因為 $k$ 通常遠小於 $m$（例如 $3\times 3$ kernel 對上 $224\times 224$ 影像），省下的不是一點點。
493aa4e0175c.en: Because $k$ is usually much smaller than $m$ (e.g. a $3\times 3$ kernel versus a $224\times 224$ image), the savings are far from small.

801d7f7dd4db.zh: ⚠️ 一個會變回全連接的邊界：稀疏來自「kernel 比輸入小」。若 kernel 尺寸等於輸入尺寸，這層實質上就是全連接——每個輸出又把整張輸入看光了，稀疏優勢消失。卷積的好處不是魔法，是「局部感受野」換來的。
801d7f7dd4db.en: ⚠️ A boundary where it turns back into fully connected: the sparsity comes from “the kernel is smaller than the input”. If the kernel size equals the input size, the layer is effectively fully connected: every output sees the whole input again, and the sparsity advantage is gone. The benefit of convolution isn't magic; it is bought with the “local receptive field”.

e83ee1c71d7a.zh: 參數共享：同一顆 kernel 滑過所有位置
e83ee1c71d7a.en: Parameter sharing: the same kernel slides over every position

d494e8f1b4ac.zh: 稀疏解決「連太多」；參數共享解決「每個位置都學一套新權重」。原文 Fig. 3 畫的就是這件事：kernel 的權重在所有空間位置共用——同一顆小濾波器一路滑過去，每個位置套同一組參數。
d494e8f1b4ac.en: Sparsity solves “too many connections”; parameter sharing solves “learning a new set of weights for every position”. Fig. 3 of the source text shows exactly this: the kernel's weights are shared across all spatial positions. The same small filter slides all the way across, and every position applies the same set of parameters.

5a342dc6607d.zh: 對比一下全連接：權重矩陣裡每個元素只用一次，專門負責「某一個輸入 → 某一個輸出」。卷積則相反：kernel 裡每個元素在每個空間位置都被重複使用。網路不是為每個像素學一套專屬濾波器，而是學一組能在整張圖上到處用的特徵偵測器。
5a342dc6607d.en: Compare with fully connected: in the weight matrix each element is used only once, dedicated to “one particular input → one particular output”. Convolution is the opposite: every element of the kernel is reused at every spatial position. The network doesn't learn a dedicated filter for each pixel; it learns one set of feature detectors that can be used everywhere across the whole image.

ebf75833f14b.zh: 口語復盤：全連接是每人跟大家握手（$\mathcal{O}(mn)$）；卷積是只跟鄰居握手（$\mathcal{O}(kn)$），而且握手的那隻手（kernel）全場共用。 Kernel 一旦跟輸入一樣大，握手又變回全場，稀疏就沒了。
ebf75833f14b.en: Recap in plain words: fully connected means everyone shakes hands with everyone ($\mathcal{O}(mn)$); convolution means shaking hands only with your neighbors ($\mathcal{O}(kn)$), and the hand doing the shaking (the kernel) is shared by the whole room. Once the kernel is as big as the input, the handshakes cover the whole room again and the sparsity is gone.

c47a1c9aa78d.en: Figure 2 Sparse connectivity: fully connected layer vs convolutional layer

3cc5395abe26.en: Dense: everyone shakes hands, O(m n); conv: only neighbors, O(k n), one kernel stamped everywhere

231bd158de15.en: Boundary: if kernel size = input size, sparsity vanishes and the layer is effectively fully connected again

ef1c45a69973.zh: 反直覺：卷積的好處不是魔法，是「局部感受野 + 同一隻手全場握手」換來的。
ef1c45a69973.en: Counterintuitive: convolution's benefit isn't magic; it's bought with “local receptive field + the same hand shaking with the whole room”.

7b1846eb702b.zh: 稀疏連結砍參數；同一組核滑過全圖＝參數共享
7b1846eb702b.en: Sparse connectivity cuts parameters; the same kernel sliding over the whole image = parameter sharing

20e9ead768bd.zh: 🧪 Demo：參數量 — 全連接 $mn$ vs 卷積 $kn$（課本 $\mathcal{O}(kn)$）
20e9ead768bd.en: 🧪 Demo: parameter count, fully connected $mn$ vs convolution $kn$ (textbook: $\mathcal{O}(kn)$)

d0aa9f37d2a4.zh: 原理：輸入 $m$ 個神經元、輸出 $n$ 個時，全連接每個輸出都連到全部輸入，參數個數恰好 $m\cdot n$。 卷積每個輸出只連到大小 $k$ 的局部，且權重全場共用，參數個數恰好 $k\cdot n$（課本寫 $\mathcal{O}(kn)$）。 比值 $mn/(kn)=m/k$（$k>0$）。若 $k=m$，稀疏優勢消失，兩式相等。
d0aa9f37d2a4.en: Principle: with $m$ input neurons and $n$ outputs, in a fully connected layer every output connects to all inputs, so the number of parameters is exactly $m\cdot n$. In convolution each output connects only to a local patch of size $k$, and the weights are shared across the whole image, so the number of parameters is exactly $k\cdot n$ (the textbook writes $\mathcal{O}(kn)$). The ratio is $mn/(kn)=m/k$ ($k>0$). If $k=m$, the sparsity advantage vanishes and the two expressions are equal.

087074273dd4.zh: 這在做什麼：把「全連接太稠、卷積只跟鄰居握手」化成兩個確切整數。 怎麼操作：
087074273dd4.en: What this does: turns “fully connected is too dense, convolution only shakes hands with neighbors” into two exact integers. How to use it:

42ad7ec87a07.en: What to look for: $n$ scales both sides; $m$ scales only the fully connected one; $k$ scales only the convolution. Correct baseline: at any slider position, the readout's FC must equal $m\times n$ and Conv must equal $k\times n$, with no rounding.

1f26432746d3.zh: 每個空間位置學一套獨立的 kernel
1f26432746d3.en: Each spatial position learns its own independent kernel

5c568b9114ca.zh: 同一顆 kernel 滑過所有空間位置、權重複用

657c460e7204.zh: 前後兩層必須參數個數相同

de96b40a5497.zh: 全連接層裡，權重矩陣每個元素的使用方式是？
de96b40a5497.en: In a fully connected layer, how is each element of the weight matrix used?

b3a7c30293ad.zh: 在每個空間位置都被重複使用
b3a7c30293ad.en: It is reused at every spatial position

3b30c2f1ce06.zh: 只用一次，專門連接特定輸入與特定輸出
3b30c2f1ce06.en: It is used only once, dedicated to connecting a specific input to a specific output

0fbda346c081.zh: 必須等於 kernel 的中心權重
0fbda346c081.en: It must equal the kernel's center weight

c46b40c24007.en: It is always zero to keep things sparse

b8cbce28228c.zh: 平移等價性（不是不變性）

269736ed23e6.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：貓往右走，特徵圖也往右
269736ed23e6.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: the cat walks right, and the feature map goes right too

b9f082b8817b.zh: 輸入挪一下，特徵圖也跟著挪——這叫等價，不是不變
b9f082b8817b.en: Shift the input a little and the feature map shifts with it: that's equivariance, not invariance

8dc4af72fc4f.zh: 卷積層還有一個常被講錯的性質：平移等價（translation equivalence），也有人寫成 equivariance。白話是：輸入平移，輸出特徵圖用同樣的方式跟著平移，特徵之間的相對空間關係被保住。原文 Fig. 4 畫的就是「兩個操作可以交換順序」。
8dc4af72fc4f.en: Convolutional layers have another property that is often explained wrongly: translation equivalence, which some also write as equivariance. In plain words: when the input is translated, the output feature map translates along with it in the same way, and the relative spatial relationships between features are preserved. Fig. 4 of the source text shows exactly “the two operations can be swapped in order”.

d84504b9b46a.zh: 請先把兩個詞分開，後面 KP-9 講池化時還會再碰到：
d84504b9b46a.en: First keep these two words apart; we will run into them again in KP-9 on pooling:

8f7df7e20517.zh: 等價（equivalence）：先變換再處理 $=$ 先處理再變換。輸出跟著動。
8f7df7e20517.en: Equivariance (equivalence): transform then process $=$ process then transform. The output moves along.

e80b37173022.zh: 不變（invariance）：輸入怎麼變，輸出幾乎同一個數字。輸出不動。
e80b37173022.en: Invariance: however the input changes, the output is almost the same number. The output doesn't move.

b7a73641d11e.zh: 卷積是前者，不是後者。貓往右移兩格，特徵圖上的「貓」也往右移兩格——這正是等價。若是不變，特徵圖應該完全沒變，那就分不清貓在左邊還是右邊了。
b7a73641d11e.en: Convolution is the former, not the latter. If the cat moves two cells to the right, the “cat” on the feature map also moves two cells to the right: that is exactly equivariance. If it were invariance, the feature map wouldn't change at all, and you couldn't tell whether the cat is on the left or on the right.

63b03a375e5b.zh: 式 (5)：$f$ 與 $g$ 可以換順序
63b03a375e5b.en: Eq. (5): $f$ and $g$ can be swapped in order

e4e7fec656f2.zh: 形式化：函數 $f(x)$ 對函數 $g(x)$ 等價，意思是
e4e7fec656f2.en: Formally: a function $f(x)$ is equivariant to a function $g(x)$ means

b85b95d610ef.zh: 把 $g$ 想成「平移」、$f$ 想成「卷積」，式 (5) 就是說下面兩條路走完結果一樣：
b85b95d610ef.en: Think of $g$ as “translation” and $f$ as “convolution”; Eq. (5) then says the two paths below end with the same result:

a3aa4802b29a.zh: 同一顆 kernel 在每個位置都用同一組權重（上一節的參數共享），平移之後局部長相沒變，濾波器當然還是在對應的新位置給出同一個反應——所以兩條路會對上。
a3aa4802b29a.en: The same kernel uses the same set of weights at every position (the parameter sharing of the previous section). After a translation the local appearance hasn't changed, so of course the filter gives the same response at the corresponding new position. That's why the two paths match.

a71d7149ea0b.zh: 平移可以，旋轉、縮放不行
a71d7149ea0b.en: Translation yes, rotation and scaling no

41ec83c7f34d.zh: 等價只對平移成立。旋轉、縮放這類變換，卷積沒有式 (5) 那種交換性：把圖轉 $90^\circ$ 再卷，跟先卷再轉 $90^\circ$，一般不會得到同一張特徵圖。實務上若要對旋轉、尺度比較穩，得靠資料增強、多尺度架構或其他模組，不是單靠標準卷積自動送你。
41ec83c7f34d.en: Equivariance holds only for translation. For transformations like rotation and scaling, convolution does not have the commutativity of Eq. (5): rotating the image by $90^\circ$ and then convolving generally does not give the same feature map as convolving first and then rotating by $90^\circ$. In practice, if you want more robustness to rotation and scale, you need data augmentation, multi-scale architectures or other modules; standard convolution doesn't hand it to you for free.

f42fb9e04b1f.zh: 口語復盤：卷積對平移是等價（輸出跟著挪），不是不變（輸出保持原樣）；式 (5) 就是「平移再卷 $=$ 卷再平移」。旋轉、縮放不在這份保障裡。
f42fb9e04b1f.en: Recap in plain words: convolution is equivariant to translation (the output shifts along), not invariant (the output stays as it was); Eq. (5) is just “translate then convolve $=$ convolve then translate”. Rotation and scaling are not covered by this guarantee.

3b607cb17792.zh: 平移等價：先平移再卷積 ＝ 先卷積再平移（兩路同一張圖）；不是旋轉不變
3b607cb17792.en: Translation equivariance: translate then convolve = convolve then translate (same map either way); not rotation invariance

e858d0d543ed.en: Stride, channels, padding and output size

dfce9b9ba2fa.en: Four knobs: stride, width, channels, padding

ed84b424242f.zh: 卷積怎麼滑、滑完特徵圖多大，由幾個超參數決定。先把名詞對好，再看輸出尺寸公式。
ed84b424242f.en: How the convolution slides, and how large the feature map is after sliding, are set by a few hyperparameters. First let's get the terms straight, then look at the output-size formula.

7504cffd60fe.zh: Stride（步幅）：kernel 每次移動幾格。$s=1$ 是逐格滑；$s=2$ 會跳格，輸出空間尺寸較小。
7504cffd60fe.en: Stride: how many cells the kernel moves each time. $s=1$ slides cell by cell; $s=2$ skips cells, and the spatial size of the output is smaller.

314ed74289ee.zh: Width（寬度）：通常同時指 kernel 的寬與高——kernel 多半是正方形。小 kernel 比較「盯中心」；大 kernel 把更廣的鄰居一起加進來。
314ed74289ee.en: Width: usually refers to both the width and the height of the kernel at once—kernels are mostly square. A small kernel "stares at the center" more; a large kernel adds a wider neighborhood into the mix.

cf70475c1241.zh: Channels（通道）：這裡講的是 kernel 的深度，必須等於它要作用的輸入通道數。千萬別跟「卷積之後有幾張輸出特徵圖」搞混——那是有幾顆獨立的 kernel，不是單一顆 kernel 的深度。例如 RGB 圖有 3 個輸入通道，每一顆濾波器的深度就是 3；若你要 16 張輸出特徵圖，你需要 16 顆這樣的濾波器，不是把 kernel 深度設成 16。
cf70475c1241.en: Channels: what is meant here is the depth of the kernel, which must equal the number of input channels it acts on. Never confuse this with "how many output feature maps there are after the convolution"—that is how many independent kernels there are, not the depth of a single kernel. For example, an RGB image has 3 input channels, so each filter has depth 3; if you want 16 output feature maps, you need 16 such filters, not a kernel depth set to 16.

775f2cfe8a38.zh: Padding（填充）：在輸入外圍補一圈（或多圈）值，用來控制輸出空間尺寸、或保留邊界資訊。常見做法：
775f2cfe8a38.en: Padding: add a ring (or several rings) of values around the input, to control the spatial size of the output or to keep boundary information. Common methods:

a1e998c21776.en: Constant padding: pad with a specified constant.

3a98db22a251.zh: Circular padding：把輸入頭尾循環接起來。
3a98db22a251.en: Circular padding: wrap the input around, joining its end to its start.

4d4916495ab0.zh: 完全不填充時，叫做 valid padding。Valid 的後果很直接：每次卷積輸出都會比輸入小一圈，疊很多層之後空間尺寸會一路縮小。
4d4916495ab0.en: No padding at all is called valid padding. The consequence of valid is straightforward: every convolution's output is one ring smaller than its input, and after stacking many layers the spatial size keeps shrinking.

fd4770855b13.zh: 輸入寬（或高）為 $d$，kernel 寬為 $f$，單側 padding 為 $p$，stride 為 $s$。輸出特徵圖的空間尺寸是
fd4770855b13.en: Let the input width (or height) be $d$, the kernel width $f$, the padding on one side $p$, and the stride $s$. The spatial size of the output feature map is

0780b767f9ad.zh: $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ 是向下取整。正方形輸入、正方形 kernel 時，寬與高用同一個式子。心算時可以記：有效覆蓋長度是 $d+2p-f$，再按步幅切成幾段，段數加 1 就是輸出邊長。
0780b767f9ad.en: $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ is rounding down (floor). For a square input and a square kernel, width and height use the same formula. For mental arithmetic, remember: the effective coverage length is $d+2p-f$; cut it into segments by the stride, and the number of segments plus 1 is the output side length.

01a57d5fd03b.zh: 舉例：$d=5$、$f=3$、$p=0$、$s=1$（valid）→ $\lfloor(5-3+0)/1+1\rfloor=3$，輸出 $3\times 3$。若改 $p=1$，則 $\lfloor(5-3+2)/1+1\rfloor=5$，輸出與輸入同邊長（常見的「same」設定之一）。
01a57d5fd03b.en: Example: $d=5$, $f=3$, $p=0$, $s=1$ (valid) → $\lfloor(5-3+0)/1+1\rfloor=3$, output $3\times 3$. If we change to $p=1$, then $\lfloor(5-3+2)/1+1\rfloor=5$, and the output has the same side length as the input (one of the common "same" settings).

eb233a2fc5d4.zh: 原文 Fig. 5 與 Fig. 6：從單通道到多通道
eb233a2fc5d4.en: Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 of the textbook: from single channel to multiple channels

412445f282f8.zh: 原文 Fig. 5 是單通道輸入的卷積例子：一張平面 × 一顆平面 kernel，滑完得到一張特徵圖。Fig. 6 升級成三個輸入通道、兩顆濾波器——每一顆濾波器的深度都是 3（對齊輸入通道），兩顆濾波器產出兩張輸出特徵圖。看這兩張圖時，請對照上面那句：kernel 深度 $=$ 輸入通道數 $\neq$ 輸出特徵圖張數。
412445f282f8.en: Fig. 5 of the textbook is a convolution example with a single-channel input: one plane × one planar kernel, which after sliding gives one feature map. Fig. 6 upgrades to three input channels and two filters—each filter has depth 3 (matching the input channels), and the two filters produce two output feature maps. When looking at these two figures, compare them with the sentence above: kernel depth $=$ number of input channels $\neq$ number of output feature maps.

75d2ab2b0c88.zh: 口語復盤：stride 管跳幾格，width 管看多寬，kernel 深度必須對齊輸入通道，padding 決定要不要補邊；valid 就是不補。輸出邊長用式 (6) 一次算完。
75d2ab2b0c88.en: Quick recap in plain words: stride controls how many cells you skip, width controls how wide you look, kernel depth must match the input channels, and padding decides whether to pad the border; valid means no padding. Eq. (6) gives the output side length in one go.

57c7c42f661a.zh: 輸出尺寸 ⌊(d−f+2p)/s⌋+1；padding 決定會不會縮邊

9d76e0c1599b.zh: 原理：正方形輸入邊長 $d$、正方形核寬 $f$、單側 padding $p$、stride $s\ge 1$。 式 (6) 每個空間維都是 $\mathrm{out}=\left\lfloor\frac{d-f+2p}{s}\right\rfloor+1$，故輸出為 $\mathrm{out}\times\mathrm{out}$。 有效覆蓋長度 $d-f+2p$；若它為負，floor 可得到 $0$ 或負數——視為不合法（核比 padded 輸入還大）。 例：$d=5,f=3,p=0,s=1$ → $\lfloor(5-3)/1\rfloor+1=3$。
9d76e0c1599b.en: Principle: square input of side $d$, square kernel of width $f$, one-side padding $p$, stride $s\ge 1$. By Eq. (6), each spatial dimension is $\mathrm{out}=\left\lfloor\frac{d-f+2p}{s}\right\rfloor+1$, so the output is $\mathrm{out}\times\mathrm{out}$. The effective coverage length is $d-f+2p$; if it is negative, the floor can give $0$ or a negative number—treat this as invalid (the kernel is larger than the padded input). Example: $d=5,f=3,p=0,s=1$ → $\lfloor(5-3)/1\rfloor+1=3$.

dffc10ccf25b.zh: 這在做什麼：把式 (6) 的四個旋鈕化成兩個成比例的正方形。 怎麼操作：
dffc10ccf25b.en: What this does: turns the four knobs of Eq. (6) into two proportionally sized squares. How to use it:

17abb956d76d.en: Drag $d$, $f$, $p$, $s$ (the lower bound of $s$ is locked at 1), and $\mathrm{out}$ is recomputed instantly.

ae1b15b0c547.zh: 試 $f>d$ 且 $p=0$，看「不合法」警告。

2730f173c661.zh: 觀察什麼：$p$ 補邊可讓 $\mathrm{out}$ 追上 $d$；$s$ 變大輸出變稀。 正確基準：$\mathrm{out}$ 必須等於 $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s\rfloor+1$；預設 $8,3,0,1$ 應為 $6$；若結果 $<1$ 必須標「不合法」。
2730f173c661.en: What to observe: padding with $p$ lets $\mathrm{out}$ catch up with $d$; a larger $s$ makes the output sparser. Correct reference: $\mathrm{out}$ must equal $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s\rfloor+1$; the default $8,3,0,1$ should give $6$; if the result is $<1$ it must be marked "invalid".

fb745f1545d3.zh: 偵測器階段：其實就是激活函數
fb745f1545d3.en: The detector stage: really just the activation function

63461149b016.zh: LeNet 那條管線把卷積層拆成三站：卷積 → 偵測器（detector） → 池化。Detector 沒有新公式——它就是套上激活函數。之所以叫偵測器，是因為激活對「超過門檻的訊號」會亮起來。Chap. 2 講過的那些 $\sigma$ 在 CNN 裡照樣能用（ReLU 最常見）。
63461149b016.en: The LeNet pipeline splits a convolutional layer into three stages: convolution → detector → pooling. The detector has no new formula—it is simply applying an activation function. It is called a detector because the activation "lights up" for signals above a threshold. All the $\sigma$ from Chap. 2 still work in a CNN (ReLU is the most common).

57b49ff5ca59.zh: 池化：對局部區域做摘要統計
57b49ff5ca59.en: Pooling: summary statistics over local regions

c1a7bbbe831b.zh: 池化也是一顆小窗在特徵圖上滑，但不做可學習的加權求和，而是對窗內數值算一個統計量。常見方法：
c1a7bbbe831b.en: Pooling is also a small window sliding over the feature map, but it does not compute a learnable weighted sum; instead it computes a statistic of the values inside the window. Common methods:

9317de1c473e.en: Weighted average pooling: take a weighted average.

587a5dd6fde9.en: $\ell_2$-norm pooling: take the $\ell_2$ norm of the region.

ba77638fa620.zh: 參數跟卷積很像，同樣有 stride、width、channels、padding：
ba77638fa620.en: Its parameters are much like convolution's: it also has stride, width, channels and padding:

3d84c07bc00e.zh: Stride：窗每次走幾格。stride 小於窗寬 → 區域重疊；否則不重疊。
3d84c07bc00e.en: Stride: how many cells the window moves each time. Stride smaller than the window width → the regions overlap; otherwise they don't overlap.

8fdcb1ab1d35.zh: Width：池化窗的空間大小，通常正方形。窗越大，摘要越「粗」。
8fdcb1ab1d35.en: Width: the spatial size of the pooling window, usually square. The larger the window, the "coarser" the summary.

f345b0fbb4e0.zh: Number of channels：池化核深度對齊輸入通道；各通道通常分開池化。
f345b0fbb4e0.en: Number of channels: the depth of the pooling kernel matches the input channels; each channel is usually pooled separately.

c57309722312.en: Padding: the same set as in §3.1.5 (zero / constant / replicate / reflect / circular).

46912fe9c7f5.en: Average pooling (stride 2, width 2)—take the average of each of the four blocks: $(2+1+2+3)/4=2$, $(7+5+2+4)/4=4.5$, $(8-1+7+3)/4=4.25$, $(-5+1+2+6)/4=1$.

3cf1796552d9.zh: 卷積找出的特徵，精確落在哪個像素上，常常沒那麼重要——有沒有這個特徵才重要。池化（pooling）把鄰近活化做摘要，因此對局部平移（local translation）近似不變。
3cf1796552d9.en: Exactly which pixel a feature found by convolution lands on often doesn't matter much; whether the feature is there at all is what matters. Pooling summarizes neighboring activations, so it is approximately invariant to local translation.

d2e1da72bd3f.zh: Fig. 7 把這件事講得很具體：訊號往右平移一格之後，輸入的四個值全部改變；但做完 max pooling，只有兩個池化特徵改變，另外兩個維持原樣（圖中虛線標出沒變的值）。也就是說，小位移會改寫整塊輸入，卻不一定改寫池化後的摘要。
d2e1da72bd3f.en: Fig. 7 makes this concrete: after the signal shifts right by one cell, all four input values change; but after max pooling, only two pooled features change, and the other two stay the same (the figure marks the unchanged values with dashed lines). In other words, a small shift rewrites the whole block of input but does not necessarily rewrite the pooled summary.

113efe0a61c2.zh: 多數任務：在不在，比在哪裡重要
113efe0a61c2.en: Most tasks: whether it's there matters more than where

dd1e8878a0e4.zh: 多數應用樂見這種局部不變性。Fig. 8 的數字「5」就是典型例子：辨識任務要的是「圖裡有沒有 5」，不是「5 偏左還是偏右幾個像素」。把位置資訊稍微模糊掉，反而讓分類更穩。
dd1e8878a0e4.en: Most applications welcome this local invariance. The digit "5" in Fig. 8 is a typical example: a recognition task wants to know "is there a 5 in the image", not "is the 5 a few pixels to the left or to the right". Blurring the position information a little actually makes classification more stable.

d3906a4f5c55.zh: 但這不是萬靈丹。有些任務空間位置本身就是答案——例如判斷物件在左還是在右、量測距離、對齊關鍵點。這時池化引入的不變性會把位置資訊洗掉，變成負擔。記一句對照：平移等價是卷積的性質（KP-6），局部平移不變是池化的性質；要不要不變，看任務。
d3906a4f5c55.en: But it is no cure-all. In some tasks the spatial position itself is the answer, for example deciding whether an object is on the left or the right, measuring distances, or aligning keypoints. There the invariance introduced by pooling washes out the position information and becomes a burden. Remember one contrast: translation equivariance is a property of convolution (KP-6), local translation invariance is a property of pooling; whether you want invariance depends on the task.

3aab82c24b28.zh: 下採樣：空間變小，後面比較負擔得起
3aab82c24b28.en: Downsampling: smaller in space, so later layers can afford more

33a21570eda8.zh: 池化的第二個角色是下採樣（downsampling）。當 stride 大於 1，特徵圖的空間尺寸會縮小；stride $=2$ 大約把高、寬各砍半。後續層要處理的格子變少，計算量下降；接到全連接時，可學習參數也跟著變少，有助於控制複雜度、改善泛化。
33a21570eda8.en: Pooling's second role is downsampling. When the stride is greater than 1, the spatial size of the feature map shrinks; stride $=2$ roughly halves both height and width. Later layers have fewer cells to process, so computation drops; when it feeds a fully connected layer, the number of learnable parameters also drops, which helps control complexity and improve generalization.

62e2ee0d27f6.zh: LeNet（Fig. 1）就是「卷積抽特徵 → 池化縮小」反覆堆疊的原型。Fig. 9 另給一個下採樣示意：池化核在空間上跨步走，輸出比輸入疏。
62e2ee0d27f6.en: LeNet (Fig. 1) is the prototype of stacking "convolution extracts features → pooling shrinks" over and over. Fig. 9 gives another downsampling illustration: the pooling kernel strides across space, and the output is sparser than the input.

d1877082e92e.zh: 口語復盤：池化 ≈ 局部摘要。 小平移後輸入全變、池化特徵往往只變一部分（Fig. 7）；多數時候「有沒有」重於「在哪裡」（Fig. 8），但位置關鍵的任務要小心。stride $\gt 1$ 把圖縮小，後面算得起、參數也比較少（Fig. 9）。
d1877082e92e.en: Plain-language recap: pooling ≈ local summary. After a small shift the input changes completely, while the pooled features often change only partly (Fig. 7); most of the time "whether it's there" matters more than "where it is" (Fig. 8), but be careful with tasks where position is key. A stride $\gt 1$ shrinks the map, so later layers can afford the computation and have fewer parameters (Fig. 9).

998d07e474cd.zh: 圖 7 pooling 對局部平移較穩健
998d07e474cd.en: Fig. 7 Pooling is more robust to local translation

9f911e6f818a.zh: 圖 8 辨識數字 5 比精確位置更重要
9f911e6f818a.en: Fig. 8 Recognizing the digit 5 matters more than its exact position

451756a7533d.en: Fig. 9 An example of pooling downsampling

6ba9a2d2e99a.en: After a small shift, most pooled features remain; position is sometimes secondary to "is it there"

a19d1e21a505.en: What phenomenon does Fig. 7 use to show that pooling is more robust to local translation?

ee916fc5d0df.en: After the shift all four inputs change, yet after max pooling only two features change

5c2a06807399.en: After the shift the input is completely unchanged

5bd22c49992b.zh: 池化會把平移放大成全域移動
5bd22c49992b.en: Pooling amplifies the shift into a global movement

56f88b7d1c43.zh: 只有平均池化具有平移不變，max pooling 完全沒有
56f88b7d1c43.en: Only average pooling is translation invariant; max pooling is not at all

cc5a096a5bec.zh: Fig. 8 想強調的辨識觀點是？
cc5a096a5bec.en: What recognition viewpoint does Fig. 8 emphasize?

f9aa05a2eafa.zh: 必須精確知道數字 5 的像素座標
f9aa05a2eafa.en: You must know the exact pixel coordinates of the digit 5

0342b6983419.zh: 偵測到數字 5 的存在，通常比知道它的精確位置更重要
0342b6983419.en: Detecting that the digit 5 is present is usually more important than knowing its exact position

b27bd62b8016.zh: 池化會摧毀所有類別資訊

e6f209e333bd.zh: 平移不變性對所有電腦視覺任務都有害
e6f209e333bd.en: Translation invariance is harmful for every computer vision task

71f058d3907d.zh: 什麼情況下，池化帶來的局部平移不變性可能有害？
71f058d3907d.en: When can the local translation invariance brought by pooling be harmful?

fab2da6f30e1.zh: 只要用了 ReLU 就一定有害
fab2da6f30e1.en: It is always harmful as soon as ReLU is used

43962d3fb901.zh: 任務本身依賴精確空間位置（例如左右、距離、對齊）
43962d3fb901.en: When the task itself depends on precise spatial position (e.g. left/right, distance, alignment)

3281a902ed13.zh: 只有平均池化會有害、max pooling 永遠無害
3281a902ed13.en: Only average pooling is harmful; max pooling is never harmful

4a4bfb3d9ef3.zh: 池化做下採樣（例如 stride $=2$）的主要效益是？
4a4bfb3d9ef3.en: What is the main benefit of downsampling with pooling (e.g. stride $=2$)?

dc462845a228.zh: 特徵圖空間尺寸變大、參數變多
dc462845a228.en: The feature map's spatial size grows and there are more parameters

72ecb615a3a7.zh: 縮小空間尺寸，降低後續計算量與可學習參數
72ecb615a3a7.en: It shrinks the spatial size, lowering later computation and the number of learnable parameters

d94986542c3d.en: It turns the convolution kernel into a fully connected layer

d4f640004054.en: It forces all weights to equal 1

40f5f50f4980.zh: 無限強先驗、動態池化與 GAP
40f5f50f4980.en: Infinitely strong prior, dynamic pooling and GAP

f3eaea06d091.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：先驗把很多權重焊死成 0
f3eaea06d091.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: the prior welds many weights shut at 0

efc10a09b311.zh: 無限強先驗：直接把某些權重釘成 0
efc10a09b311.en: Infinitely strong prior: pin some weights to 0 outright

be52d760a0ef.zh: 卷積與池化都可以看成對權重加了無限強先驗（infinitely strong prior）。Fig. 10 把約束強度排成三級：弱先驗、較強先驗、無限強先驗——最後一檔等於直接把某些權重設成 0，不讓模型去學它們。
be52d760a0ef.en: Convolution and pooling can both be seen as placing an infinitely strong prior on the weights. Fig. 10 ranks the strength of the constraint in three levels: weak prior, stronger prior, infinitely strong prior; the last level amounts to setting some weights directly to 0 and not letting the model learn them.

7df3bce26893.zh: 這來自前面講過的稀疏性（Fig. 2、§3.1.2）：每個輸出只看局部感受野，其餘連線根本不存在。這種內建稀疏呼應「押注稀疏」（betting on sparsity）——高密度時沒有方法能處處表現好，所以選在稀疏假設下會表現好的程序——也符合奧卡姆剃刀：較簡單的解通常較可能是對的。
7df3bce26893.en: This comes from the sparsity discussed earlier (Fig. 2, §3.1.2): each output looks only at a local receptive field, and the other connections simply do not exist. This built-in sparsity echoes "betting on sparsity": in high density no method can do well everywhere, so we choose a procedure that does well under a sparsity assumption. It also fits Occam's razor: simpler solutions are usually more likely to be correct.

d2e9ea74e8bc.zh: 動態池化：不一定綁死在固定鄰域
d2e9ea74e8bc.en: Dynamic pooling: not necessarily tied to a fixed neighborhood

42acfe236149.zh: 池化不必永遠對「空間上剛好相鄰」的格子做。動態池化（dynamic pooling） 可以依內容或結構決定誰跟誰一起摘要。例如對顯著特徵的位置做 K-means，同一群的特徵再池化——每個輸入的池化區域可以不一樣。另一條路是訓練時學一套固定的池化結構，之後對所有樣本共用。
42acfe236149.en: Pooling does not always have to act on cells that "happen to be adjacent in space". Dynamic pooling can decide by content or structure which features are summarized together. For example, run K-means on the locations of salient features and pool the features within each cluster; each input can then have different pooling regions. Another route is to learn one fixed pooling structure during training and then share it across all samples.

cddc3279f65f.zh: 輸入尺寸不一定要砍成同一張圖
cddc3279f65f.en: Inputs don't all have to be cut to the same image size

24b739f4beb6.zh: 標準 CNN 常假設輸入寬高固定。實務上每張圖大小不同，硬裁切或 zero padding 會丟掉資訊。比較彈性的做法是用池化去遷就尺寸：
24b739f4beb6.en: A standard CNN often assumes a fixed input width and height. In practice every image has a different size, and hard cropping or zero padding throws information away. A more flexible approach is to let pooling accommodate the size:

6161578e7e7e.zh: Fig. 11：依輸入大小調整池化核寬——大圖用較寬的核、小圖用較窄的核，讓輸出對齊到同一空間尺寸。
6161578e7e7e.en: Fig. 11: adjust the pooling kernel width to the input size: a wider kernel for large images, a narrower kernel for small ones, so the output lines up at the same spatial size.

3ca7faef4cc9.zh: 空間金字塔池化（spatial pyramid pooling, SPP）：把最後一層池化換成一組固定數量的箱子（bins），箱子會隨輸入縮放。這樣 CNN 可以吃任意尺寸，不必先 resize／crop。
3ca7faef4cc9.en: Spatial pyramid pooling (SPP): replace the last pooling layer with a fixed number of bins that scale with the input. This way a CNN can take any size without first resizing or cropping.

c0647ae0ddc9.zh: 全域平均池化：結尾不一定要接巨大全連接
c0647ae0ddc9.en: Global average pooling: the end doesn't have to be a huge fully connected layer

a38200c5f669.zh: 現代 CNN 常在網路末端用 全域平均池化（global average pooling, GAP） 取代全連接層：每張特徵圖壓成一個數，再接到類別。參數大幅減少，也強迫「一張特徵圖對應一個語意／類別」的直接對應。
a38200c5f669.en: Modern CNNs often use global average pooling (GAP) at the end of the network instead of fully connected layers: each feature map is squeezed into one number, which is then connected to the classes. The parameter count drops sharply, and it enforces a direct correspondence of "one feature map to one semantic concept / class".

12a11bfee0d0.zh: 口語復盤：卷積／池化 = 把很多權重強制為 0 的無限強先驗（Fig. 10）。 池化區可以動態決定；核寬或 SPP 能吃不同尺寸（Fig. 11）；結尾用 GAP 常比巨型 FC 更乾淨。
12a11bfee0d0.en: Plain-language recap: convolution / pooling = an infinitely strong prior that forces many weights to 0 (Fig. 10). Pooling regions can be decided dynamically; kernel width or SPP can take different sizes (Fig. 11); ending with GAP is often cleaner than a giant FC.

03944442cfc5.zh: 圖 10 弱先驗、較強先驗、無限強先驗
03944442cfc5.en: Fig. 10 Weak prior, stronger prior, infinitely strong prior

f12a5227cc7b.zh: 圖 11 用不同 pooling 核寬處理不同影像尺寸
f12a5227cc7b.en: Fig. 11 Using different pooling kernel widths for different image sizes

9f56ee122643.zh: 無限強先驗：不是「希望權重小」，而是直接把許多權重釘成 0
9f56ee122643.en: Infinitely strong prior: not "hoping weights are small", but pinning many weights to 0

663ab75e91df.zh: 模型自己決定遠近要不要連

a97e78f3197c.zh: 鼓勵稀疏，但仍可學回來
a97e78f3197c.en: Encourages sparsity, but can be learned back

724bd22f3a78.zh: 梯度仍能把它們救回來

c1769f6bbcc7.zh: 連線根本不存在＝權重就是 0

efa2786ddd2c.en: CNN / pooling: distant weights forced to 0

a92b99942e28.zh: 梯度改不到它們 · 結構說了算
a92b99942e28.en: Gradients can't touch them · structure decides

2fb2184faf1b.zh: 同一先驗的後續：GAP 取代巨型 FC
2fb2184faf1b.en: Same prior, continued: GAP replaces the giant FC

d8743db5cdd8.zh: SPP／調池化核寬：用摘要遷就任意輸入尺寸，不必先裁切
d8743db5cdd8.en: SPP / tuned pooling width: summaries adapt to any input size, no cropping first

0cd71d2c7b0d.en: "Can't learn" is sometimes better than "can learn everything"

ad8e787571ef.zh: 押注稀疏：遠距像素不該握手
ad8e787571ef.en: Betting on sparsity: distant pixels shouldn't shake hands

8c5e78dc92ac.zh: 奧卡姆：較少參數更可能對
8c5e78dc92ac.en: Occam: fewer parameters more likely right

2715465f08bc.zh: 無限強＝硬約束，不是正則項
2715465f08bc.en: Infinitely strong = hard constraint, not a regularizer

4647679de92b.zh: 卷積／池化等於把許多權重強制為 0 的無限強先驗
4647679de92b.en: Convolution / pooling amount to an infinitely strong prior that forces many weights to 0

320c7803fe86.zh: 無限強先驗（Fig. 10）在卷積／池化裡實際做了什麼？
320c7803fe86.en: What does the infinitely strong prior (Fig. 10) actually do in convolution / pooling?

96742c504a44.zh: 把某些權重直接設成 0（內建稀疏）
96742c504a44.en: Sets some weights directly to 0 (built-in sparsity)

316d4266d4fe.en: Forces the learning rate to be 0

2c75d5c2013a.zh: 動態池化與固定局部鄰域池化的差異是？
2c75d5c2013a.en: How does dynamic pooling differ from pooling over a fixed local neighborhood?

7804a69481cb.zh: 動態池化依內容／結構決定池化區域，例如對顯著點做 K-means 再同群池化
7804a69481cb.en: Dynamic pooling decides pooling regions by content / structure, e.g. K-means on salient points, then pooling within each cluster

e07629da3a15.zh: 動態池化只能用在全連接層
e07629da3a15.en: Dynamic pooling can only be used in fully connected layers

c5ea401d0be0.zh: 兩者完全相同，只是名字不同
c5ea401d0be0.en: The two are exactly the same, just with different names

45c360baa2fc.zh: Fig. 11 與空間金字塔池化（SPP）分別如何處理可變輸入尺寸？
45c360baa2fc.en: How do Fig. 11 and spatial pyramid pooling (SPP) each handle variable input sizes?

1a695874f1f2.en: Both can only rely on cropping to 224×224

360779a94d30.zh: Fig. 11 調池化核寬；SPP 用隨輸入縮放的固定數量 bins
360779a94d30.en: Fig. 11 tunes the pooling kernel width; SPP uses a fixed number of bins that scale with the input

8c8181f7252a.zh: 兩者都把池化拿掉、改回全連接
8c8181f7252a.en: Both remove pooling and go back to fully connected layers

c6a05b230abe.zh: 只能 zero padding，不能改池化
c6a05b230abe.en: Only zero padding is possible; pooling cannot be changed

748ca4fe1565.zh: 全域平均池化（GAP）放在現代 CNN 末端，主要取代什麼？
748ca4fe1565.en: Placed at the end of modern CNNs, what does global average pooling (GAP) mainly replace?

eef23efac5d8.zh: 末端的全連接層，減少參數並讓特徵圖與類別直接對應
eef23efac5d8.en: The final fully connected layers, cutting parameters and mapping feature maps directly to classes

f7ec1217b2bf.en: Random initialization of the convolution kernels

7f354ff785be.zh: 權重初始化：隨機、Xavier／He 與 PCA
7f354ff785be.en: Weight initialization: random, Xavier/He, and PCA

9894518cab72.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：音量旋鈕太大爆音、太小沒聲
9894518cab72.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: a volume knob too high blasts, too low is silent

0733a7b1c138.zh: 卷積核就是權重，訓練前一定要先賦值
0733a7b1c138.en: Convolution kernels are the weights, and they must be given values before training

0ab311288abd.zh: CNN 的權重就是卷積核（kernel / filter）裡的數值。訓練目標仍是把損失壓低；主力優化器是 Chap. 3 的反向傳播——梯度下降加上鏈式法則。因為它是迭代算法，優化變數（權重）必須在訓練開始前初始化，否則沒有起點可走。
0ab311288abd.en: The weights of a CNN are the values inside the convolution kernels (kernel / filter). The training goal is still to push the loss down; the main optimizer is backpropagation from Chap. 3, i.e., gradient descent plus the chain rule. Because it is an iterative algorithm, the optimization variables (the weights) must be initialized before training starts; otherwise there is no starting point to move from.

d307dd9c27fd.zh: 常見路線有三條：隨機初始化、Xavier／Glorot 與 He 這類「顧變異數」的隨機法，以及用非監督方法（例如 PCA）先學一組核。近代實務以前兩類為主；純高斯／均勻亂數已較少當預設。
d307dd9c27fd.en: There are three common routes: random initialization; variance-aware random methods such as Xavier/Glorot and He; and learning a set of kernels first with an unsupervised method (e.g., PCA). Modern practice relies mainly on the first two; plain Gaussian/uniform random numbers are now rarely the default.

88740efe3063.zh: 隨機初始化：和隨機投影、Johnson–Lindenstrauss 有關
88740efe3063.en: Random initialization: related to random projection and Johnson–Lindenstrauss

238d8bffdcff.zh: 權重可從高斯或均勻分布抽。太大容易梯度爆炸，太小容易梯度消失——前向活化與反向梯度都會在層與層之間失控。
238d8bffdcff.en: The weights can be drawn from a Gaussian or uniform distribution. Too large easily leads to exploding gradients, too small easily leads to vanishing gradients: both the forward activations and the backward gradients get out of control from layer to layer.

3ddb31929d4c.zh: 這件事和 Chap. 2 的觀點接得上：一層權重可看成線性變換的投影矩陣；隨機初始化就對應隨機投影（random projection）。Johnson–Lindenstrauss 引理說：隨機投影能以高機率近似保留成對距離（誤差有界）。這提供一個理論理由，解釋為什麼「隨便抽一組不太大也不太小的權重」往往是堪用的起點——前饋網路與 CNN 都適用。
3ddb31929d4c.en: This connects to the view from Chap. 2: the weights of a layer can be seen as the projection matrix of a linear transformation, so random initialization corresponds to a random projection. The Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma says that a random projection approximately preserves pairwise distances with high probability (with bounded error). This gives a theoretical reason why "just drawing a set of weights that are neither too large nor too small" is often a usable starting point, for both feedforward networks and CNNs.

359ed3f2836f.zh: 顧變異數：Xavier／Glorot 對 tanh／sigmoid，He 對 ReLU
359ed3f2836f.en: Variance-aware: Xavier/Glorot for tanh/sigmoid, He for ReLU

9da351a83683.zh: 要讓各層活化與梯度的變異數大致平衡，實務上改用：
9da351a83683.en: To keep the variances of the activations and gradients roughly balanced across layers, in practice one uses instead:

1994dd7707c0.zh: Xavier／Glorot 初始化：配合 tanh、sigmoid 這類飽和型激活。
1994dd7707c0.en: Xavier/Glorot initialization: paired with saturating activations such as tanh and sigmoid.

fab2c96bd6be.zh: He 初始化：配合 ReLU（以及其變體）。

06b374fb1146.zh: 它們依扇入／扇出縮放初始變異數，減輕消失／爆炸。純隨機高斯或均勻初始化在現代深度網路裡已不常當預設。
06b374fb1146.en: They scale the initial variance by the fan-in/fan-out, which mitigates vanishing/exploding. Plain random Gaussian or uniform initialization is no longer common as the default in modern deep networks.

983d0bcedffa.zh: 非監督初始化：平移過的 patch 做 PCA
983d0bcedffa.en: Unsupervised initialization: PCA on shifted patches

09a013838ac8.zh: 也可以先不靠標籤。把一層權重切成與核步幅 $s$ 對應的 patch；為了讓特徵對小位移穩健，每個 patch 再稍微平移幾個像素，原 patch 與平移後的一起收集，拉成行向量，送進 PCA。
09a013838ac8.en: You can also start without labels. Cut the weights of a layer into patches corresponding to the kernel stride $s$; to make the features robust to small shifts, each patch is also shifted by a few pixels, and the original and shifted patches are collected together, flattened into column vectors, and fed into PCA.

0fb1041ad114.zh: PCA 得到 $s \times s$ 的特徵向量矩陣，用來取代該層的 patch 權重——這些特徵向量就是這一層的初始核。對小平移較不敏感的特徵，會被 PCA 優先抓出來。同一流程可逐層重複，用非監督方式初始化整座 CNN 的卷積核。
0fb1041ad114.en: PCA yields an $s \times s$ eigenvector matrix, which replaces the patch weights of that layer: these eigenvectors are the layer's initial kernels. Features that are less sensitive to small shifts are picked up first by PCA. The same procedure can be repeated layer by layer to initialize all the convolution kernels of a CNN in an unsupervised way.

de1526892e89.zh: 口語復盤：核 = 權重，沒賦值 backprop 走不了。 亂數起點連到隨機投影／JL；太大爆炸、太小消失。tanh／sigmoid 用 Xavier，ReLU 用 He。想用資料先行：平移 patch → PCA → $s\times s$ 特徵向量當核。
de1526892e89.en: Quick recap: kernels = weights; without values, backprop cannot run. A random starting point connects to random projection/JL; too large explodes, too small vanishes. Use Xavier for tanh/sigmoid and He for ReLU. If you want to let the data go first: shifted patches → PCA → $s\times s$ eigenvectors as kernels.

752fa0c6f3f5.zh: 核就是權重：太大一路放大到爆炸，太小一路縮小到消失，He／Xavier 在保變異數
752fa0c6f3f5.en: Kernels are weights: too large blows up, too small vanishes; He/Xavier preserve variance

330c02aa178b.en: |w| too big: each layer amplifies the signal

7b0ae8dd0d8a.en: Forward activations and gradients both blow up

fab511eab5c0.en: Unsupervised fallback: shifted patches → PCA kernels

8500a3d7d432.en: Weights too large explode, too small vanish; Xavier/He balance the variance

2bd1118cfa21.en: Why must a CNN be initialized before backpropagation?

ab5ba9d6da6c.en: Convolution kernels are not weights, so gradients cannot be computed

824e46a037e1.zh: 權重就是核的數值，backprop 是迭代優化，沒有初值就沒有優化變數
824e46a037e1.en: The weights are the kernel values; backprop is iterative optimization, so without initial values there are no optimization variables

4201befcc429.en: The weights can be seen as a random projection, and JL says random projections approximately preserve pairwise distances

383f10cde0e1.en: The larger the weights the better, to avoid exploding

cd3ea993488d.en: Too large explodes, too small vanishes; Xavier/Glorot suits tanh/sigmoid, He suits ReLU

a9a743b2dd41.zh: Xavier 專為 ReLU 設計，He 專為 sigmoid 設計
a9a743b2dd41.en: Xavier is designed for ReLU, He for sigmoid

939c47d174a0.en: In unsupervised initialization, what does PCA produce to serve as the convolution kernels?

c8acbc2233ce.en: A random Gaussian matrix, unrelated to the patches

89f9f2ac988e.zh: 對原 patch 與微平移 patch 做 PCA，得到 $s\times s$ 特徵向量矩陣當初始核
89f9f2ac988e.en: PCA on the original patches and slightly shifted patches gives an $s\times s$ eigenvector matrix as the initial kernels

6f9e535fac36.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：ImageNet 大賽把 LeNet 放大
6f9e535fac36.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: the ImageNet contest scales up LeNet

218ee66d0bf3.zh: 從競賽場地講起：ImageNet 與 ILSVRC
218ee66d0bf3.en: Starting from the arena: ImageNet and ILSVRC

1e9d391a8533.zh: 後面幾節會依序碰到 VGG、Inception／GoogLeNet、U-Net、ResNet、DenseNet——它們多半在 ImageNet 大規模視覺辨識挑戰（ILSVRC） 上較勁，而且一代疊一代。這一節先把場地與第一個引爆點 AlexNet（2012） 講清楚。
1e9d391a8533.en: The next few sections meet, in order, VGG, Inception/GoogLeNet, U-Net, ResNet, and DenseNet. Most of them competed on the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC), each generation building on the previous one. This section first explains the arena and the first spark, AlexNet (2012).

fb3b7390ad06.zh: ImageNet 約有 1500 萬 張標註高解析影像、約 22,000 個物體類別，圖片從網路上蒐集，以 Amazon Mechanical Turk 人工標註。
fb3b7390ad06.en: ImageNet has about 15 million labeled high-resolution images in about 22,000 object categories; the images were collected from the web and labeled by hand through Amazon Mechanical Turk.

af3f2f648738.zh: 2010 年起，每年舉辦的 ILSVRC 成為影像分類與物件偵測的指標基準。它是 ImageNet 的精選子集：約 120 萬 張高解析圖、1000 類、每類約 1000 張；影像為 RGB，解析度 $224\times 224$。
af3f2f648738.en: Starting in 2010, the annual ILSVRC became the benchmark for image classification and object detection. It is a curated subset of ImageNet: about 1.2 million high-resolution images, 1000 classes, about 1000 images per class; the images are RGB with resolution $224\times 224$.

95a2a9784f2a.zh: AlexNet：八層、雙 GPU、把深度學習打進電腦視覺
95a2a9784f2a.en: AlexNet: eight layers, two GPUs, bringing deep learning into computer vision

8dc5d0f43a73.zh: AlexNet 由 Krizhevsky 在 Hinton 指導下提出（Sutskever 共同作者），拿下 ILSVRC 2012，常被視為深度學習在影像領域爆發的起點。架構見 Fig. 12：八層——五層卷積再接三層全連接，骨架明顯承襲 LeNet。當時單卡約 3 GB 顯存不夠用，網路拆到兩張 GPU 上，既塞得下也加快訓練。
8dc5d0f43a73.en: AlexNet was proposed by Krizhevsky under Hinton's supervision (with Sutskever as co-author). It won ILSVRC 2012 and is often seen as the starting point of the deep-learning explosion in vision. The architecture is shown in Fig. 12: eight layers, five convolutional layers followed by three fully connected layers, a skeleton clearly inherited from LeNet. At the time, a single card's roughly 3 GB of memory was not enough, so the network was split across two GPUs, which both made it fit and sped up training.

1fa8508d37b1.en: Size of each layer (per the original book):

66078fb42a4e.zh: 第 1 層：輸入 $224\times 224\times 3$，96 個核，尺寸 $11\times 11\times 3$，stride 4。

bbc6e3d80fcc.zh: 第 6、7 層：全連接，各 4096 個神經元。

29f034a41471.zh: 第 8 層：全連接輸出 1000 個神經元（一類一個）。
29f034a41471.en: Layer 8: fully connected output with 1000 neurons (one per class).

ce41792959ed.zh: 除了最後一層用 softmax 做 1000 類分類，其餘層用 ReLU，實務上加快收斂。全網路約 6000 萬 參數、65 萬個神經元。ILSVRC 2010 上 top-1／top-5 錯誤率分別為 37.5% 與 17.0%。
ce41792959ed.en: Except for the last layer, which uses softmax for 1000-class classification, all layers use ReLU, which speeds up convergence in practice. The whole network has about 60 million parameters and 650,000 neurons. On ILSVRC 2010 its top-1/top-5 error rates were 37.5% and 17.0%.

8dda5733af62.zh: 局部響應正規化（LRN）與重疊池化
8dda5733af62.en: Local response normalization (LRN) and overlapping pooling

2670d585b11f.zh: 第 1、2 層在 ReLU 之後做 局部響應正規化（local response normalization, LRN），有助泛化。令 $a_{x,y}^{i}$ 為核 $i$ 在位置 $(x,y)$ 的 ReLU 輸出，$N$ 為該層核數，正規化為（式 (7)）：
2670d585b11f.en: Layers 1 and 2 apply local response normalization (LRN) after the ReLU, which helps generalization. Let $a_{x,y}^{i}$ be the ReLU output of kernel $i$ at position $(x,y)$ and $N$ the number of kernels in the layer; the normalization is (Eq. (7)):

086f7cbfa610.zh: 求和範圍是同一空間位置上、鄰近的 $n$ 張特徵圖。交叉驗證得到的超參數：$k=2$，$n=5$，$\alpha=10^{-4}$，$\beta=0.75$。
086f7cbfa610.en: The sum runs over the $n$ neighboring feature maps at the same spatial position. Hyperparameters obtained by cross-validation: $k=2$, $n=5$, $\alpha=10^{-4}$, $\beta=0.75$.

eb9ac59bf1cd.zh: 第 1、2、5 層之後做 max pooling；第 1、2 層是 LRN 之後再池化。池化核寬 3、stride 2，因此是重疊池化（overlapping pooling）。
eb9ac59bf1cd.en: Max pooling is applied after layers 1, 2, and 5; in layers 1 and 2, pooling comes after LRN. The pooling kernel width is 3 with stride 2, so this is overlapping pooling.

444a7e89b6b7.zh: 對樣本 $\boldsymbol{x}_{i}$、目標類別 $\ell$，網路最大化第 $\ell$ 個 softmax 神經元的輸出機率；訓練改寫成最小化問題（式 (8)）：
444a7e89b6b7.en: For sample $\boldsymbol{x}_{i}$ with target class $\ell$, the network maximizes the output probability of the $\ell$-th softmax neuron; training is rewritten as a minimization problem (Eq. (8)):

e71948daa65b.zh: 其中 $o_{j}$ 是 softmax 前的第 $j$ 個輸出。箭號右邊把「最大化正確類機率」改成「最小化其負值」，以配合神經網路慣用的最小化訓練。
e71948daa65b.en: Here $o_{j}$ is the $j$-th output before the softmax. The right side of the arrow turns "maximize the probability of the correct class" into "minimize its negative," to match the minimization convention of neural-network training.

8862ecf47f35.zh: 口語復盤：ImageNet 約 15M／22k 類；ILSVRC 子集約 1.2M／1000 類／$224\times 224$。 AlexNet 八層（5 conv + 3 FC）、雙 GPU、ReLU、LRN 式 (7)、重疊池化 3／2、約 60M 參數，損失是 1000 類多項邏輯迴歸式 (8)。
8862ecf47f35.en: Quick recap: ImageNet is about 15M images / 22k classes; the ILSVRC subset is about 1.2M / 1000 classes / $224\times 224$. AlexNet has eight layers (5 conv + 3 FC), two GPUs, ReLU, LRN (Eq. (7)), overlapping pooling 3/2, about 60M parameters, and its loss is the 1000-class multinomial logistic regression of Eq. (8).

32d18f8aea70.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：三個小 3×3 換一個大 7×7
32d18f8aea70.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: three small 3×3s for one big 7×7

b32634a761eb.zh: VGG 在問什麼：深度到底有沒有用？
b32634a761eb.en: What VGG asks: does depth actually help?

f48092dee9ab.zh: VGG 出自牛津大學 Visual Geometry Group。它要回答的問題很直：把網路明顯加深，能不能學到更複雜、更有層次的特徵？層數一多，可學習參數也暴增，過擬合風險跟著來——VGG 的對策是用更大的訓練集，而不是先把模型砍瘦。
f48092dee9ab.en: VGG comes from the University of Oxford's Visual Geometry Group. The question it set out to answer is blunt: if you make the network significantly deeper, can it learn more complex, more hierarchical features? More layers means the number of learnable parameters explodes too, and the risk of overfitting comes along with it. VGG's answer was to use a larger training set, rather than first slimming the model down.

a95cc6b43ad9.zh: 可以把它想成「很多卷積層疊在一起的深 CNN」。設計哲學很執著：幾乎全程用很小的 $3 \times 3$ 卷積核。小核的好處是參數比較好控、比較不容易過擬合——對很深的網路特別重要。少數地方會插 $1 \times 1$ 核，用來對特徵做線性變換（通道混和），但主角仍是 $3 \times 3$。
a95cc6b43ad9.en: You can think of it as "a deep CNN made of many convolutional layers stacked together." Its design philosophy is stubborn: use very small $3 \times 3$ kernels almost everywhere. The advantage of small kernels is that the parameter count is easier to keep in check and overfitting is less likely, which matters especially for a very deep network. In a few places it inserts $1 \times 1$ kernels to apply a linear transformation to the features (mixing channels), but the star is still $3 \times 3$.

7bf5399f64da.zh: 前處理與「尺寸不縮」的卷積設定

0c892d41fafa.zh: 輸入是 $224 \times 224 \times 3$ 的影像，先把 RGB 各通道的均值減掉，讓資料零中心化。
0c892d41fafa.en: The input is a $224 \times 224 \times 3$ image; first the mean of each RGB channel is subtracted to make the data zero-centered.

a5fd4b0ae9ea.zh: 卷積的幾何設定幾乎固定：
a5fd4b0ae9ea.en: The convolution geometry is almost fixed:

03c94f6a2f2c.zh: $3 \times 3$ 卷積的 padding 為 1：剛好補回核掃過時少掉的一圈，空間尺寸維持不變。
03c94f6a2f2c.en: The padding of the $3 \times 3$ convolutions is 1: it exactly restores the ring lost as the kernel sweeps across, so the spatial size stays unchanged.

0e8131013b56.zh: 降解析度不靠卷積，而靠池化。
0e8131013b56.en: Resolution is reduced not by the convolutions but by pooling.

142c9bc8d2c5.en: Pooling, fully connected layers and activations

321247d9b4e7.zh: Max pooling 用寬度 2、步幅 2 的視窗——相鄰視窗不重疊，特徵圖長寬各砍半。依版本不同，VGG 的卷積層數通常比更早的架構深很多；卷積堆完之後接 三層全連接：
321247d9b4e7.en: Max pooling uses a window of width 2 with stride 2, so adjacent windows do not overlap and the feature map's height and width are each halved. Depending on the version, VGG usually has far more convolutional layers than earlier architectures; after the convolution stack come three fully connected layers:

1080fbbe3fbd.zh: 最後 1000 個神經元，對應 ILSVRC 的 1000 類
1080fbbe3fbd.en: finally 1000 neurons, one for each of ILSVRC's 1000 classes

5f5a0c56c7dc.zh: 隱藏層全部用 ReLU；輸出層用 softmax。
5f5a0c56c7dc.en: All hidden layers use ReLU; the output layer uses softmax.

d956effa1a7b.zh: 跟 AlexNet 一個關鍵差別：多數 VGG 版本不用局部響應正規化（LRN）。實驗上 LRN 在 ILSVRC 沒帶來幫助，所以乾脆拿掉。
d956effa1a7b.en: One key difference from AlexNet: most VGG versions do not use local response normalization (LRN). Experimentally, LRN brought no benefit on ILSVRC, so it was simply dropped.

1e5e477a45de.zh: 用 帶動量的 mini-batch SGD：batch size 256（2 的冪次，實務常見）、動量係數 0.9（動量夠大、又不太容易晃到失控）。正則化用 $\ell_2$ 權重衰減，係數 $5 \times 10^{-4}$（很小，避免蓋過主損失）。初始學習率 $10^{-2}$，驗證準確率平台期就把學習率 除以 10——太大不穩、太小又爬不動。
1e5e477a45de.en: It uses mini-batch SGD with momentum: batch size 256 (a power of 2, common in practice) and momentum coefficient 0.9 (enough momentum, without wobbling out of control too easily). Regularization is $\ell_2$ weight decay with coefficient $5 \times 10^{-4}$ (very small, so it doesn't drown out the main loss). The initial learning rate is $10^{-2}$, and whenever validation accuracy plateaus the learning rate is divided by 10: too large is unstable, too small can't make progress.

2cd6d5acb779.zh: 口語小結：VGG = 清一色 $3 \times 3$（stride 1、pad 1 保尺寸）+ 不重疊 $2\times 2$ max pool + 減 RGB 均值 + 三層 FC 4096-4096-1000 + ReLU；通常沒有 LRN。 用深度換感受野，不必一上來就上大核。
2cd6d5acb779.en: In plain words: VGG = all $3 \times 3$ (stride 1, pad 1 to keep the size) + non-overlapping $2\times 2$ max pool + subtract the RGB mean + three FC layers 4096-4096-1000 + ReLU; usually no LRN. Trade depth for receptive field instead of going for big kernels right away.

302d58ebf3b2.zh: 同一 7×7 感受野：一顆大核 49 個權重；三層 3×3 只要 27，還多兩次非線性
302d58ebf3b2.en: Same 7×7 receptive field: one big kernel has 49 weights; three 3×3 layers need only 27, plus two extra non-linearities

890a71d03e96.zh: 一次看完 7×7 · 參數 7×7 = 49（單通道）
890a71d03e96.en: Sees all 7×7 at once · params 7×7 = 49 (single channel)

627c0a35f7ff.zh: 權重 49 · 只有一次非線性

0800db80c561.zh: 每層 stride 1、pad 1 → 空間尺寸不變
0800db80c561.en: Each layer stride 1, pad 1 → spatial size unchanged

6425533136af.zh: 27 權重 · 中間多兩次 ReLU
6425533136af.en: 27 weights · two extra ReLUs in between

5e9229ebf39d.zh: VGG 配方：清一色 3×3（stride 1、pad 1 保尺寸）· 降解析度交給 2×2 stride 2 max pool
5e9229ebf39d.en: VGG recipe: all 3×3 (stride 1, pad 1 keeps size) · downsampling left to 2×2 stride 2 max pool

1873b406015b.zh: 末端 FC 4096-4096-1000 · 減 RGB 均值 · 多數版本不用 LRN（實驗上沒幫助）
1873b406015b.en: FC 4096-4096-1000 at the end · subtract RGB mean · most versions skip LRN (no help in experiments)

6c6b10b4004f.zh: 反直覺：感受野不夠大時，不必上 7×7——用深度換面積，參數更少、層次更多。
6c6b10b4004f.en: Counterintuitive: when the receptive field is too small, you don't need 7×7. Trade depth for area: fewer parameters, more levels.

8204ed226c62.zh: 過擬合風險用更大訓練集擋，而不是先把模型砍瘦
8204ed226c62.en: Fight overfitting with a larger training set, not by slimming the model first

78ea9cf4dd43.zh: VGG：清一色 3×3，用深度換感受野，不必上大核
78ea9cf4dd43.en: VGG: all 3×3, trading depth for receptive field instead of big kernels

be4ea0489cd4.zh: VGG 的 $3\times 3$ 卷積採用 stride 1、padding 1，主要效果是？
be4ea0489cd4.en: VGG's $3\times 3$ convolutions use stride 1 and padding 1. What is the main effect?

bc46dbdd82fc.en: The feature map's height and width are each halved

8962fe89ba96.en: It forces the use of LRN

828a9aebaeaf.en: It turns the input into a 1-D vector

b09ae2ec2751.zh: VGG 末端三層全連接的神經元數依序是？
b09ae2ec2751.en: What are the neuron counts of VGG's three final fully connected layers, in order?

6762995048b4.zh: 與 AlexNet 相比，多數 VGG 版本對 LRN（局部響應正規化）的態度是？
6762995048b4.en: Compared with AlexNet, what is the stance of most VGG versions on LRN (local response normalization)?

65773ab05d4e.en: LRN is required in every layer

7d714a6f294d.zh: 通常不使用，因實驗上在 ILSVRC 沒幫助
7d714a6f294d.en: Usually not used, since experiments showed no benefit on ILSVRC

284616369a1b.zh: 只用在輸出 softmax 之後
284616369a1b.en: Used only after the output softmax

af93bfdda8fd.zh: VGG 的 max pooling 設定為何？
af93bfdda8fd.en: What is VGG's max pooling setting?

b7ca1f551de9.zh: 只用 global average pooling、沒有 max pool
b7ca1f551de9.en: Only global average pooling, no max pool

9559220f1054.zh: Inception 與 GoogLeNet：多尺度與 1×1 降維
9559220f1054.en: Inception and GoogLeNet: multiple scales and 1×1 dimensionality reduction

052ab9662e3c.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：先 1×1 瘦身再做貴的 5×5
052ab9662e3c.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: slim down with 1×1 before the expensive 5×5

a0da9be29ea3.zh: 名字與競賽：GoogLeNet 從哪來
a0da9be29ea3.en: The name and the competition: where GoogLeNet comes from

4fe09dc73abf.zh: Inception 模組與用它堆出來的 GoogLeNet 出自同一篇工作。名字有雙關：團隊在 Google，同時向早期的 LeNet 致敬。GoogLeNet 拿下 ILSVRC 2014 第一名。
4fe09dc73abf.en: The Inception module and the GoogLeNet built by stacking it come from the same work. The name is a pun: the team was at Google, and it also pays tribute to the early LeNet. GoogLeNet won first place in ILSVRC 2014.

0f14d5ef21b9.zh: 要把網路容量做大，不外乎加深度（層數）或加寬度（每層神經元／通道），或兩者一起加。但參數一多就有兩個痛：
0f14d5ef21b9.en: To increase a network's capacity, you basically add depth (layers), add width (neurons/channels per layer), or both. But more parameters bring two pains:

c749e73770ed.zh: 過擬合：標註資料不夠時特別明顯。
c749e73770ed.en: Overfitting: especially visible when labeled data is scarce.

85d413b22fc2.zh: Inception 的解法是讓網路更稀疏——呼應「押注稀疏」（betting on sparsity）與奧卡姆剃刀：能用小結構表達的，就不要無謂地又寬又密。
85d413b22fc2.en: Inception's solution is to make the network sparser, echoing "betting on sparsity" and Occam's razor: whatever a small structure can express should not be made needlessly wide and dense.

5a35c4473b7a.en: The early module (Fig. 13): multiple scales in parallel

6a35f68ff474.zh: 每一層的神經元可以想成對應輸入影像的一塊局部區域。淺層裡，相關的神經元往往在空間上擠成團，這種局部團塊用 $1 \times 1$ 卷積就能有效處理（對特徵做線性變換）。空間相關範圍較廣時，才需要較大的核。
6a35f68ff474.en: Each neuron in a layer can be thought of as corresponding to a local region of the input image. In shallow layers, correlated neurons tend to cluster together spatially, and such local clusters can be handled effectively with $1 \times 1$ convolutions (a linear transformation of the features). Only when the spatial correlation spans a wider area are larger kernels needed.

7eab2adf1ce6.zh: 可是 $5 \times 5$ 這類大核又貴、參數又多。為了效率、減少冗餘，Inception 只允許小核：$1 \times 1$、$3 \times 3$、$5 \times 5$，再加一個 $3 \times 3$ max pooling（前面章節已經講過 pooling 的好處）。Fig. 13 就是這個「幾條路並列、最後接在一起」的早期設計。
7eab2adf1ce6.en: But large kernels such as $5 \times 5$ are expensive and have many parameters. For efficiency and to reduce redundancy, Inception allows only small kernels: $1 \times 1$, $3 \times 3$, $5 \times 5$, plus a $3 \times 3$ max pooling (the benefits of pooling were covered in earlier sections). Fig. 13 is this early design of "several paths in parallel, joined together at the end."

a2d2b796bf26.zh: GoogLeNet 把 Inception 模組一層層疊起來。各層裡 $1 \times 1$、$3 \times 3$、$5 \times 5$ 的比例不固定：愈靠近輸出、特徵愈抽象，需要更大的感受野，因此較深層會配比較多的 $3 \times 3$ 與 $5 \times 5$。
a2d2b796bf26.en: GoogLeNet stacks Inception modules layer upon layer. The proportions of $1 \times 1$, $3 \times 3$ and $5 \times 5$ are not fixed across layers: the closer to the output, the more abstract the features and the larger the receptive field they need, so deeper layers get more $3 \times 3$ and $5 \times 5$.

c1d33ccf95dc.zh: 最終模組（Fig. 14）：1×1 先降維再做貴的卷積
c1d33ccf95dc.en: The final module (Fig. 14): reduce dimensions with 1×1 before the expensive convolutions

985924ccdda7.zh: 大核若一路往深堆，計算量會炸。最終版 Inception 因此加入 $1 \times 1$ 降維（dimensionality reduction），位置很關鍵（Fig. 14）：
985924ccdda7.en: If large kernels keep being stacked deeper, the computation blows up. The final version of Inception therefore adds $1 \times 1$ dimensionality reduction, and where it goes is crucial (Fig. 14):

9da2a8a4c662.zh: 做昂貴的 $3 \times 3$、 $5 \times 5$ 之前，先用 $1 \times 1$ 把通道壓瘦。
9da2a8a4c662.en: Before the expensive $3 \times 3$ and $5 \times 5$, a $1 \times 1$ first squeezes the channels down.

6bcd5ef85f04.zh: max pooling 之後也接 $1 \times 1$，避免 pooling 把通道數堆太胖。
6bcd5ef85f04.en: After max pooling there is also a $1 \times 1$, so pooling doesn't pile up too many channels.

065b99698e6a.zh: 白話：多尺度還是要，但先用便宜的 $1 \times 1$ 減肥，再讓較大的核上場。
065b99698e6a.en: In plain words: you still want multiple scales, but first slim down with the cheap $1 \times 1$, then let the larger kernels take the stage.

1df86b249220.en: The whole network (Fig. 15): stacking, ReLU, zero-centered input

bab1216c97ea.zh: Fig. 15 是 GoogLeNet 全貌。前處理與 VGG 同類：從 $224 \times 224 \times 3$ 影像減去 RGB 均值，做零中心。骨幹就是堆疊的 Inception 模組。所有卷積（含模組內部）都用 ReLU。
bab1216c97ea.en: Fig. 15 is the full picture of GoogLeNet. The preprocessing is the same kind as VGG's: subtract the RGB mean from the $224 \times 224 \times 3$ image to zero-center it. The backbone is stacked Inception modules. All convolutions (including those inside the modules) use ReLU.

fb4e8e1d523a.zh: 口語復盤：早期 Inception（Fig. 13）是 1×1／3×3／5×5／pool 並列；最終版（Fig. 14）在 3×3、5×5 前以及 pooling 後加 1×1。GoogLeNet（Fig. 15）把模組疊起來，ReLU，224 輸入先減均值。
fb4e8e1d523a.en: Quick recap in plain words: the early Inception (Fig. 13) runs 1×1/3×3/5×5/pool in parallel; the final version (Fig. 14) adds 1×1 before the 3×3 and 5×5 and after pooling. GoogLeNet (Fig. 15) stacks the modules, uses ReLU, and subtracts the mean from the 224 input first.

4397c51e3075.zh: 圖 13 Inception 模組初期設計
4397c51e3075.en: Fig. 13 Early design of the Inception module

f26f50740fab.zh: 圖 14 Inception 模組最終設計（含 1×1 降維）
f26f50740fab.en: Fig. 14 Final design of the Inception module (with 1×1 dimensionality reduction)

d26f56678ea5.zh: Inception：多尺度仍要，但 5×5 太貴——先用 1×1 把通道減肥再做大核
d26f56678ea5.en: Inception: still multi-scale, but 5×5 is too expensive, so slim the channels with 1×1 before the big kernel

946e061d39df.zh: 通道還很胖時，大核每個位置都做一次厚乘法
946e061d39df.en: With channels still fat, the big kernel does a thick multiply at every position

c12ace402871.zh: 深層還想要更大感受野 → 5×5 比例更高 → 更貴
c12ace402871.en: Deeper layers want larger RF → more 5×5 → more expensive

99158cb87810.zh: 早期模組：1×1／3×3／5×5／pool 並列，尚未減肥
99158cb87810.en: Early module: 1×1/3×3/5×5/pool in parallel, not yet slimmed

999f419ddc64.zh: 最終 Inception：貴核之前先降維
999f419ddc64.en: Final Inception: reduce dimensions before the expensive kernels

0947460ec02e.zh: 1×1 也接在 pooling 之後，避免通道被堆太胖
0947460ec02e.en: 1×1 also follows pooling, so channels don't pile up

6fbde6282465.zh: 1×1＝通道方向的線性變換（減肥＋混和）

a763042acfcb.zh: GoogLeNet＝堆疊 Inception（名字向 LeNet 致敬）· ILSVRC 2014 冠軍
a763042acfcb.en: GoogLeNet = stacked Inception (name honors LeNet) · ILSVRC 2014 winner

a5f5b088ee79.zh: 輸入 224×224×3 先減 RGB 均值；模組內卷積皆 ReLU；愈深愈多 3×3／5×5（抽象特徵要大感受野）
a5f5b088ee79.en: Input 224×224×3 minus RGB mean; all module convs use ReLU; deeper = more 3×3/5×5 (abstract features need large RF)

15b49aa9894f.zh: 反直覺：加寬加深深怕過擬合與算爆——用 1×1 讓網路「看起來寬、算起來瘦」。
15b49aa9894f.en: Counterintuitive: wider and deeper risks overfitting and blown compute; 1×1 makes the net "look wide, compute slim."

50292fb9b4b5.zh: Inception：多尺度並列，1×1 先降維再做貴的 3×3／5×5
50292fb9b4b5.en: Inception: multiple scales in parallel, 1×1 reduction before the expensive 3×3/5×5

358703e8e20a.zh: 最終版 Inception 模組（Fig. 14）相對早期設計（Fig. 13）多了什麼？
358703e8e20a.en: What does the final Inception module (Fig. 14) add compared with the early design (Fig. 13)?

c2ee62757bf0.zh: 在 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 之前以及 pooling 之後加入 $1\times 1$ 降維
c2ee62757bf0.en: $1\times 1$ dimensionality reduction is added before the $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ and after pooling

38956921ff50.en: Fully connected layers replace the convolutions

7e2ec8860a9f.zh: Inception 用 $1\times 1$ 卷積的主要動機是？
7e2ec8860a9f.en: What is the main motivation for Inception's $1\times 1$ convolutions?

114e769c6801.zh: 線性變換特徵，並在大核之前／pooling 之後做降維以降低計算量
114e769c6801.en: Linearly transforming features, and reducing dimensions before the large kernels / after pooling to lower the computation

d6d4d00e14ea.zh: 關於 GoogLeNet（Fig. 15）下列何者正確？
d6d4d00e14ea.en: Which of the following about GoogLeNet (Fig. 15) is correct?

0e95e9d0dec3.zh: 輸入 $224\times 224\times 3$ 先減 RGB 均值；以堆疊 Inception 為骨幹；卷積用 ReLU
0e95e9d0dec3.en: The $224\times 224\times 3$ input has the RGB mean subtracted first; the backbone is stacked Inception modules; convolutions use ReLU

3ea87ef6dccb.zh: 全程不用 ReLU、改用 LRN
3ea87ef6dccb.en: It never uses ReLU, using LRN instead

106d20f53a8d.zh: 只有一層 Inception、其餘全是全連接
106d20f53a8d.en: There is only one Inception layer; the rest are all fully connected

fd9ad2bd902b.zh: 為什麼較深、靠近輸出的 Inception 層會配置較多 $3\times 3$ 與 $5\times 5$？
fd9ad2bd902b.en: Why do the deeper Inception layers, close to the output, get more $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$?

c5c89fc24651.zh: 因為那些層需要更大的感受野來處理更抽象的特徵
c5c89fc24651.en: Because those layers need a larger receptive field to handle more abstract features

2e8aed51834a.en: Because only shallow layers need large kernels

75451b2926fa.zh: 因為 $1\times 1$ 在深層被禁止
75451b2926fa.en: Because $1\times 1$ is forbidden in deep layers

55d81443ae43.zh: 因為 max pooling 只能接在輸出層
55d81443ae43.en: Because max pooling can only follow the output layer

69581d38738d.zh: U-Net：收縮–擴張路徑與醫學分割
69581d38738d.en: U-Net: contracting–expansive paths and medical segmentation

efd774fab567.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：U 型醫院——左邊診斷、右邊重建，跳接把細節接回
efd774fab567.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: the U-shaped hospital — diagnose on the left, rebuild on the right, skip connections bring the details back

8be103c5a4be.zh: 為什麼叫 U-Net：左邊收縮、右邊擴張
8be103c5a4be.en: Why it is called U-Net: contracting on the left, expanding on the right

65382ccbc74d.zh: U-Net 出自生醫影像分割，是 ISBI 電子顯微鏡神經結構分割挑戰的優勝架構。名字來自對稱的 U 形（Fig. 16）：
65382ccbc74d.en: U-Net comes from biomedical image segmentation; it was the winning architecture of the ISBI challenge on segmenting neuronal structures in electron microscopy images. The name comes from its symmetric U shape (Fig. 16):

19c74a209151.zh: 收縮路徑（contracting path，U 的左邊）：抓語境／上下文（這塊大概是什麼組織）。
19c74a209151.en: Contracting path (the left side of the U): captures context (roughly what kind of tissue this patch is).

588c9b35a532.zh: 擴張路徑（expansive path，U 的右邊）：做精準定位（邊界到底在哪一個像素）。
588c9b35a532.en: Expansive path (the right side of the U): does precise localization (exactly which pixel the boundary is on).

9c5569375094.zh: 分割任務兩個都要：只知道「大概是細胞」卻對不齊邊緣，或邊緣很銳但看不懂語境，都不夠。
9c5569375094.en: A segmentation task needs both: knowing only that "it's probably a cell" but failing to line up the edges, or having very sharp edges but not understanding the context, is not enough either way.

1a09d0c697c2.zh: 收縮路徑：兩次 3×3 + ReLU，再 2×2 下採樣
1a09d0c697c2.en: Contracting path: two 3×3 + ReLU, then 2×2 downsampling

039258c1aaf2.zh: 收縮路徑走「典型 CNN」節奏。每一步：
039258c1aaf2.en: The contracting path follows the rhythm of a "typical CNN". At each step:

c92494e42aae.zh: 連續兩次 $3 \times 3$ 卷積，每次後面接 ReLU。
c92494e42aae.en: Two $3 \times 3$ convolutions in a row, each followed by a ReLU.

5c8e845dd872.zh: 用 stride 2 的 $2 \times 2$ max pooling 下採樣。
5c8e845dd872.en: Downsample with a $2 \times 2$ max pooling with stride 2.

743a30f2b1ae.zh: 每下採樣一次，特徵通道數加倍，把容量補回來。
743a30f2b1ae.en: At each downsampling, the number of feature channels doubles, to make up for the lost capacity.

311a7a6e6341.zh: 擴張路徑：2×2 反卷積，再跳接＋裁切
311a7a6e6341.en: Expansive path: 2×2 deconvolution, then skip connection + cropping

589c32cda60e.zh: 右邊幾乎是左邊的鏡子。每一步同樣兩次 $3 \times 3$ + ReLU，但不用 pooling，改用 $2 \times 2$ 反卷積（deconvolution）——也叫 轉置卷積（transpose convolution） 或 up-convolution。Fig. 17 就是在示範這種「把特徵圖放大」的運算。每上採樣一次，通道數減半。
589c32cda60e.en: The right side is almost a mirror of the left. Each step likewise has two $3 \times 3$ + ReLU, but it does not use pooling; instead it uses a $2 \times 2$ deconvolution, also called a transposed convolution or up-convolution. Fig. 17 demonstrates exactly this kind of "enlarge the feature map" operation. At each upsampling, the number of channels is halved.

d30673285422.zh: 上採樣之後，把得到的特徵圖與收縮路徑對應層的特徵圖串接（concatenate）。原始 U-Net 用的是不補邊（unpadded）卷積，每做一次 $3 \times 3$ 空間尺寸會縮小，兩邊對不齊，所以跳接前要先 crop。現代實作也可以改用 padding，讓尺寸從頭對齊、少做裁切。
d30673285422.en: After upsampling, the resulting feature map is concatenated with the feature map from the corresponding layer of the contracting path. The original U-Net uses unpadded convolutions: each $3 \times 3$ shrinks the spatial size, so the two sides don't line up, and the feature map must be cropped before the skip connection. Modern implementations can use padding instead, so the sizes line up from the start and less cropping is needed.

8e7f805044eb.zh: 最後輸出與輸入空間尺寸相同；最後一張特徵圖有 $c$ 個通道（一類一通道），接 softmax。損失是 cross-entropy，因為這是逐像素分類。原作在 Caffe 上訓練；生醫圖塊很大，batch size 設為 1。動量與 VGG 相同，取 0.9，讓收斂穩一點、少震盪。
8e7f805044eb.en: The final output has the same spatial size as the input; the last feature map has $c$ channels (one channel per class), followed by a softmax. The loss is cross-entropy, because this is per-pixel classification. The original work was trained in Caffe; biomedical image tiles are large, so the batch size was set to 1. The momentum is the same as VGG's, 0.9, to make convergence a bit steadier with less oscillation.

c603e7630de1.zh: U-Net 還帶出後繼者，例如把 U 改成 Y 形的 Y-Net。
c603e7630de1.en: U-Net also led to successors, such as Y-Net, which turns the U into a Y shape.

acc6ba13375e.zh: 口語小結：左收縮（語境）＋右擴張（定位）＝ U；跳接是 concat，原始版因 unpadded conv 要 crop；$3 \times 3$+ReLU 成對出現；放大靠 $2 \times 2$ 轉置卷積（Fig. 17）；戰場是醫學分割。
acc6ba13375e.en: Plain-words summary: contracting on the left (context) + expanding on the right (localization) = U; the skip connection is a concat, and the original version needs a crop because of unpadded conv; $3 \times 3$+ReLU comes in pairs; enlarging is done by a $2 \times 2$ transposed convolution (Fig. 17); the battlefield is medical segmentation.

b0b5ca3faa7a.zh: 圖 17 反卷積／轉置卷積例子
b0b5ca3faa7a.en: Figure 17 An example of deconvolution / transposed convolution

fed9babf5c3f.zh: U-Net：左邊收縮抓語境，右邊擴張還原位置；跳接把細節 concat 回來
fed9babf5c3f.en: U-Net: the left contracts for context, the right expands to restore position; skips concat the details back

3a73c1c9f011.zh: 跳接：左邊的空間細節接到右邊
3a73c1c9f011.en: Skip: spatial detail from the left joins the right

ee8abf1f3397.zh: 原始 unpadded 3×3 會縮邊 → 跳接前要 crop

bf57ea149a47.zh: 分割要兩樣：知道「大概是什麼組織」＋對齊「邊界在哪一像素」
bf57ea149a47.en: Segmentation needs both: know "roughly what tissue" + align "which pixel the boundary is on"

bc1ad9eab813.zh: 每步：兩次 3×3+ReLU；下採樣通道加倍、上採樣通道減半；輸出與輸入同空間尺寸、c 類 softmax
bc1ad9eab813.en: Each step: two 3×3+ReLU; downsampling doubles channels, upsampling halves them; output has the input's spatial size, c-class softmax

b1f50e38269b.zh: 反直覺：深網把圖縮得很小會丟邊界——U 形不是為了好看，是把細節從左邊借回來。
b1f50e38269b.en: Counterintuitive: shrinking the image a lot in a deep net loses boundaries — the U shape isn't for looks, it borrows details back from the left.

28c3dea2205a.zh: 生醫分割出身 · 損失 cross-entropy · 原作 batch size 1 · 動量 0.9
28c3dea2205a.en: Born in biomedical segmentation · cross-entropy loss · original batch size 1 · momentum 0.9

f1789e35dc89.zh: U-Net：收縮抓語境、擴張還原位置，跳接把細節接回來
f1789e35dc89.en: U-Net: contracting captures context, expanding restores position, skip connections bring the details back

807921b91fa7.zh: U-Net 收縮路徑與擴張路徑的分工是？
807921b91fa7.en: How are the roles divided between U-Net's contracting path and expansive path?

e770ef9aed8a.zh: 兩者都只做分類、不做定位
e770ef9aed8a.en: Both only do classification, not localization

0cd0303119cf.zh: 收縮路徑抓上下文，擴張路徑做精準定位
0cd0303119cf.en: The contracting path captures context; the expansive path does precise localization

b6a1c7b2aed8.zh: 收縮路徑只做全連接，擴張路徑只做 LRN
b6a1c7b2aed8.en: The contracting path only does fully connected layers; the expansive path only does LRN

05e615d18af2.zh: 兩者功能完全相同、只是畫成 U 形好看
05e615d18af2.en: Both have exactly the same function; it's just drawn as a U because it looks nice

30aae7ec6f1e.zh: 原始 U-Net 在 skip connection 時要先 crop，原因是？
30aae7ec6f1e.en: Why does the original U-Net need to crop first at the skip connection?

b51ee5a5f079.zh: 因為用了 unpadded 卷積，特徵圖逐步縮小，兩邊尺寸對不齊
b51ee5a5f079.en: Because it uses unpadded convolutions, the feature maps gradually shrink and the sizes of the two sides don't line up

614a23c2dae9.zh: 因為 softmax 會改變空間大小
614a23c2dae9.en: Because softmax changes the spatial size

a195aeb52f0d.zh: 因為 max pooling 的 stride 必須是 3
a195aeb52f0d.en: Because the stride of max pooling must be 3

5e211b1d430f.zh: 因為輸出通道數必須是 1000
5e211b1d430f.en: Because the number of output channels must be 1000

aae676a150b9.en: What operation does U-Net's expansive path use to enlarge the feature maps? (See Fig. 17)

6c9d8d776880.zh: 再做一次 stride 2 的 max pooling
