11b84f4d2b85.en: Use only $1\times 1$ convolutions to raise the spatial resolution

c6026fcb59d2.zh: U-Net 最初主要應用與輸出形式是？
c6026fcb59d2.en: What was U-Net's original main application and output format?

cd9211111363.zh: 手寫數字 10 類分類，輸出 10 維向量
cd9211111363.en: 10-class handwritten digit classification, outputting a 10-dimensional vector

16e3a4268b82.zh: 生醫影像分割；輸出與輸入同空間尺寸、$c$ 個類別通道 + softmax + cross-entropy
16e3a4268b82.en: Biomedical image segmentation; the output has the same spatial size as the input, $c$ class channels + softmax + cross-entropy

f124a3e98165.zh: 只做超解析度、沒有類別通道
f124a3e98165.en: Only super-resolution, with no class channels

9da2259cf59c.zh: ResNet、DenseNet 到結論：殘差、密集連接與複合縮放
9da2259cf59c.en: From ResNet and DenseNet to the conclusion: residuals, dense connections, and compound scaling

ef6ebc658768.zh: 退化問題：層數超過約 20 層，訓練準確率不升反降
ef6ebc658768.en: The degradation problem: beyond about 20 layers, training accuracy goes down instead of up

e5f2354232ea.zh: 經驗上，網路大概 超過 20 層 之後，再加深往往讓訓練準確率先飽和、再變差。這叫 degradation（退化），直覺上很怪：理論上更深的網路至少不該比淺的差——多出來的層大可學成恆等映射，表現應能「複製」淺模型。實務上多加層卻常常把訓練誤差加高。Fig. 19 把 ResNet 與「純 CNN／VGG 式直筒」對照，就是在講這條路後來怎麼被改寫。
e5f2354232ea.en: Empirically, once a network goes beyond about 20 layers, making it deeper often makes training accuracy saturate first and then get worse. This is called degradation, and intuitively it is strange: in theory a deeper network should be at least as good as a shallow one — the extra layers could simply learn the identity mapping, so its performance should be able to "copy" the shallow model. In practice, adding more layers often increases the training error. Fig. 19 contrasts ResNet with a "plain CNN / VGG-style straight stack", which is exactly about how this road was later rewritten.

26a1b7bc397b.zh: ResNet 提出 deep residual learning。一般堆疊層被期待直接學目標映射 $\mathcal{H}(x)$；ResNet 改讓一組層去學相對輸入的殘差。令 $\mathcal{H}(x)$ 為想要的底層映射，改學
26a1b7bc397b.en: ResNet introduced deep residual learning. A stack of ordinary layers is expected to learn the target mapping $\mathcal{H}(x)$ directly; ResNet instead has a group of layers learn the residual relative to the input. Let $\mathcal{H}(x)$ be the desired underlying mapping; instead we learn

3800f7782147.zh: 實作就是 Fig. 18 的 residual block：主路學 $\mathcal{F}$，旁路 shortcut（恆等捷徑） 把 $x$ 加回來。整網由多個殘差塊堆成。
3800f7782147.en: In practice this is the residual block of Fig. 18: the main path learns $\mathcal{F}$, and a side path, the identity shortcut, adds $x$ back. The whole network is built by stacking many residual blocks.

322b820a1b2f.zh: 捷徑的關鍵好處是反向傳播時梯度比較走得通：恆等路讓梯度能較直接從深層回到淺層，減輕梯度消失。經驗上也顯示：優化殘差 $\mathcal{F}(x)$ 比直接優化沒有參考點的 $\mathcal{H}(x)$ 容易。常見變體依層數命名：ResNet-18／34／50／101；筆電級任務往往 ResNet-18 就夠。當代很多研究不再天天發明新骨幹，而是假設 ResNet（或 LeNet 這類標準 CNN）當 backbone，把力氣放在新損失。
322b820a1b2f.en: The key benefit of the shortcut is that gradients get through more easily during backpropagation: the identity path lets gradients return more directly from deep layers to shallow ones, easing vanishing gradients. Experiments also show that optimizing the residual $\mathcal{F}(x)$ is easier than directly optimizing $\mathcal{H}(x)$, which has no reference point. Common variants are named by their depth: ResNet-18/34/50/101; for laptop-scale tasks ResNet-18 is often enough. Much current research no longer invents new backbones every day; instead it assumes ResNet (or a standard CNN such as LeNet) as the backbone and puts its effort into new losses.

7f2d945729c6.en: DenseNet: switch to concatenation, with $l(l+1)/2$ connections

e46a9db5d01a.zh: CNN 若在較早層與較後層之間加短接，往往能更深、更準、更好訓。DenseNet 把這件事做滿：在 dense block 裡，每一層以 feedforward 方式接到後面所有層（Fig. 20）。可以看成 ResNet shortcut 的極端版：ResNet 主要連「下一層並做加法」；DenseNet 連「後面每一層，並做串接」。
e46a9db5d01a.en: If a CNN adds short connections between earlier and later layers, it can often be deeper, more accurate, and easier to train. DenseNet takes this all the way: within a dense block, each layer is connected in a feedforward fashion to all the layers after it (Fig. 20). You can see it as the extreme version of ResNet's shortcut: ResNet mainly connects "to the next layer, by addition"; DenseNet connects "to every later layer, by concatenation".

e6f33770bb0e.zh: 標準 $l$ 層網路大約有 $l$ 個權重矩陣（只連相鄰層）。DenseNet 的 $l$ 層則有
e6f33770bb0e.en: A standard $l$-layer network has about $l$ weight matrices (connecting only adjacent layers). An $l$-layer DenseNet instead has

02c14c91d8ac.zh: 個權重矩陣——每一層都直接連到它的所有後繼。好處包括：捷徑多、梯度更好流；特徵重複使用；層數不必很多就能保持表達力，參數反而可能較省。
02c14c91d8ac.en: weight matrices — every layer connects directly to all of its successors. The benefits include: many shortcuts, so gradients flow better; features are reused; the network stays expressive without needing many layers, and may even use fewer parameters.

96dd2674b23d.zh: ResNet 的遞推是加法（式 (11)），DenseNet 改成把前面所有輸出 concat 再送進 $\mathcal{F}_{\ell}$（式 (12)）：
96dd2674b23d.en: ResNet's recursion is an addition (Eq. (11)); DenseNet instead concats all the previous outputs and feeds them into $\mathcal{F}_{\ell}$ (Eq. (12)):

5c51a0bc9511.zh: $\mathcal{F}_{\ell}$ 在塊內通常是 batch norm + $3 \times 3$ 卷積 + ReLU（也可能含 pooling）。每層卷積產出的特徵圖數量叫 growth rate $k$。若塊的輸入通道是 $k_0$，則第 $\ell$ 層會看到 $k_0+k(\ell-1)$ 張輸入特徵圖。經驗上 $k=12$ 這類不大的成長率就常常夠用。
5c51a0bc9511.en: Inside a block, $\mathcal{F}_{\ell}$ is usually batch norm + $3 \times 3$ convolution + ReLU (possibly also with pooling). The number of feature maps each convolutional layer produces is called the growth rate $k$. If the block's input has $k_0$ channels, then layer $\ell$ sees $k_0+k(\ell-1)$ input feature maps. Empirically, a modest growth rate such as $k=12$ is often enough.

b64e3892befe.zh: Fig. 21：多個 dense block 串起來；塊與塊之間用 transition layer 控複雜度——batch norm、$1 \times 1$ 卷積、再 $2 \times 2$ average pooling。最後一段 transition 含平均池化與全連接 + softmax 做分類。
b64e3892befe.en: Fig. 21: several dense blocks chained together; between blocks, a transition layer controls the complexity — batch norm, a $1 \times 1$ convolution, then $2 \times 2$ average pooling. The final transition contains average pooling and a fully connected layer + softmax for classification.

b7bf76962664.zh: EfficientNet 與 ConvNeXt：縮放方式，以及 CNN 對上 Transformer
b7bf76962664.en: EfficientNet and ConvNeXt: how to scale, and CNNs versus Transformers

d4fcfc6005c9.zh: DenseNet 之後，EfficientNet（2019）提出對深度、寬度、解析度一起做複合縮放（compound scaling），用較少參數衝到當時很強的精度。ConvNeXt（2022）則把 CNN 設計現代化，好跟 Transformer（見 Chap. 9）競爭——重點是：進入注意力模型的時代，CNN 並沒有過氣。
d4fcfc6005c9.en: After DenseNet, EfficientNet (2019) proposed compound scaling of depth, width, and resolution together, reaching what was then very high accuracy with fewer parameters. ConvNeXt (2022) modernized CNN design to compete with the Transformer (see Chap. 9) — the point being: in the era of attention models, CNNs have not gone out of style.

0d21f3d8e390.zh: 本章結論：積木是 conv＋detector＋pool，再看經典架構怎麼疊
0d21f3d8e390.en: Chapter conclusion: the building blocks are conv + detector + pool; then see how the classic architectures stack them

d404be06c191.zh: 回到整章主線：CNN 專攻網格資料（影像），用卷積 → 偵測器（激活）→ 池化當一層的三階段，而不是把圖攤平成全連接。從 LeNet、AlexNet 往後，VGG、Inception、ResNet、DenseNet 分別在深度、效率、特徵重用上加碼。Transformer 在很多領域已成主流，但 CNN 在電腦視覺、醫學影像、邊緣裝置上仍很關鍵，也是讀懂現代深度學習的地基。
d404be06c191.en: Back to the chapter's main thread: CNNs specialize in grid data (images), using convolution → detector (activation) → pooling as the three stages of a layer, instead of flattening the image into a fully connected network. From LeNet and AlexNet onward, VGG, Inception, ResNet, and DenseNet each raised the stakes in depth, efficiency, and feature reuse. Transformers have become mainstream in many fields, but CNNs remain crucial in computer vision, medical imaging, and edge devices, and they are also the foundation for understanding modern deep learning.

4b1584948a6b.zh: 口語復盤：超過約 20 層會退化；ResNet 學殘差 $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$（式 (9)(10)），捷徑幫忙傳梯度；DenseNet 改 concat（式 (11) vs (12)），連線 $l(l+1)/2$，成長率 $k$，transition 用 1×1＋avg pool；EfficientNet 複合縮放，ConvNeXt 讓 CNN 跟 Transformer 打；積木仍是 conv＋detector＋pool。
4b1584948a6b.en: Plain-words recap: beyond about 20 layers you get degradation; ResNet learns the residual $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$ (Eqs. (9)(10)), and the shortcut helps pass gradients; DenseNet switches to concat (Eq. (11) vs (12)), with $l(l+1)/2$ connections, growth rate $k$, and transitions using 1×1 + avg pool; EfficientNet does compound scaling, ConvNeXt lets CNNs fight Transformers; the building blocks are still conv + detector + pool.

9ac63e73540c.en: Figure 19 ResNet vs a plain CNN / VGG

4bb86ee99e69.en: Figure 21 The DenseNet architecture with dense blocks

0e429a747f73.en: Learn H(x) directly · no reference point

af3fad4df1d3.en: Training error rises instead of falling, from ≈20 layers

63ee047b2f7a.en: Extra layers can learn a zero residual

2cdb10e17cc3.en: Optimizing F is easier than optimizing H directly

90841c6f3315.zh: 成長率 k：每層長出 k 張圖
90841c6f3315.en: Growth rate k: each layer adds k maps

cf08d1961871.zh: 第 ℓ 層看見 k0+k(ℓ−1) 張

5fcdd4112b1c.zh: 對照一句：ResNet 把 x 加回去；DenseNet 把歷史特徵疊成更厚的通道
5fcdd4112b1c.en: In one line: ResNet adds x back; DenseNet stacks past features into thicker channels

0d2791236246.zh: 更深理論上可學恆等、不該更差——實務直筒卻退化；捷徑讓「多出來的層」有一條不傷害淺模型的路
0d2791236246.en: Deeper could in theory learn identity and shouldn't be worse — yet plain stacks degrade; shortcuts give the "extra layers" a path that doesn't hurt the shallow model

6bc1e45ff899.zh: 之後 EfficientNet 對深／寬／解析度做複合縮放；ConvNeXt 讓 CNN 跟 Transformer 打 —— CNN 沒過氣
6bc1e45ff899.en: Later, EfficientNet compound-scales depth/width/resolution; ConvNeXt lets CNNs fight Transformers — CNNs aren't outdated

e77b09244899.zh: 反直覺：不是層數愈多愈好；沒有捷徑時，多出來的層常常學不會恆等，訓練誤差先飽和再變差。
e77b09244899.en: Counterintuitive: more layers isn't always better; without shortcuts, extra layers often fail to learn identity, and training error saturates, then worsens.

b6621db39cd0.zh: 積木仍是 conv → detector → pool；架構差在怎麼接、怎麼重用特徵
b6621db39cd0.en: Building blocks are still conv → detector → pool; architectures differ in how they connect and reuse features

682e0fd85782.zh: ResNet 學殘差 F(x)+x；DenseNet 則把前面全部串接起來
682e0fd85782.en: ResNet learns the residual F(x)+x; DenseNet instead concatenates everything before it

3d80781e5a96.zh: 原理：ResNet 不直接學目標映射 $\mathcal{H}(x)$，改學殘差 $\mathcal{F}(x):=\mathcal{H}(x)-x$（式 (9)），因此 $\mathcal{H}(x)=\mathcal{F}(x)+x$（式 (10)）。旁路是恆等捷徑：把 $x$ 原樣加回來。 若 $\mathcal{F}=0$，則 $\mathcal{H}=x$，多出來的層退化成恆等——這正是「加深不該比淺的差」的數學出口。
3d80781e5a96.en: Principle: ResNet does not learn the target mapping $\mathcal{H}(x)$ directly; it learns the residual $\mathcal{F}(x):=\mathcal{H}(x)-x$ (Eq. (9)) instead, therefore $\mathcal{H}(x)=\mathcal{F}(x)+x$ (Eq. (10)). The side path is an identity shortcut: it adds $x$ back unchanged. If $\mathcal{F}=0$, then $\mathcal{H}=x$, and the extra layers reduce to the identity — this is exactly the mathematical way out of "going deeper shouldn't be worse than shallow".

3777749d72aa.zh: 這在做什麼：把殘差塊收成一個可對帳的加法 $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$。 怎麼操作：
3777749d72aa.en: What this does: reduces the residual block to an addition you can check, $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$. How to use it:

4d61a0f0d297.zh: 拉 $x$、$\mathcal{F}$（皆 $[-2,2]$），數線與堆疊段即時更新。
4d61a0f0d297.en: Drag $x$ and $\mathcal{F}$ (both in $[-2,2]$); the number line and the stacked segments update live.

8f9a8d58da98.zh: 按「F＝0」看捷徑單獨成立；$\mathcal{H}$ 必須與 $x$ 重合。
8f9a8d58da98.en: Press "F = 0" to see the shortcut on its own; $\mathcal{H}$ must coincide with $x$.

a20d925e11ac.zh: 觀察什麼：藍段是捷徑 $x$；橙段從 $x$ 再走 $\mathcal{F}$ 到達綠點 $\mathcal{H}$。 正確基準：任何時刻 $\mathcal{H}$ 必須等於 $\mathcal{F}+x$（閉式加法，不准近似）；$\mathcal{F}=0$ 時 $\mathcal{H}=x$。
a20d925e11ac.en: What to watch: the blue segment is the shortcut $x$; the orange segment goes on from $x$ by $\mathcal{F}$ to reach the green point $\mathcal{H}$. Correct baseline: at every moment $\mathcal{H}$ must equal $\mathcal{F}+x$ (exact closed-form addition, no approximation); when $\mathcal{F}=0$, $\mathcal{H}=x$.

57e907f493f4.zh: 祕笈教授祕笈：殘差學「還差多少」；DenseNet 把以前全部貼上
57e907f493f4.en: NotesProfessor's Secret Notes: residuals learn "how much is still missing"; DenseNet pastes in everything from before

972ac75b7fa7.en: What does the "degradation problem" refer to?

fa532f0d9170.zh: 只要超過 3 層就一定無法訓練
fa532f0d9170.en: Any network with more than 3 layers definitely cannot be trained

6c9a89ab7a43.zh: 大約超過 20 層後，再加深可能使訓練準確率飽和甚至下降
6c9a89ab7a43.en: Beyond about 20 layers, going deeper can make training accuracy saturate or even drop

80d4f3d5c85d.zh: pooling 會讓所有梯度變為零

c98b72500a5b.zh: 只有 U-Net 會發生、分類網路不會
c98b72500a5b.en: It only happens in U-Net, not in classification networks

1221c9461c08.zh: 殘差學習式 (9)(10) 的含義是？
1221c9461c08.en: What do the residual learning equations (9)(10) mean?

952572a44b1f.zh: 層去學 $\mathcal{F}(x):=\mathcal{H}(x)-x$，因此目標映射寫成 $\mathcal{H}(x)=\mathcal{F}(x)+x$（shortcut 把 $x$ 加回）
952572a44b1f.en: The layers learn $\mathcal{F}(x):=\mathcal{H}(x)-x$, so the target mapping is written as $\mathcal{H}(x)=\mathcal{F}(x)+x$ (the shortcut adds $x$ back)

587f9020e504.zh: 把卷積全部換成全連接
587f9020e504.en: Replace all convolutions with fully connected layers

fea9f64fed62.zh: DenseNet 相對 ResNet 的連接方式，下列何者正確？
fea9f64fed62.en: Which of the following correctly describes how DenseNet's connections differ from ResNet's?

0f6d3d73c144.zh: DenseNet 仍用式 (11) 的加法，只是把層數加倍
0f6d3d73c144.en: DenseNet still uses the addition of Eq. (11), just with twice as many layers

ce58e3c8e54e.zh: DenseNet 用式 (12) 把前面各層輸出 concat； $l$ 層約有 $l(l+1)/2$ 條連線
ce58e3c8e54e.en: DenseNet uses Eq. (12) to concat the outputs of all previous layers; $l$ layers have about $l(l+1)/2$ connections

0d2742f310b1.zh: DenseNet 刪除所有 skip connection

38011702197a.zh: EfficientNet 的複合縮放（compound scaling）與 ConvNeXt 的訊息，正確的是？
38011702197a.en: Which statement about EfficientNet's compound scaling and ConvNeXt's message is correct?

9514f688b395.zh: EfficientNet 同時縮放深度、寬度與解析度；ConvNeXt 顯示現代化 CNN 仍可與 Transformer 競爭
9514f688b395.en: EfficientNet scales depth, width, and resolution together; ConvNeXt shows that a modernized CNN can still compete with Transformers

fee614b3a806.zh: EfficientNet 只加深、不改寬度與解析度
fee614b3a806.en: EfficientNet only goes deeper, without changing width or resolution

26828079ccf0.zh: ConvNeXt 證明 CNN 已完全被淘汰
26828079ccf0.en: ConvNeXt proves that CNNs have been completely phased out

9c7c99d27efd.en: Both forbid the use of convolution

e4e929d04e80.zh: 依 Elements of Deep Learning (Ghojogh & Ghodsi) Ch04 改寫 · 自學用
e4e929d04e80.en: Adapted from Elements of Deep Learning (Ghojogh & Ghodsi) Ch04 · for self-study

66f48a9d20b8.zh: 拉平後網路把所有像素當成同等相關，鄰居關係消失，邊緣與紋理等局部圖案很難學。
66f48a9d20b8.en: After flattening, the network treats all pixels as equally related; neighbor relations disappear, so local patterns such as edges and textures are hard to learn.

c39db4f94931.zh: 每個輸出只連局部區域（稀疏），且各局部區域共用同一組權重（共享），這就是卷積層。
c39db4f94931.en: Each output connects only to a local region (sparse), and all local regions use the same set of weights (shared): that is the convolutional layer.

04fd31081a87.zh: 等變性是「輸入移位、輸出跟著移位」；與後文池化帶來的平移不變性不是同一件事。
04fd31081a87.en: Equivariance means "the input shifts, and the output shifts along with it"; it is not the same thing as the translation invariance that pooling brings later on.

193660a1245e.zh: §2 講 LeNet 骨架，§3 拆卷積層內部三階段，§4 初始化，§5 經典架構。
193660a1245e.en: §2 covers the LeNet skeleton, §3 takes apart the three stages inside a convolutional layer, §4 initialization, §5 classic architectures.

ccba846624fe.zh: 福島邦彥 1980 年提出 neocognitron；LeCun 團隊約 1989 年改用於手寫數字，1998 年定名 LeNet。
ccba846624fe.en: Kunihiko Fukushima proposed the neocognitron in 1980; LeCun's team applied it to handwritten digits around 1989, and in 1998 it was named LeNet.

857108a6dc17.zh: 1998 年 LeCun 等人改進並命名 LeNet 的同一篇論文，也介紹了 MNIST（Modified NIST）。
857108a6dc17.en: The same 1998 paper in which LeCun et al. improved and named LeNet also introduced MNIST (Modified NIST).

ec0c503afa92.en: Convolution gives 28×28×6, pooling 14×14 (6 channels), convolving again 10×10×16, pooling again 5×5, and finally FC 120-84-10.

36479a2db93a.zh: 先 conv＋pool、後 fully connected 的管線，成為現代卷積網路的基礎模板。
36479a2db93a.en: The pipeline of conv + pool first, then fully connected, became the basic template for modern convolutional networks.

3aa80693b2c5.zh: 每一個卷積層由 convolution、detector（激活函數）、pooling 三階段組成。
3aa80693b2c5.en: Every convolutional layer consists of three stages: convolution, detector (activation function), and pooling.

e051ff35017f.zh: Prewitt 的兩個 3×3 核分別用於水平與垂直邊緣偵測，是傳統影像濾波的例子。
e051ff35017f.en: Prewitt's two 3×3 kernels are used for horizontal and vertical edge detection respectively; they are an example of traditional image filtering.

e88a7d1bc1d4.zh: 不同任務／資料集需要不同特徵；因此核值改由學習決定，而不是固定成邊緣模板。
e88a7d1bc1d4.en: Different tasks/datasets need different features; so the kernel values are determined by learning instead of being fixed as edge templates.

32c05ddb5bd3.zh: 核當作可學習權重，以反向傳播針對該任務與資料集優化。
32c05ddb5bd3.en: The kernel is treated as learnable weights and optimized with backpropagation for that task and dataset.

8b18d5fa067a.zh: 理論卷積對其中一個訊號（通常是核）做翻轉；指標 $t-a$ 就是翻轉後再對齊到 $t$。
8b18d5fa067a.en: Theoretical convolution flips one of the signals (usually the kernel); the index $t-a$ is exactly the flip followed by alignment to $t$.

96b6f8089858.zh: 式 (3) 對 $m,n$ 求和，核索引為 $i-m$、$j-n$，即二維翻轉卷積；實務求和只覆蓋核的有限支撐。
96b6f8089858.en: Eq. (3) sums over $m,n$ with kernel indices $i-m$ and $j-n$, i.e. a 2D flipped convolution; in practice the sum covers only the kernel's finite support.

ab0a81eee0ab.zh: 影像處理與 CNN 實作多半不翻核；網路會學到對應翻或未翻版本，訓練結果等價於慣例選擇。
ab0a81eee0ab.en: Image processing and CNN implementations mostly don't flip the kernel; the network learns the corresponding flipped or unflipped version, so the training result is equivalent whichever convention is chosen.

73e5b63fef09.zh: 不翻核的變體稱為互相關；CNN 口語仍常稱卷積，實作卻多半是式 (4) 這類形式。
73e5b63fef09.en: The non-flipped variant is called cross-correlation; CNNs are still commonly said to do convolution, but implementations are mostly of the form of Eq. (4).

01a136611154.zh: 全連接每個輸出連到全部輸入，為 $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$；卷積每個輸出只連到大小 $k$ 的局部，為 $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$。
01a136611154.en: In a fully connected layer every output connects to all inputs, giving $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$; in convolution each output connects only to a local patch of size $k$, giving $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$.

cbd2a2d7d1cc.zh: 稀疏來自 kernel 小於輸入；kernel 一旦與輸入同大，每個輸出又看見全部輸入，等價於密集連接。
cbd2a2d7d1cc.en: Sparsity comes from the kernel being smaller than the input; once the kernel is as large as the input, every output sees the whole input again, which is equivalent to dense connectivity.

99c901511ff9.zh: kernel 權重在所有空間位置共享：同一組參數重複套用，而不是每個位置各學一套。
99c901511ff9.en: The kernel weights are shared across all spatial positions: the same set of parameters is applied over and over, rather than each position learning its own set.

7ae0fbf4ac30.zh: 全連接沒有參數共享：每個權重只服務一條特定連線，用一次即結束。
7ae0fbf4ac30.en: Fully connected layers have no parameter sharing: each weight serves one specific connection only and is done after a single use.

86f3f02743ed.zh: 卷積是平移等價而非平移不變：特徵圖跟著輸入一起移，相對空間關係被保留。
86f3f02743ed.en: Convolution is translation equivariant, not translation invariant: the feature map moves together with the input, and relative spatial relationships are preserved.

bec54b1129dc.zh: 等價定義即兩函數可交換順序；此處 $g$ 為平移、$f$ 為卷積。
bec54b1129dc.en: The definition of equivariance is exactly that the two functions can be swapped in order; here $g$ is the translation and $f$ the convolution.

ce156c98f6f7.zh: 原文明確指出：等價性對旋轉、縮放等其他變換不成立。
ce156c98f6f7.en: The source text states explicitly: equivariance does not hold for other transformations such as rotation and scaling.

db4e366193e0.zh: 等價保留相對空間排列；若是不變，特徵圖不應跟著貓的位置移動。
db4e366193e0.en: Equivariance preserves the relative spatial arrangement; if it were invariance, the feature map should not move with the cat's position.

6fb27bb3826b.zh: kernel 深度必須等於它所作用的輸入通道數；輸出張數是「有幾顆獨立 kernel」，兩者不是同一件事。
6fb27bb3826b.en: The kernel depth must equal the number of input channels it acts on; the number of outputs is "how many independent kernels there are". The two are not the same thing.

f3528da15e84.zh: 輸出空間尺寸為 $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s+1\rfloor$ 的平方（寬、高各用一次）。
f3528da15e84.en: The output spatial size is $\lfloor(d-f+2p)/s+1\rfloor$ squared (used once for width and once for height).

c39347a83e62.zh: 不施加任何 padding 的情況稱為 valid padding，輸出通常比輸入更小。
c39347a83e62.en: Applying no padding at all is called valid padding; the output is usually smaller than the input.

664e20887b1a.zh: 原文列出 zero、constant、replicate、reflect、circular；沒有把輸入隨機打亂當 padding。
664e20887b1a.en: The textbook lists zero, constant, replicate, reflect and circular; randomly shuffling the input is not listed as padding.

15b8dd3dd43a.zh: Detector 就是激活函數：對超過門檻的訊號產生反應；Chap. 2 的激活在 CNN 中同樣適用。
15b8dd3dd43a.en: The detector is just the activation function: it responds to signals above a threshold. The activations from Chap. 2 apply equally in a CNN.

c39a63a99ff6.zh: 原文列出 max、average、weighted average、median、以及 $\ell_2$-norm；沒有 softmax pooling。
c39a63a99ff6.en: The textbook lists max, average, weighted average, median, and $\ell_2$-norm; there is no softmax pooling.

7811d53aba65.zh: 四塊不重疊 $2\times 2$ 的最大值分別為 3、7、8、6。
7811d53aba65.en: The maxima of the four non-overlapping $2\times 2$ blocks are 3, 7, 8, 6.

ec0a661b4da8.en: Top-right $(7+5+2+4)/4=4.5$, bottom-left $(8-1+7+3)/4=4.25$; the full average result is $[[2, 4.5],[4.25, 1]]$.

2a2161b9ad0b.zh: 訊號右移一格後四個輸入值全變，但 max pooling 只改兩個輸出，其餘維持（虛線標出未變值）。
2a2161b9ad0b.en: After the signal shifts right by one, all four input values change, but max pooling changes only two outputs and the rest stay the same (the unchanged values are marked with dashed lines).

c020a7e8c101.zh: 多數分類任務在意特徵「有沒有」，不在意它偏了幾個像素；池化提供的局部不變性因此有用。
c020a7e8c101.en: Most classification tasks care whether a feature is "there", not how many pixels it has drifted; the local invariance provided by pooling is therefore useful.

e35ae26cbd0c.zh: 位置本身是答案時，池化會模糊空間資訊，變成缺點而非優點。
e35ae26cbd0c.en: When position itself is the answer, pooling blurs the spatial information and becomes a drawback rather than an advantage.

193dae29b960.zh: stride 大於 1 會縮小特徵圖；後續層格子變少、接到全連接時參數也變少，有助計算與泛化（Fig. 9）。
193dae29b960.en: A stride greater than 1 shrinks the feature map; later layers have fewer cells, and there are fewer parameters when it feeds a fully connected layer, which helps both computation and generalization (Fig. 9).

bc23772f149d.zh: 無限強先驗等於硬約束：不存在的連線權重就是 0，對應卷積與池化的稀疏結構。
bc23772f149d.en: An infinitely strong prior is a hard constraint: the weight of a connection that does not exist is 0, matching the sparse structure of convolution and pooling.

b448f6985cc2.zh: 動態池化不以固定空間鄰域為限；也可用訓練學得、之後共用的固定池化結構。
b448f6985cc2.en: Dynamic pooling is not limited to a fixed spatial neighborhood; one can also use a fixed pooling structure learned during training and shared afterwards.

65826029f6af.zh: 核寬可隨圖大小調整；SPP 以固定 bins 取代最後池化，讓網路接受任意尺寸。
65826029f6af.en: The kernel width can be adjusted to the image size; SPP replaces the last pooling with a fixed number of bins, letting the network accept any size.

d16f56237779.zh: GAP 把每張特徵圖收成一個值，省掉巨大 FC，並建立特徵圖與輸出類別的直接連結。
d16f56237779.en: GAP collapses each feature map into one value, removes the huge FC, and builds a direct link between feature maps and output classes.

6d2596d326c9.zh: 核值即權重；反向傳播從當前權重出發迭代更新，因此訓練前必須給初值。
6d2596d326c9.en: The kernel values are the weights; backpropagation iteratively updates them starting from the current weights, so initial values must be given before training.

fa0b7568ea0c.zh: 層權重是投影矩陣；隨機初始化對應隨機投影，JL 引理為其保距性質提供理論支持。
fa0b7568ea0c.en: A layer's weights are a projection matrix; random initialization corresponds to random projection, and the JL lemma provides theoretical support for its distance-preserving property.

44697f76fec6.zh: 過大爆炸、過小消失；Xavier／Glorot 平衡 tanh／sigmoid，He 平衡 ReLU 的變異數。
44697f76fec6.en: Too large explodes, too small vanishes; Xavier/Glorot balances the variance for tanh/sigmoid, He for ReLU.

715ebc91e290.zh: patch 尺寸對應步幅 $s$；收集原樣與平移後的 patch，PCA 的 $s\times s$ 特徵向量即該層初始核。
715ebc91e290.en: The patch size corresponds to the stride $s$; collect the original and shifted patches, and the $s\times s$ eigenvectors from PCA are that layer's initial kernels.

a9df8f6b308f.zh: ImageNet 約 1500 萬張、約 2.2 萬類；ILSVRC 為其子集，約 120 萬張、1000 類、RGB $224\times 224$。
a9df8f6b308f.en: ImageNet has about 15 million images and about 22k classes; ILSVRC is its subset, with about 1.2 million images, 1000 classes, RGB $224\times 224$.

1fc5c693688a.zh: Fig. 12：五層 conv 再接三層 FC；當時單卡約 3GB 不夠，故採雙 GPU。
1fc5c693688a.en: Fig. 12: five conv layers followed by three FC layers; a single card's roughly 3GB was not enough at the time, so two GPUs were used.

aad24099068c.zh: AlexNet 在第 1、2 層 ReLU 後做 LRN，超參數為 $k=2$、$n=5$、$\alpha=10^{-4}$、$\beta=0.75$。
aad24099068c.en: AlexNet applies LRN after the ReLU in layers 1 and 2, with hyperparameters $k=2$, $n=5$, $\alpha=10^{-4}$, $\beta=0.75$.

48d874ac45bf.zh: 第 1、2、5 層後 max pool（1、2 層在 LRN 之後），核寬 3、stride 2 為重疊池化；約 60M 參數；式 (8) 對 1000 類 softmax 做多項邏輯迴歸。
48d874ac45bf.en: Max pooling after layers 1, 2, and 5 (in layers 1 and 2 after LRN), kernel width 3 and stride 2, i.e., overlapping pooling; about 60M parameters; Eq. (8) is multinomial logistic regression over the 1000-class softmax.

d5456dcdd6f8.zh: $3\times 3$ 核在 pad 1、stride 1 時剛好補回邊界損失，空間尺寸不變；降解析度交給 stride 2 的 max pooling。
d5456dcdd6f8.en: With pad 1 and stride 1, a $3\times 3$ kernel exactly makes up for the border loss, so the spatial size is unchanged; downsampling is left to stride-2 max pooling.

8229448b6f87.zh: 前兩層各 4096，最後一層 1000 對應 ILSVRC 的 1000 類；LeNet 的 120-84-10 是另一套架構。
8229448b6f87.en: The first two layers have 4096 each, and the last has 1000 for ILSVRC's 1000 classes; LeNet's 120-84-10 is a different architecture.

6c1aa2970a25.zh: 原文明確寫：unlike AlexNet，多數 VGG 不用 LRN，因實驗發現對 ILSVRC 沒有提升。
6c1aa2970a25.en: The original text states it explicitly: unlike AlexNet, most VGG versions do not use LRN, because experiments found it brought no improvement on ILSVRC.

d2e01e6a042c.zh: 寬度 2、stride 2 的 max pooling 使相鄰視窗不重疊，長寬各減半。
d2e01e6a042c.en: Max pooling with width 2 and stride 2 makes adjacent windows non-overlapping and halves the height and width.

509719eb47bd.zh: 昂貴的 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 前先 $1\times 1$ 壓通道；pooling 後也接 $1\times 1$，這是最終模組相對早期設計的關鍵改動。
509719eb47bd.en: A $1\times 1$ squeezes the channels before the expensive $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$, and another $1\times 1$ follows pooling; this is the key change of the final module over the early design.

5d28f3b9fc63.zh: $1\times 1$ 可當成通道方向的線性變換；放在貴的 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 前與 pooling 後，是為了降維、減少冗餘。
5d28f3b9fc63.en: A $1\times 1$ can be seen as a linear transformation along the channel direction; it is placed before the expensive $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ and after pooling to reduce dimensions and redundancy.

39526f6036b1.zh: 前處理零中心、核心是堆疊 Inception、卷積（含模組內）皆 ReLU，對應原文對 Fig. 15 的描述。
39526f6036b1.en: Zero-centering preprocessing, a core of stacked Inception modules, and ReLU in all convolutions (including inside the modules) match the original text's description of Fig. 15.

1fea3034a637.zh: 深層特徵更抽象，需要較大感受野，因此 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 比例提高；也因此更需要 $1\times 1$ 降維來控制計算量。
1fea3034a637.en: Deeper features are more abstract and need a larger receptive field, so the proportion of $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ goes up; that is also why $1\times 1$ dimensionality reduction is needed all the more to keep the computation in check.

314d3315b8ae.zh: 原文：contracting path 捕捉 contextual information，expansive path 負責 precise localization。
314d3315b8ae.en: The original text: the contracting path captures contextual information, and the expansive path is responsible for precise localization.

0c7bbb8456b2.zh: 不補邊的 $3\times 3$ 卷積會吃掉邊界，跳接前需裁切對齊；現代也可用 padding 避免這一步。
0c7bbb8456b2.en: An unpadded $3\times 3$ convolution eats away the border, so the feature map must be cropped to align before the skip connection; modern versions can use padding to avoid this step.

b1a46f19cfea.zh: 上採樣以 $2\times 2$ deconvolution（transpose / up-convolution）完成，Fig. 17 即此運算示意。
b1a46f19cfea.en: Upsampling is done with a $2\times 2$ deconvolution (transpose / up-convolution); Fig. 17 illustrates this operation.

5788be61c0cf.zh: 針對 biomedical segmentation；最後一層 $c$ 通道對應 $c$ 類，逐像素 softmax 與交叉熵。
5788be61c0cf.en: It targets biomedical segmentation; the last layer's $c$ channels correspond to $c$ classes, with per-pixel softmax and cross-entropy.

714752c31f93.zh: 原文：very deep networks（typically more than 20 layers）加深後訓練準確率先飽和再變差；理論上多層可學恆等，實務卻常讓訓練誤差上升。
714752c31f93.en: The original text: for very deep networks (typically more than 20 layers), going deeper makes training accuracy saturate and then get worse; in theory the extra layers could learn the identity, yet in practice training error often rises.

33afc4fdf1d7.zh: 不直接學 $\mathcal{H}$，改學殘差 $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$，主路與恆等捷徑相加得到 $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$；捷徑也改善梯度回傳。
33afc4fdf1d7.en: Instead of learning $\mathcal{H}$ directly, learn the residual $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$; adding the main path and the identity shortcut gives $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$; the shortcut also improves gradient backpropagation.

e49fc7fb34ba.zh: ResNet： $x_\ell=\mathcal{F}_\ell(x_{\ell-1})+x_{\ell-1}$；DenseNet：對 $[x_0,\ldots,x_{\ell-1}]$ concat。密集連線數為 $l(l+1)/2$；transition 為 $1\times 1$ + avg pool，$k$ 可小（如 12）。
e49fc7fb34ba.en: ResNet: $x_\ell=\mathcal{F}_\ell(x_{\ell-1})+x_{\ell-1}$; DenseNet: concat over $[x_0,\ldots,x_{\ell-1}]$. The number of dense connections is $l(l+1)/2$; a transition is $1\times 1$ + avg pool, and $k$ can be small (e.g. 12).

41b31595cc3f.zh: EfficientNet（2019）對 depth／width／resolution 做 compound scaling；ConvNeXt（2022）把 CNN 設計現代化，說明在注意力模型時代 CNN 仍具競爭力。
41b31595cc3f.en: EfficientNet (2019) does compound scaling over depth/width/resolution; ConvNeXt (2022) modernized CNN design, showing that CNNs remain competitive in the era of attention models.

6778dc143910.zh: 教授祕笈：攤平信紙對上小窗格掃照片
6778dc143910.en: Professor's Secret Notes: flattening the letter vs. scanning the photo with a small window

866d49c66e33.zh: 同學，Chap. 1 把機器學習拆成選模型、定損失、再搜尋；Chap. 3 把搜尋講成下山。這一章資料換成有上下左右的照片。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：把信紙攤平成一條長帶子，對上拿小窗格在照片上掃過去。
866d49c66e33.en: Class, Chap. 1 broke machine learning into choosing a model, defining a loss, then searching; Chap. 3 described the search as walking downhill. In this chapter the data becomes photos that have up, down, left and right. There is only one main analogy from start to finish: flattening a letter into one long strip, versus scanning a small window across the photo.

efba73cbec7d.zh: 先把任務講成一句人話
efba73cbec7d.en: First, State the Task in Plain Language

28150368dc0a.zh: 影像又高維、又有空間結構：隔壁像素通常長得很像。你若把 $H\times W$ 的格子拉平（flatten）再送進全連接網路（MLP），左上角跟右下角變成「同等距離、同等相關」——信紙上誰跟誰是鄰居，全沒了。卷積神經網路（CNN）不攤平，它直接在二維格子上用小濾波器滑動，把局部圖案抓出來。
28150368dc0a.en: Images are high-dimensional and spatially structured: neighboring pixels usually look alike. If you flatten the $H\times W$ grid and then feed it into a fully connected network (MLP), the top-left and bottom-right corners become "equally far apart and equally related"—who was neighbors with whom on the letter is completely lost. A convolutional neural network (CNN) doesn't flatten; it slides small filters directly over the 2D grid to pick out local patterns.

46d40fbaa6b0.zh: 直覺就一句：別把照片撕成一條線，用小窗去掃。 為什麼還需要專有名詞？因為 CNN 其實是全連接網路的特例，只扳了兩個結構開關。
46d40fbaa6b0.en: The intuition is one sentence: don't tear the photo into a line; scan it with a small window. Why do we still need technical terms? Because a CNN is actually a special case of a fully connected network, with just two structural switches flipped.

aebe4c030b9e.zh: 稀疏連接（sparsity）：每個輸出單元只看窗格蓋到的一小塊鄰居，不是整張圖。權重共享（weight sharing）：每一小塊都用同一組權重去掃——左邊的邊緣偵測器和右邊共用同一套數字。
aebe4c030b9e.en: Sparse connectivity (sparsity): each output unit looks only at the small neighborhood covered by the window, not the whole image. Weight sharing: every small patch is scanned with the same set of weights—the edge detector on the left and the one on the right share the same set of numbers.

68b628b21e8c.zh: 這樣做有三個立刻看得見的好處：參數量大幅下降；模型自帶先驗「邊緣、角落這種局部圖案到處都可能出現」；還會帶來平移等變性（translation equivariance）——輸入平移一點，輸出特徵圖也跟著平移一點。注意，這是「跟著走」，不是後面池化才講的「怎麼挪都同一個數字」。
68b628b21e8c.en: This brings three immediately visible benefits: the number of parameters drops sharply; the model carries a built-in prior that "local patterns such as edges and corners can appear anywhere"; and it brings translation equivariance—shift the input a little and the output feature map shifts by the same amount. Note that this means "it moves along," not the "same number no matter how you shift it" that pooling brings later.

21058d2e7619.zh: 真的算一遍：4×4 信紙，兩種寄法差多少郵票
21058d2e7619.en: Actually compute it: a 4×4 letter, how many stamps the two ways of mailing it cost

f80cf67590e0.zh: 一張 $4\times 4$ 小圖有 16 個像素，假設每個位置都要一個輸出（same 尺寸）。
f80cf67590e0.en: A small $4\times 4$ image has 16 pixels; suppose every position needs one output (same size).

e0f8f9fa35fa.en: Each connection learns its own number

20e1701c07dc.zh: 每個位置一套 9 個數
20e1701c07dc.en: A set of 9 numbers for each position

89d053d8febe.en: Small window shared across the whole image (CNN)

c7d1b8502cfb.en: The same 9 numbers scan the whole image

21295d37c7d3.zh: 從 256 砍到 9，不是運氣，是「局部＋共用」兩個開關一起扳。MNIST 那種 $28\times 28=784$ 若接到 120 顆隱藏單元，攤平要 $784\times 120=94{,}080$ 個權重；6 顆 $5\times 5$ 窗格只要 $25\times 6=150$。
21295d37c7d3.en: Cutting 256 down to 9 isn't luck; it's the two switches "local + shared" flipped together. For MNIST's $28\times 28=784$, connecting to 120 hidden units means flattening takes $784\times 120=94{,}080$ weights; 6 windows of $5\times 5$ need only $25\times 6=150$.

295417a4d28f.zh: 你大概會覺得 CNN 是另一個星球的發明，跟 MLP 沒血緣。反轉在這裡：它就是全連接的特例。你沒有換數學物種，只是禁止遠房像素握手，並強迫同一套筆跡到處蓋章。另一個坑更常見：聽到「平移」就以為特徵圖會凍住。凍住叫不變性；小窗格掃過的結果是等變性——貓往右，反應也往右。
295417a4d28f.en: You probably think the CNN is an invention from another planet, with no blood relation to the MLP. Here's the twist: it is a special case of fully connected. You haven't switched to a different mathematical species; you've just forbidden distant pixels from shaking hands and forced the same handwriting stamp to be used everywhere. Another pitfall is even more common: hearing "translation" and assuming the feature map freezes in place. Freezing is called invariance; the result of a small window scanning across is equivariance—the cat moves right, and the response moves right too.

9a248ab4d6ea.zh: 換個場景，自己找出同一條路
9a248ab4d6ea.en: Change the Scenario and Find the Same Path Yourself

56413cfab40f.zh: 把照片換成一頁樂譜。攤平成一串音高數字，小節線跟鄰近和弦全斷；用一小段三拍的窗去掃，才能抓到「這裡是一段音階」。結構相同：局部相關不要拆掉。請你自己算：輸入 $8\times 8=64$，輸出也 64，窗格 $3\times 3$。全連接參數多少？CNN 共享之後多少？骨架跟上表一樣。
56413cfab40f.en: Swap the photo for a page of sheet music. Flatten it into a string of pitch numbers and the bar lines and neighboring chords are all broken; only by scanning with a small three-beat window can you catch "here is a scale passage." Same structure: don't tear apart local correlations. Work it out yourself: input $8\times 8=64$, output also 64, window $3\times 3$. How many parameters does fully connected need? How many does a CNN need after sharing? The skeleton is the same as the table above.

caa657bf2ed9.zh: 大家最容易在這裡搞混
caa657bf2ed9.en: Where Everyone Gets Confused Most Easily

93db752787f1.zh: 第一個誤解：以為 flatten 之後「一定分不出手寫數字」。MLP 硬幹有時還分得過，只是難學局部邊緣，參數又肥。第二個誤解：把等變性講成不變性。KP-6 會把這兩個詞釘死。
93db752787f1.en: First misconception: thinking that after flattening it "can never tell handwritten digits apart." An MLP brute-forcing it can sometimes still classify them; it just has a hard time learning local edges, and its parameters are bloated. Second misconception: calling equivariance invariance. KP-6 will nail these two terms down.

99552898f16e.zh: KP-2 會用 LeNet 把「先小窗格掃、再交卷分類」做成一條具體尺寸的流水線。KP-5 把稀疏跟共享寫成 $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ 對 $\mathcal{O}(kn)$。KP-6 專門講貓往右走。Chap. 3 的反向傳播，在 KP-3 會回來調窗格裡的數字。
99552898f16e.en: KP-2 uses LeNet to turn "scan with a small window first, then hand in the classification" into a pipeline with concrete sizes. KP-5 writes sparsity and sharing as $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ versus $\mathcal{O}(kn)$. KP-6 is all about the cat moving right. Chap. 3's backpropagation comes back in KP-3 to tune the numbers in the window.

9dad82d8d334.zh: 影像有空間鄰居；flatten 等於把信紙攤成帶子。CNN 用稀疏連接加權重共享，在原圖上滑小窗格，參數少，還帶平移等變性。
9dad82d8d334.en: Images have spatial neighbors; flattening is like spreading the letter out into a strip. A CNN uses sparse connectivity plus weight sharing to slide a small window over the original image: fewer parameters, plus translation equivariance.

923466174a86.zh: 一句話收尾： 別把信紙攤平——用同一格小窗，把照片掃過去。
923466174a86.en: One-sentence wrap-up: Don't flatten the letter—scan the photo with one and the same small window.

fd52608b63ac.zh: 教授祕笈：先用放大鏡找筆畫，再交卷
fd52608b63ac.en: Professor's Secret Notes: find the strokes with a magnifying glass first, then hand in the paper

5dad71c7cc0d.zh: 同學，KP-1 說別把信紙攤平、要用小窗格掃照片。今天這張窗格有了歷史與尺寸。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：先用放大鏡在考卷上找筆畫，看清楚局部特徵，最後才把答案寫在交卷欄。現代 CNN 幾乎都還在抄這張答題流程。
5dad71c7cc0d.en: Class, KP-1 said don't flatten the letter; scan the photo with a small window. Today that window gets a history and sizes. There is only one main analogy from start to finish: first use a magnifying glass to find the strokes on the exam paper, see the local features clearly, and only at the end write the answer in the answer box. Almost every modern CNN is still copying this answering procedure.

98668ac3dbfa.zh: 辨識手寫數字，不要一開始就把 28×28 格撕成 784 個獨立分數再猜 0 到 9。正確流程是：放大鏡先掃局部筆畫，紙張愈收愈小、特徵愈來愈抽象，最後才交卷分類。這條管線有名字，叫做 LeNet。
98668ac3dbfa.en: To recognize a handwritten digit, don't start by tearing the 28×28 grid into 784 independent scores and then guess 0 to 9. The right procedure: the magnifying glass first scans local strokes, the paper gets smaller and smaller while the features get more and more abstract, and only at the end do you hand in the classification. This pipeline has a name: LeNet.

3a970e9a6b52.zh: 直覺：先局部掃描，再抽象決策。 故事不是 2012 才開始。1980 年福島邦彥（Kunihiko Fukushima）提出 neocognitron，已經有分層、局部感受野的味道。大約 1989 年，Yann LeCun 團隊把它改成手寫數字網路；1998 年 LeCun、Yoshua Bengio 等人再改進，模型以 LeCun 為名，叫做 LeNet。同一篇論文還交出基準資料集 MNIST（Modified NIST）：28×28 的手寫數字 0–9。
3a970e9a6b52.en: Intuition: scan locally first, then make an abstract decision. The story did not start in 2012. In 1980 Kunihiko Fukushima proposed the neocognitron, which already had the flavor of layered, local receptive fields. Around 1989, Yann LeCun's team turned it into a handwritten-digit network; in 1998 LeCun, Yoshua Bengio and others improved it further, and the model was named after LeCun: LeNet. The same paper also delivered the benchmark dataset MNIST (Modified NIST): 28×28 handwritten digits 0–9.

8b4c2a3179af.zh: 課本 Fig. 1 那條管線，用尺寸就能背下來。輸入是一張 28×28 的考卷。放大鏡（卷積）掃完，得到 $28\times 28$、6 張特徵圖；紙張對摺縮小（池化），變成 $14\times 14$，通道仍是 6。再掃一次，得到 $10\times 10\times 16$；再縮小成 $5\times 5$（16 通道）。這才攤平、交卷：全連接 120 → 84 → 10，最後 10 維對應數字 0 到 9。
8b4c2a3179af.en: The pipeline in the textbook's Fig. 1 can be memorized through its sizes. The input is a 28×28 exam paper. After the magnifying glass (convolution) scans it, you get $28\times 28$ with 6 feature maps; fold the paper to shrink it (pooling) and it becomes $14\times 14$, still 6 channels. Scan once more to get $10\times 10\times 16$; shrink again to $5\times 5$ (16 channels). Only then do you flatten and hand in: fully connected 120 → 84 → 10, with the final 10 dimensions corresponding to the digits 0 to 9.

127244d27a19.zh: 真的算一遍：考卷上還剩多少格子
127244d27a19.en: Actually compute it: how many cells are left on the exam paper

d7be2ce6d972.zh: 把每一站的「格子總數」算出來，你會看到放大鏡先把筆畫展開成多張描圖，再逐步摘要：
d7be2ce6d972.en: Compute the "total number of cells" at each station, and you'll see the magnifying glass first spreads the strokes out into several tracings, then summarizes them step by step:

88758e8a57d8.zh: 最後那 400 個格子才允許攤平。若第一步就 flatten，你是拿 784 個沒整理的像素直接猜答案；LeNet 是拿 400 個「已經被放大鏡看過的筆畫摘要」去交卷。
88758e8a57d8.en: Only those last 400 cells are allowed to be flattened. If you flatten in the very first step, you're guessing the answer directly from 784 unorganized pixels; LeNet hands in 400 "stroke summaries that the magnifying glass has already looked at."

f0dcf07f34f8.zh: 你大概會覺得 1998 年的網路是考古，現在該直接跳 AlexNet。反轉在這裡：後世加寬加深，骨架幾乎沒換——前面卷積加池化抽空間特徵，後面全連接做分類。放大鏡先找筆畫、最後才交卷，這不是過時儀式，是常規 CNN 的原型。
f0dcf07f34f8.en: You probably think a 1998 network is archaeology and you should skip straight to AlexNet. Here's the twist: later generations made it wider and deeper, but the skeleton barely changed—convolution plus pooling up front to extract spatial features, fully connected at the back to classify. Finding the strokes with a magnifying glass first and handing in the paper last is not an outdated ritual; it's the prototype of the conventional CNN.

d1efd8525dbc.zh: 把考卷換成「先看病理切片再寫診斷」。病理科不會把整張切片像素攤平成一條再猜病名；他們先用顯微鏡掃局部細胞型態，再縮小視野做摘要，最後才填診斷欄。結構跟 LeNet 同一套。請你把口訣默寫一遍：$28\times 28\times 6$ → 池化 $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → FC 120-84-10。數字對了，管線就記住了。
d1efd8525dbc.en: Swap the exam paper for "look at the pathology slide first, then write the diagnosis." A pathology department doesn't flatten the whole slide's pixels into one line and then guess the disease; they first scan the local cell morphology under the microscope, then zoom out to summarize, and only at the end fill in the diagnosis box. Same structure as LeNet. Write out the mnemonic from memory: $28\times 28\times 6$ → pool $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → FC 120-84-10. Get the numbers right and you've memorized the pipeline.

5acad488cea6.zh: 第一個誤解：以為 CNN 從 2012 ImageNet 才誕生。種子是 1980 的 neocognitron，LeNet 在 1989／1998 已經做成標準答案。第二個誤解：以為最後還要全連接，就代表前面白掃了。前面負責找筆畫，交卷欄負責寫 0 到 9；兩段分工，不是自我打臉。
5acad488cea6.en: First misconception: thinking CNNs were born only with ImageNet in 2012. The seed was the 1980 neocognitron, and LeNet had already become the standard answer in 1989/1998. Second misconception: thinking that needing fully connected layers at the end means the scanning up front was wasted. The front part finds the strokes, the answer box writes 0 to 9; it's a division of labor, not self-contradiction.

b393b27fa0b6.zh: KP-1 解釋為什麼第一步不能攤平。KP-3 開始拆「放大鏡裡面的三道工序」：卷積、激活、池化。KP-12 的 AlexNet 會把同一條交卷流程加寬加深。Chap. 22 有 PyTorch 實作對照。
b393b27fa0b6.en: KP-1 explains why the first step can't be flattening. KP-3 starts taking apart "the three steps inside the magnifying glass": convolution, activation, pooling. KP-12's AlexNet widens and deepens the same hand-in procedure. Chap. 22 has the corresponding PyTorch implementation.

6f7c420de84e.zh: 福島 1980 種下種子，LeCun 做成 LeNet 並帶出 MNIST；常規 CNN 就是先放大鏡找筆畫、再交卷。尺寸口訣：$28\times 28\times 6$ → $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → 120-84-10。
6f7c420de84e.en: Fukushima planted the seed in 1980; LeCun built LeNet and brought out MNIST with it; the conventional CNN is just finding the strokes with a magnifying glass first, then handing in the paper. Size mnemonic: $28\times 28\times 6$ → $14\times 14$ → $10\times 10\times 16$ → $5\times 5$ → 120-84-10.

8c0944de430d.zh: 一句話收尾： 先用放大鏡找筆畫，再交卷——這張答題紙，後世還在抄。
8c0944de430d.en: One-sentence wrap-up: Find the strokes with a magnifying glass first, then hand in the paper—later generations are still copying this answer sheet.

c241f08745bb.zh: 教授祕笈：濾鏡從手調變成可學習
c241f08745bb.en: Professor's Secret Notes: filters go from hand-tuned to learnable

5d128d6ed123.zh: 同學，KP-2 的放大鏡已經掃過考卷。今天打開鏡片，看裡面那一層「卷積層」到底做了哪三道工序。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：拍照濾鏡從工程師手調九宮格，變成讓資料自己把濾鏡學出來。
5d128d6ed123.en: Students, KP-2's magnifying glass has already swept over the exam paper. Today we open up the lens and look at the three steps that the "convolutional layer" inside actually performs. There is only one running analogy from start to finish: photo filters go from a nine-cell grid hand-tuned by an engineer to filters the data learns on its own.

e0a7c28337a5.zh: 你在修圖軟體裡套「找邊緣」濾鏡，九個格子裡的數字是人填的。分類貓狗、辨識路牌時，最好的九個數字不會長一樣。卷積層乾脆把這九個數字當成權重，用 Chap. 3 的反向傳播去調。
e0a7c28337a5.en: When you apply a "find edges" filter in a photo editor, the numbers in the nine cells were filled in by a person. For classifying cats and dogs or recognizing road signs, the best nine numbers won't look the same. The convolutional layer simply treats these nine numbers as weights and tunes them with the backpropagation of Chap. 3.

bfd3d73d2ba1.zh: 課本把「一個卷積層」拆成三站，後面會逐站放大，先把名字對上。
bfd3d73d2ba1.en: The textbook breaks "one convolutional layer" into three stops. Later we'll zoom in on each stop; first, let's get the names straight.

9b5c1c43f30a.zh: 卷積階段（convolution stage）：用核（kernel／filter）在特徵圖上滑，做局部加權求和——這就是套濾鏡。偵測器階段（detector stage）：接激活函數，決定這個位置的特徵「被點亮多少」。池化階段（pooling stage）：做下採樣或局部彙總，表徵更穩、尺寸更小。
9b5c1c43f30a.en: Convolution stage: slide a kernel (also called a filter) over the feature map and compute local weighted sums — this is applying the filter. Detector stage: apply an activation function, which decides "how brightly" the feature at this position lights up. Pooling stage: downsample or summarize locally, so the representation is more stable and smaller.

33c01f509eac.zh: 今天先盯第一站：核裡的數字從哪來？傳統影像處理裡，不同任務用不同核。Prewitt 的兩個 $3\times 3$ 核分別抓水平邊緣與垂直邊緣（式 (1)）：
33c01f509eac.en: Today we focus on the first stop: where do the numbers in the kernel come from? In traditional image processing, different tasks use different kernels. The two $3\times 3$ kernels of Prewitt detect horizontal edges and vertical edges respectively (Eq. (1)):

7c306d504220.zh: 左邊上正下負，對水平向的邊緣敏感；右邊左正右負，對垂直向的邊緣敏感。它們做的事情很明確：抽出跟邊緣有關的特徵。問題是：換資料集、換任務，這九個數字就不是最佳答案。
7c306d504220.en: The left one is positive on top and negative on the bottom, so it is sensitive to horizontal edges; the right one is positive on the left and negative on the right, so it is sensitive to vertical edges. What they do is very clear-cut: extract features related to edges. The problem: change the dataset or the task, and these nine numbers are no longer the best answer.

707e9b3d2adb.zh: 真的算一遍：同一塊 3×3，兩片濾鏡數字差很多
707e9b3d2adb.en: Actually compute it: the same 3×3 patch, two filters, very different numbers

ed0d336d2903.zh: 這是「上面暗、下面亮」的水平條紋。把每個格子跟核逐項相乘再加總：
ed0d336d2903.en: This is a horizontal stripe pattern, "dark on top, bright on the bottom". Multiply each cell by the kernel element-wise and sum:

20eefb2d612a.zh: 水平核給出 $-6$，垂直核給出 $0$：濾鏡真的在「選它會的那種筆畫」。若影像改成左右對比 $[[0,1,2],[0,1,2],[0,1,2]]$，兩數會對調成水平 $0$、垂直 $-6$。手調濾鏡的本事，就是這九個固定係數。
20eefb2d612a.en: The horizontal kernel gives $-6$, the vertical kernel gives $0$: the filter really does "pick out the kind of stroke it knows". If the image is changed to a left-right contrast $[[0,1,2],[0,1,2],[0,1,2]]$, the two numbers swap to horizontal $0$, vertical $-6$. The whole skill of a hand-tuned filter lies in these nine fixed coefficients.

89507d32c7e3.zh: 你大概會覺得：Prewitt 都寫進教科書了，當然應該把這兩片當成標準配備。反轉在這裡——現代卷積層故意不沿用這組手調數字。最佳核隨任務與資料集而變；九個格子改成可學習權重，損失對核的梯度用反向傳播傳回來，梯度下降把濾鏡調成「對這份資料最有用」的樣子。手調是示範「濾鏡在幹嘛」；學習才是 CNN 的引擎。
89507d32c7e3.en: You probably think: Prewitt is in the textbooks, so of course these two should be standard equipment. Here's the twist — modern convolutional layers deliberately don't reuse this set of hand-tuned numbers. The best kernel changes with the task and the dataset; the nine cells become learnable weights, the gradient of the loss with respect to the kernel is passed back by backpropagation, and gradient descent tunes the filter into whatever is "most useful for this data". Hand-tuning demonstrates "what a filter does"; learning is the engine of a CNN.

1cd09d0d41cf.zh: 把修圖濾鏡換成「錄音室的等化器」。工程師可以手調一組「人聲增強」旋鈕；換到鳥鳴分類，同一組旋鈕就不對了。正確做法是讓損失去擰那些旋鈕。請你自己算一塊 $[[2,2,2],[2,2,2],[0,0,0]]$ 對水平 Prewitt 的反應——結構跟上表相同，只是明暗對調，符號會翻過來。
1cd09d0d41cf.en: Swap the photo filter for "a recording studio's equalizer". An engineer can hand-tune a set of "vocal boost" knobs; switch to classifying bird songs, and the same knobs are wrong. The right approach is to let the loss turn those knobs. Compute for yourself the response of the patch $[[2,2,2],[2,2,2],[0,0,0]]$ to the horizontal Prewitt kernel — the structure is the same as in the table above, only dark and bright are swapped, so the sign flips.

df438e36145b.zh: 第一個誤解：以為「卷積層」就是一次乘法。它是三站：卷積、激活、池化。第二個誤解：以為 CNN 只能用 Prewitt 這種邊緣核。Prewitt 只是手調時代的例子；學出來的核可能像邊緣，也可能像紋理、眼睛、車輪。
df438e36145b.en: First misconception: thinking a "convolutional layer" is a single multiplication. It is three stops: convolution, activation, pooling. Second misconception: thinking CNNs can only use edge kernels like Prewitt. Prewitt is just an example from the hand-tuning era; learned kernels may look like edges, or like textures, eyes, or wheels.

7dab9969f831.zh: 三站裡，KP-4 會把「滑著乘加」寫成離散卷積與互相關。KP-8 講偵測器就是激活、池化就是摘要。調濾鏡的演算法不是新發明，就是 Chap. 3 的反向傳播。
7dab9969f831.en: Of the three stops, KP-4 writes "slide and multiply-add" as discrete convolution and cross-correlation. KP-8 explains that the detector is the activation and pooling is the summary. The algorithm that tunes the filters is not a new invention; it is just the backpropagation of Chap. 3.

baa3e6ba3643.zh: 一層 CNN ≈ 卷積加激活加池化。Prewitt 示範手調邊緣濾鏡；現代做法把核當權重，用 backprop 學出來。
baa3e6ba3643.en: One CNN layer ≈ convolution plus activation plus pooling. Prewitt demonstrates a hand-tuned edge filter; the modern approach treats the kernel as weights and learns them with backprop.

34202466cafb.zh: 一句話收尾： 濾鏡別再手調九宮格——那九個數字，交給梯度去擰。
34202466cafb.en: In one sentence: stop hand-tuning the nine-cell filter grid — hand those nine numbers over to the gradient to turn.

4a3075e33d3b.zh: 教授祕笈：翻餅的卷積，對上不翻的蓋印章
4a3075e33d3b.en: Professor's Secret Notes: flip-the-pancake convolution vs. no-flip rubber stamping

c024db39e828.zh: 同學，KP-3 說濾鏡裡的數字可以學。今天問：套濾鏡時，那片核要不要先翻過來？主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：理論卷積像烙餅要先翻面再蓋下去；實務 CNN 多半不翻，直接拿橡皮章蓋——那叫互相關。
c024db39e828.en: Students, KP-3 said the numbers in a filter can be learned. Today's question: when applying the filter, should the kernel be flipped over first? There is only one running analogy from start to finish: theoretical convolution is like a pancake you must flip over before pressing it down; practical CNNs mostly don't flip and just press a rubber stamp straight on — that's called cross-correlation.

bb6fc5907064.zh: 離散卷積就是：把訊號跟核對齊，逐點相乘再加總，得到每個位置的輸出。教科書堅持核要先沿軸翻轉；寫程式的人通常懶得翻。對訓練來說，兩種慣例幾乎沒差。
bb6fc5907064.en: Discrete convolution is: align the signal with the kernel, multiply point by point and sum, to get the output at each position. Textbooks insist the kernel must first be flipped along the axis; people writing code usually can't be bothered to flip it. For training, the two conventions make almost no difference.

c953f4d4fffb.zh: 直覺：一邊滑、一邊乘加。 一維定義是式 (2)。輸出在位置 $t$ 的值，等於把訊號 $x$ 跟核 $w$ 對齊後加總。求和指標 $a$ 只是「掃過所有位置」，跟輸出名稱 $a[t]$ 撞名，別被嚇到：
c953f4d4fffb.en: Intuition: slide and multiply-add as you go. The 1D definition is Eq. (2). The output value at position $t$ equals the signal $x$ and the kernel $w$ aligned and summed. The summation index $a$ just "sweeps over all positions"; it clashes with the output's name $a[t]$, so don't let that scare you:

3f4efb7e7484.zh: $w[t-a]$ 裡的 $t-a$ 就是在做翻轉再平移：核先對時間軸翻過來，再滑到 $t$。影像 $I$ 搭配二維核 $K$，兩個空間方向都做一次（式 (3)）：
3f4efb7e7484.en: The $t-a$ in $w[t-a]$ is exactly a flip followed by a shift: the kernel is first flipped along the time axis, then slid to $t$. For an image $I$ with a 2D kernel $K$, this is done once in each of the two spatial directions (Eq. (3)):

6fd759a4a72c.zh: 求和範圍理論上是無窮，實務上只加核蓋得到的那些格子；核外面當成 0。核很小（$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$）時，這就是在每個 $(i,j)$ 做一次局部乘加。
6fd759a4a72c.en: In theory the summation range is infinite; in practice only the cells covered by the kernel are added, and everything outside the kernel is treated as 0. When the kernel is small ($3\times 3$, $5\times 5$), this amounts to one local multiply-add at each $(i,j)$.

6a74f2d836e4.zh: 理論要翻核；影像處理和 CNN 實作裡，核通常不翻——不翻的版本叫做互相關（cross-correlation）。對訓練幾乎沒差：你若堅持翻，網路就學會「翻過的那一版」；你若不翻，它就學會「沒翻的那一版」。梯度下降不在乎你的慣例叫卷積還是互相關，它只在乎這組數字能不能把損失壓下去。
6a74f2d836e4.en: Theory flips the kernel; in image processing and CNN implementations, the kernel is usually not flipped — the non-flipped version is called cross-correlation. For training it makes almost no difference: if you insist on flipping, the network learns "the flipped version"; if you don't flip, it learns "the unflipped version". Gradient descent doesn't care whether your convention is called convolution or cross-correlation; it only cares whether this set of numbers can push the loss down.

2cb7b9fe4cbd.zh: 真的算一遍：三個數的訊號，翻與不翻差 1
2cb7b9fe4cbd.en: Actually compute it: a three-number signal, flipped vs. unflipped differ by 1

b19a8c346226.en: Let $x=[2,\,1,\,3]$ and the kernel $w=[4,\,5]$. First flip the pancake: $w$ becomes $[5,\,4]$. There are two valid output positions:

9855c4f01063.zh: 數字不一樣：14 對 13、17 對 19。可是若學習把核學成 $[5,\,4]$，不翻的蓋章就會吐出 14 與 17——跟「用 $[4,\,5]$ 翻餅」一模一樣。二維也同一套：核旋轉 180 度再蓋，等於用翻面後的印章。
9855c4f01063.en: The numbers differ: 14 vs. 13, 17 vs. 19. But if learning turns the kernel into $[5,\,4]$, the no-flip stamp outputs 14 and 17 — exactly the same as "flip-the-pancake with $[4,\,5]$". 2D works the same way: rotating the kernel 180 degrees and then pressing is the same as using the flipped stamp.

7e9593963636.zh: 訊號處理課會說：不翻就不叫卷積，考試會扣分。進了深度學習實驗室，你打開框架，發現 conv2d 多半在做互相關。反轉不是「課本錯了」，是學習會自動適配慣例。口語上大家還是說卷積層，程式裡多半在蓋不翻的章。
7e9593963636.en: A signal-processing course will tell you: without the flip it isn't convolution, and you'll lose points on the exam. Walk into a deep-learning lab, open a framework, and you'll find that conv2d mostly does cross-correlation. The twist isn't that "the textbook is wrong"; it's that learning adapts to the convention automatically. In everyday speech people still say convolutional layer, while the code is mostly pressing an unflipped stamp.

1f5ed4b65384.zh: 把烙餅換成「用橡皮章在信封上蓋店名」。理論要求你先把章面左右顛倒再蓋，印出來才跟設計稿同向；實務上你若永遠不顛倒，只要刻章時把左右刻反，蓋出來一樣對。請你自己算 $x=[1,\,0,\,2]$、$w=[3,\,4]$ 的翻與不翻兩組輸出，骨架跟上表相同。
1f5ed4b65384.en: Swap the pancake for "stamping a shop name on an envelope with a rubber stamp". Theory requires you to first mirror the stamp face left-to-right before pressing, so the print comes out the same way round as the design; in practice, if you never mirror it, you just carve the stamp mirrored, and the print comes out right just the same. Compute for yourself the flipped and unflipped outputs for $x=[1,\,0,\,2]$ and $w=[3,\,4]$; the skeleton is the same as in the table above.

02314f421110.zh: 第一個誤解：以為一定要先把核旋轉 180 度，否則無法訓練。錯，不翻也能訓。第二個誤解：看到式 (2) 的求和指標也叫 $a$，以為輸出 $a[t]$ 在等式右邊出現。那只是符號撞名，右邊的 $a$ 是啞指標。
02314f421110.en: First misconception: thinking the kernel must be rotated 180 degrees first, otherwise it can't be trained. Wrong: it trains fine without flipping. Second misconception: seeing that the summation index in Eq. (2) is also called $a$, and thinking the output $a[t]$ appears on the right-hand side of the equation. That is just a name clash; the $a$ on the right is a dummy index.

c29a1cac9cb1.zh: KP-3 的 Prewitt 核，套到影像上時實務框架通常不翻那九個數字。KP-5 會說明：不論翻不翻，這次乘加都只連局部、而且全圖共用同一顆核。Chap. 3 的 backprop 負責把核學成對的方向。
c29a1cac9cb1.en: When the Prewitt kernels of KP-3 are applied to an image, practical frameworks usually don't flip those nine numbers. KP-5 will explain: flipped or not, this multiply-add connects only locally, and the whole image shares the same kernel. Chap. 3's backprop is responsible for learning the kernel in the right orientation.

ebe1c848779f.zh: 卷積＝翻核再滑著乘加；CNN 框架多半省略翻轉、改做互相關。反正梯度會把章面學對。
ebe1c848779f.en: Convolution = flip the kernel, then slide and multiply-add; CNN frameworks mostly skip the flip and do cross-correlation instead. Either way, the gradient will learn the stamp face correctly.

e7521036675f.zh: 一句話收尾： 理論翻餅，實務蓋章——章面反正會被梯度刻對。
e7521036675f.en: In one sentence: theory flips the pancake, practice just stamps — the gradient will carve the stamp face right anyway.

eb1fa89da706.zh: 教授祕笈：每人一條專線，對上同一把尺量全圖
eb1fa89da706.en: Professor's Secret Notes: a private line for every pair vs one ruler measuring the whole image

618e54145f42.zh: 同學，KP-4 把「滑著乘加」的公式講完了。現在問一個很土的問題：為什麼不用全連接硬幹影像？答案有兩半。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：全連接像替每一對點拉一條專線；卷積是同一把尺，拿去量整張圖的每一塊。
618e54145f42.en: Folks, KP-4 finished the “slide, multiply and add” formula. Now for a very down-to-earth question: why not just brute-force images with fully connected layers? The answer comes in two halves. There is only one running metaphor from start to finish: fully connected is like running a private line between every pair of points; convolution is one ruler, taken around to measure every patch of the whole image.

aa8f054f6527.zh: 全連接層裡，每一個輸出神經元都跟每一個輸入神經元握手。影像一放大，專線條數會爆炸。卷積不這麼做：每個輸出只量kernel蓋到的那一小塊（稀疏），而且全場共用同一把尺（參數共享）。
aa8f054f6527.en: In a fully connected layer, every output neuron shakes hands with every input neuron. Once the image gets bigger, the number of private lines explodes. Convolution doesn't do this: each output measures only the small patch the kernel covers (sparsity), and the whole image shares the same ruler (parameter sharing).

2197fe47e104.zh: 直覺：少拉線，還要把尺共用。 原文 Fig. 2 左邊是密集層，右邊是卷積層。令 $m$、$n$ 分別是輸入、輸出神經元數，$k$ 是 kernel 大小，且 $k\lt m$。執行時間、記憶體、參數個數可以一起比：全連接都是 $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$；卷積都降成 $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$。因為 $k$ 通常遠小於 $m$（$3\times 3$ 對上 $224\times 224$），省下的不是一點點。這也符合「賭稀疏會贏」和 Occam's razor：能用較少參數解釋資料，就不要用較多。
2197fe47e104.en: The intuition: run fewer lines, and share the ruler too. In Fig. 2 of the source text, the left side is a dense layer and the right side is a convolutional layer. Let $m$ and $n$ be the numbers of input and output neurons, and $k$ the kernel size, with $k\lt m$. Running time, memory and number of parameters can be compared together: fully connected is $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$ for all of them; convolution drops them all to $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$. Because $k$ is usually much smaller than $m$ ($3\times 3$ versus $224\times 224$), the savings are far from small. This also fits “betting on sparsity” and Occam's razor: if fewer parameters can explain the data, don't use more.

8352b456dca1.zh: 稀疏解決「連太多」。參數共享解決「每個位置都學一套新權重」。原文 Fig. 3：kernel 的權重在所有空間位置共用——同一顆小濾波器一路滑過去。全連接的權重矩陣裡，每個元素只用一次，專門負責某一條專線。卷積相反：尺上的每個刻度，在每個位置都被重複使用。網路不是為每個像素學一套專屬濾波器，而是學一組能在整張圖上到處用的特徵偵測器。
8352b456dca1.en: Sparsity solves “too many connections”. Parameter sharing solves “learning a new set of weights for every position”. Fig. 3 of the source text: the kernel's weights are shared across all spatial positions; the same small filter slides all the way across. In a fully connected weight matrix, each element is used only once, dedicated to one particular private line. Convolution is the opposite: every tick mark on the ruler is reused at every position. The network doesn't learn a dedicated filter for each pixel; it learns one set of feature detectors that can be used everywhere across the whole image.

ede7e8810f41.zh: 有一個會變回全連接的邊界：若 kernel 尺寸等於輸入尺寸，每個輸出又把整張輸入看光了，稀疏優勢消失。卷積的好處不是魔法，是「局部感受野」換來的。
ede7e8810f41.en: There is a boundary where it turns back into fully connected: if the kernel size equals the input size, every output sees the whole input again, and the sparsity advantage is gone. The benefit of convolution isn't magic; it is bought with the “local receptive field”.

a33ae9b7fc01.zh: 真的算一遍：8×8 小圖，三種拉線法
a33ae9b7fc01.en: Actually work it out: an 8×8 image, three ways to run the lines

fe17a84809c8.zh: 輸入 $8\times 8=64$ 個像素，輸出也維持 64 個位置（有 padding），kernel 為 $3\times 3$ 所以 $k=9$。
fe17a84809c8.en: The input has $8\times 8=64$ pixels, the output also keeps 64 positions (with padding), and the kernel is $3\times 3$, so $k=9$.

06097b08368b.en: A private line for every pair (fully connected)

6f2aa041cad7.zh: 只量鄰居、每塊一把新尺（稀疏、不共享）
6f2aa041cad7.en: Measure only neighbors, a new ruler per patch (sparse, not shared)

39e11098d6d7.zh: 同一把尺量全圖（稀疏＋共享）
39e11098d6d7.en: One ruler measures the whole image (sparse + shared)

a9db433b2db9.zh: 連線從 4096 降到 576，是稀疏；參數再從 576 降到 9，是共享。換成 $224\times 224$，輸入約 $50{,}176$ 格，全連接專線約 $2.5\times 10^{9}$ 條；同一把 $3\times 3$ 的尺仍然只有 9 個刻度（單通道、單顆核）。
a9db433b2db9.en: Going from 4096 connections down to 576 is sparsity; going from 576 parameters down to 9 is sharing. Switch to $224\times 224$: the input has about $50{,}176$ cells, and fully connected needs about $2.5\times 10^{9}$ private lines; the same $3\times 3$ ruler still has only 9 tick marks (single channel, single kernel).

705a122b620d.zh: 你大概會覺得 kernel 愈大愈厲害，乾脆做成跟照片一樣大。反轉在這裡：尺一旦跟地圖一樣長，你又在拉全場專線，卷積退化成全連接，$\mathcal{O}(kn)$ 變回 $\mathcal{O}(mn)$。大核不是免費的表達力，它會把「局部」這個賭注輸掉。
705a122b620d.en: You probably think a bigger kernel is more powerful, so why not make it as big as the photo? Here is the twist: once the ruler is as long as the map, you are running private lines across the whole room again, convolution degenerates into fully connected, and $\mathcal{O}(kn)$ turns back into $\mathcal{O}(mn)$. A big kernel isn't free expressive power; it loses the bet on “local”.

90572cbae2ec.zh: 把影像換成「量整座城市的路寬」。專線方案是每條街訂製一把尺；卷積方案是巡查員帶同一把 30 公分的尺，每個路口量一次。請你自己算 $m=100$、$n=100$、$k=5$ 時，全連接參數、$kn$、以及共享後的參數各是多少。骨架跟上表三列相同。
90572cbae2ec.en: Swap images for “measuring the road widths of a whole city”. The private-line plan custom-makes a ruler for every street; the convolution plan has an inspector carry the same 30 cm ruler and measure once at every intersection. Work out for yourself, with $m=100$, $n=100$, $k=5$, the fully connected parameter count, $kn$, and the parameter count after sharing. The skeleton is the same as the three rows of the table above.

e9e81c5571a2.zh: 第一個誤解：以為卷積層「永遠」比全連接瘦。kernel 跟輸入一樣大時，瘦不了。第二個誤解：以為參數共享是「各通道共用同一組權重」。這裡講的是空間位置共用同一顆 kernel；不同輸出通道通常是不同的尺。
e9e81c5571a2.en: The first misconception: thinking a convolutional layer is “always” leaner than a fully connected one. When the kernel is as big as the input, it can't be leaner. The second misconception: thinking parameter sharing means “all channels share the same set of weights”. What we mean here is that spatial positions share the same kernel; different output channels usually have different rulers.

4ec859e70663.zh: KP-1 已經用 4×4 預告過「256 對 9」；今天把帳寫成 $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ 對 $\mathcal{O}(kn)$。KP-6 的平移等價，正是因為同一把尺到處量，平移之後局部長相沒變，反應才會跟著走。KP-4 的乘加，就是這把尺在某一格上的讀數。
4ec859e70663.en: KP-1 already previewed “256 versus 9” with a 4×4 image; today we write the bill as $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ versus $\mathcal{O}(kn)$. KP-6's translation equivariance comes precisely from measuring everywhere with the same ruler: after a translation the local appearance hasn't changed, so the response moves along. KP-4's multiply-and-add is just this ruler's reading at one cell.

c749f1c5bcfc.zh: 全連接是每人跟大家拉專線，$\mathcal{O}(mn)$；卷積只跟鄰居量，$\mathcal{O}(kn)$，而且那把尺全場共用。Kernel 一旦跟輸入一樣大，專線又拉回來了。
c749f1c5bcfc.en: Fully connected means everyone runs private lines to everyone, $\mathcal{O}(mn)$; convolution measures only neighbors, $\mathcal{O}(kn)$, and that ruler is shared by the whole image. Once the kernel is as big as the input, the private lines are back.

3d3e4374de0f.zh: 一句話收尾： 別給每個像素拉專線——同一把尺，量完整張圖。
3d3e4374de0f.en: One-line wrap-up: Don't run a private line to every pixel: one ruler measures the whole image.

da592f21b431.zh: 教授祕笈：貓往右走，特徵圖也往右
da592f21b431.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the cat walks right, and the feature map goes right too

78c13595a3fb.zh: 同學，KP-5 說同一把尺量全圖。今天這把尺會帶出一個常被講錯的性質。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：貓在照片裡往右走兩步，特徵圖上的「貓」也往右走兩步——這叫等價，不是旋轉不變，更不是「輸出凍住不動」。
78c13595a3fb.en: Folks, KP-5 said one ruler measures the whole image. Today that ruler brings out a property that is often explained wrongly. There is only one running metaphor from start to finish: when the cat in the photo walks two steps to the right, the “cat” on the feature map also walks two steps to the right. That's called equivariance, not rotation invariance, and even less “the output freezes in place”.

92aad3a2d7f4.zh: 卷積層具有平移等價（translation equivalence），也有人寫成 equivariance。輸入平移，輸出特徵圖用同樣的方式跟著平移，特徵之間的相對空間關係被保住。原文 Fig. 4 畫的就是「兩個操作可以交換順序」。
92aad3a2d7f4.en: Convolutional layers have translation equivalence, which some also write as equivariance. When the input is translated, the output feature map translates along with it in the same way, and the relative spatial relationships between features are preserved. Fig. 4 of the source text shows exactly “the two operations can be swapped in order”.

cf7a13877d0d.zh: 請先把兩個詞分開，後面 KP-9 講池化時還會再碰到。等價（equivalence）：先變換再處理，等於先處理再變換；輸出跟著動。不變（invariance）：輸入怎麼變，輸出幾乎同一個數字；輸出不動。卷積是前者，不是後者。若是不變，特徵圖應該完全沒變，那就分不清貓在左邊還是右邊了。
cf7a13877d0d.en: First keep these two words apart; we will run into them again in KP-9 on pooling. Equivariance (equivalence): transforming then processing equals processing then transforming; the output moves along. Invariance: however the input changes, the output is almost the same number; the output doesn't move. Convolution is the former, not the latter. If it were invariance, the feature map wouldn't change at all, and you couldn't tell whether the cat is on the left or on the right.

2e6f948c168f.zh: 形式化：函數 $f(x)$ 對函數 $g(x)$ 等價，意思是式 (5)：
2e6f948c168f.en: Formally: a function $f(x)$ being equivariant to a function $g(x)$ means Eq. (5):

740ebfc4c51d.zh: 把 $g$ 想成「平移」、$f$ 想成「卷積」，兩條路走完結果一樣：先平移輸入再做卷積，或先做卷積再平移結果。為什麼成立？因為同一顆 kernel 在每個位置都用同一組權重（KP-5 的參數共享）。平移之後局部長相沒變，濾波器當然還是在對應的新位置給出同一個反應。
740ebfc4c51d.en: Think of $g$ as “translation” and $f$ as “convolution”: the two paths end with the same result, whether you translate the input first and then convolve, or convolve first and then translate the result. Why does it hold? Because the same kernel uses the same set of weights at every position (KP-5's parameter sharing). After a translation the local appearance hasn't changed, so of course the filter gives the same response at the corresponding new position.

d39dad9eb1e0.zh: 等價只對平移成立。旋轉、縮放這類變換，卷積沒有式 (5) 那種交換性：把圖轉 90 度再卷，跟先卷再轉 90 度，一般不會得到同一張特徵圖。
d39dad9eb1e0.en: Equivariance holds only for translation. For transformations like rotation and scaling, convolution doesn't have the commutativity of Eq. (5): rotating the image by 90 degrees and then convolving generally doesn't give the same feature map as convolving first and then rotating by 90 degrees.

20801af29ab4.zh: 真的算一遍：一維的貓走一步
20801af29ab4.en: Actually work it out: a one-dimensional cat takes one step

749cb4b1d388.zh: 把「貓」簡化成訊號裡的一個高峰。核用互相關 $[1,\,-1]$（不翻，跟 KP-4 實務一致），valid 輸出：
749cb4b1d388.en: Simplify the “cat” to a single peak in a signal. The kernel is applied as cross-correlation $[1,\,-1]$ (not flipped, consistent with KP-4's practice), with valid output:

a6c9e0f0735b.zh: 第二列幾乎就是第一列往右塞了一個 0：$-3,\,2$ 跟著貓走。這就是等價。若是不變，兩列特徵圖必須一模一樣——它們明明不同。貓的相對筆畫（3 旁邊是 1）還在，只是整段往右挪。
a6c9e0f0735b.en: The second row is almost the first row with a 0 stuffed in on the left and everything pushed right: $-3,\,2$ follows the cat. That is equivariance. If it were invariance, the two feature maps would have to be identical, and they clearly differ. The cat's relative strokes (a 1 next to the 3) are still there; the whole segment has just shifted right.

c6209cd37577.zh: 分類作業常希望「貓在哪裡都算同一類」，於是直覺以為卷積會把位置抹掉。反轉在這裡：卷積故意留位置。抹位置是後面池化的工作（KP-8、KP-9），而且那叫不變，不是等價。另一個更常見的願望是「轉 90 度也該一樣」——標準卷積不送你這份保障。
c6209cd37577.en: Classification tasks often want “a cat counts as the same class wherever it is”, so intuition says convolution erases position. Here is the twist: convolution keeps position on purpose. Erasing position is the job of pooling later (KP-8, KP-9), and that is called invariance, not equivariance. Another, even more common wish is “rotating by 90 degrees should give the same thing too”; standard convolution doesn't give you that guarantee.

28ba8d1c4ab4.zh: 把貓換成舞台追光：演員往右側走，光斑也往右側走，相對關係不變。這是等價。若改成大廳的固定燈，演員走到哪亮度數字都一樣，那是不變——你會丟失「人在舞台哪一側」。請你把訊號改成 $[1,\,4,\,0,\,0]$ 再往右移一格，用同一個核 $[1,\,-1]$ 算兩張特徵圖，看高峰是不是跟著走。
28ba8d1c4ab4.en: Swap the cat for a stage spotlight: as the actor walks to the right side, the light spot moves to the right side too, and the relative relationship stays the same. That's equivariance. If you switch to the hall's fixed lights, the brightness numbers are the same wherever the actor walks, and that's invariance: you lose “which side of the stage the person is on”. Change the signal to $[1,\,4,\,0,\,0]$, shift it one cell to the right, compute both feature maps with the same kernel $[1,\,-1]$, and check whether the peak moves along.

c44cea603cd7.zh: 第一個誤解：把等價講成不變，以為輸入平移後特徵圖完全相同。第二個誤解：以為卷積對旋轉、縮放也等價。原文明確說不成立；實務要靠資料增強、多尺度架構或其他模組。
c44cea603cd7.en: The first misconception: describing equivariance as invariance, thinking the feature map is completely identical after the input is translated. The second misconception: thinking convolution is also equivariant to rotation and scaling. The source text says explicitly that it isn't; in practice you need data augmentation, multi-scale architectures or other modules.

209beeb6c8f5.zh: 等價能成立，是因為 KP-5 的同一把尺到處量。KP-1 導論裡的「平移等變性」就是今天這件事。KP-8 的池化開始做摘要，KP-9 才會認真講局部平移不變。旋轉問題不要期待這一層卷積自動解決。
209beeb6c8f5.en: Equivariance holds because of KP-5's one ruler measuring everywhere. The “translation equivariance” in KP-1's introduction is exactly today's topic. KP-8's pooling starts producing summaries, and only KP-9 takes local translation invariance seriously. Don't expect this convolution layer to solve the rotation problem automatically.

ac83b8b3b57a.zh: 卷積對平移是等價（輸出跟著挪），不是不變（輸出保持原樣）；式 (5) 就是「平移再卷等於卷再平移」。旋轉、縮放不在這份保障裡。
ac83b8b3b57a.en: Convolution is equivariant to translation (the output shifts along), not invariant (the output stays as it was); Eq. (5) is just “translating then convolving equals convolving then translating”. Rotation and scaling are not covered by this guarantee.

8191d7c64b95.zh: 一句話收尾： 貓往右走，特徵圖也往右——等價是跟著走，不是旋轉不變，更不是凍住。
8191d7c64b95.en: One-line wrap-up: The cat walks right, and the feature map goes right too: equivariance means following along; it isn't rotation invariance, and it certainly isn't freezing.

07b44215b35a.zh: 教授祕笈：窗戶、步伐、邊框，決定照片會縮多少
07b44215b35a.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the window, the step, and the frame decide how much the photo shrinks

5b5f82418dca.zh: 同學，KP-4 的章已經會蓋了，KP-5 說章面全圖共用。今天問蓋完之後，照片會變成幾乘幾。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：拿窗戶去框牆上的壁畫——窗戶多大、每次邁幾步、外圍要不要加邊框，決定你最後拍到幾張小照片。
5b5f82418dca.en: Hey everyone, by KP-4 you can already use the stamp, and KP-5 said the stamp face is shared across the whole picture. Today's question: after stamping, how many-by-how-many does the photo become? There's just one main analogy from start to finish: frame a mural on the wall with a window—how big the window is, how many steps you take each time, and whether you add a frame around the outside decide how many little photos you end up taking.

35ec5fa1cc0f.zh: 卷積怎麼滑、滑完特徵圖多大，由幾個超參數決定。窗戶是 kernel 寬度，步伐是 stride，邊框是 padding。輸出邊長有一條公式，心算一次就能對答案。
35ec5fa1cc0f.en: How the convolution slides, and how large the feature map is after sliding, are set by a few hyperparameters. The window is the kernel width, the step is the stride, the frame is the padding. There's one formula for the output side length; do it once in your head and you can check your answer.

9595659b3969.zh: Stride（步幅）：窗戶每次移動幾格。$s=1$ 逐格滑；$s=2$ 跳格，輸出比較小。Width（寬度）：通常同時指 kernel 的寬與高，多半是正方形。小窗較盯中心，大窗把更廣的鄰居加進來。
9595659b3969.en: Stride: how many cells the window moves each time. $s=1$ slides cell by cell; $s=2$ skips cells, and the output is smaller. Width: usually refers to both the width and height of the kernel, mostly square. A small window stares at the center more; a large window adds a wider neighborhood.

c2bddaa3221a.zh: Channels（通道）這裡講的是 kernel 的深度，必須等於它要作用的輸入通道數。千萬別跟「卷積之後有幾張輸出特徵圖」搞混——那是有幾顆獨立的 kernel，不是單一顆 kernel 的深度。RGB 圖有 3 個輸入通道，每一顆濾波器的深度就是 3；若要 16 張輸出特徵圖，你需要 16 顆這樣的濾波器，不是把 kernel 深度設成 16。
c2bddaa3221a.en: Channels here means the depth of the kernel, which must equal the number of input channels it acts on. Never confuse this with "how many output feature maps there are after the convolution"—that is how many independent kernels there are, not the depth of a single kernel. An RGB image has 3 input channels, so each filter has depth 3; if you want 16 output feature maps, you need 16 such filters, not a kernel depth set to 16.

71ad412f15c9.zh: Padding（填充）：在輸入外圍補一圈或多圈，用來控制輸出尺寸、或保留邊界。常見做法包括補 0（zero）、補指定常數（constant）、重複邊緣（replicate）、沿邊界鏡射（reflect）、頭尾循環接起來（circular）。完全不填充叫做 valid padding。Valid 的後果很直接：每次卷積輸出都會比輸入小一圈，疊很多層之後空間尺寸一路縮小。
71ad412f15c9.en: Padding: add one or more rings around the input, to control the output size or keep the boundary. Common methods include padding with 0 (zero), padding with a specified constant (constant), repeating the edge (replicate), mirroring along the boundary (reflect), and wrapping the end around to the start (circular). No padding at all is called valid padding. The consequence of valid is straightforward: every convolution's output is one ring smaller than its input, and after stacking many layers the spatial size keeps shrinking.

d0956804d8ab.zh: 輸入寬（或高）為 $d$，kernel 寬為 $f$，單側 padding 為 $p$，stride 為 $s$。輸出特徵圖的空間尺寸是式 (6)：
d0956804d8ab.en: Let the input width (or height) be $d$, the kernel width $f$, the padding on one side $p$, and the stride $s$. The spatial size of the output feature map is Eq. (6):

cd9d1a253a60.zh: $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ 是向下取整。正方形輸入、正方形 kernel 時，寬與高用同一個式子。心算：有效覆蓋長度是 $d+2p-f$，再按步幅切成幾段，段數加 1 就是輸出邊長。
cd9d1a253a60.en: $\lfloor\cdot\rfloor$ is rounding down (floor). For a square input and a square kernel, width and height use the same formula. Mental arithmetic: the effective coverage length is $d+2p-f$; cut it into segments by the stride, and the number of segments plus 1 is the output side length.

0825115e557b.zh: 真的算一遍：同一面牆，七種窗戶設定
0825115e557b.en: Let's actually compute it: the same wall, seven window settings

05557ed47b45.en: Same side length as the input

9142c0e67704.zh: $d=6$、$s=2$ 那一列最關鍵：中間算出 2.5，向下取整變成 2，不是四捨五入成 3。最後那半步窗戶蓋不住，這張小照片就沒了。
9142c0e67704.en: The $d=6$, $s=2$ row is the key one: the middle step gives 2.5, which rounds down to 2, not to 3 by rounding to nearest. The window can't cover that last half step, so that little photo is simply gone.

b7eac54747ff.zh: 你大概會覺得補邊愈多愈保險，輸出愈大愈好。反轉在這裡：padding 是在牆外圍貼假壁紙。補 0 等於貼黑邊，鏡射才像把畫延續出去。Valid 不是「比較正確的 padding」，它只是不貼邊，所以照片會縮。另一個反轉：把 RGB 的 3 當成「輸出要 3 張圖」——深度對齊的是輸入通道，輸出張數是你準備了幾扇獨立的窗戶。
b7eac54747ff.en: You probably think the more padding the safer, and the bigger the output the better. Here's the twist: padding is pasting fake wallpaper around the outside of the wall. Padding with 0 is like pasting a black border; only mirroring is like extending the painting outward. Valid is not "the more correct padding"; it just doesn't paste a border, so the photo shrinks. Another twist: taking the 3 of RGB to mean "the output should be 3 maps"—the depth matches the input channels, and the number of outputs is how many independent windows you've prepared.

c7d9ebc32b4c.zh: 把壁畫換成「用相機沿書架拍照」。鏡頭視野是 $f$，每次側移幾本書是 $s$，書架兩端要不要留空白是 $p$。請你算 $d=11$、$f=3$、$p=1$、$s=2$ 的輸出邊長——先算分子 $11-3+2=10$，再除以 2 加 1。原文 Fig. 5 是單通道一扇窗；Fig. 6 是三通道輸入、兩顆濾波器，產出兩張特徵圖，請對照「深度 ≠ 輸出張數」。
c7d9ebc32b4c.en: Swap the mural for "taking photos with a camera along a bookshelf". The lens's field of view is $f$, how many books you shift sideways each time is $s$, and whether to leave blank space at both ends of the shelf is $p$. Please compute the output side length for $d=11$, $f=3$, $p=1$, $s=2$—first compute the numerator $11-3+2=10$, then divide by 2 and add 1. The textbook's Fig. 5 is one window over a single channel; Fig. 6 is a three-channel input with two filters, producing two feature maps—compare it with "depth ≠ number of outputs".

59e02018bcdd.zh: 第一個誤解：kernel 深度 = 輸出特徵圖張數。錯，深度對齊輸入通道。第二個誤解：忘記向下取整，把 2.5 當成 3 張照片。第三個誤解：以為 valid 是補零；valid 是完全不補。
59e02018bcdd.en: First misconception: kernel depth = number of output feature maps. Wrong, the depth matches the input channels. Second misconception: forgetting to round down, and counting 2.5 as 3 photos. Third misconception: thinking valid means zero padding; valid means no padding at all.

d4afa826f643.zh: KP-2 的 LeNet 尺寸（28×28 變 14×14）就是窗戶加步伐加池化一起縮。KP-8 的池化窗也用同一套 stride、width、padding 旋鈕。式 (6) 先在卷積這裡站穩。
d4afa826f643.en: The LeNet sizes in KP-2 (28×28 becoming 14×14) are the window, the step and pooling shrinking it together. The pooling window in KP-8 also uses the same stride, width and padding knobs. Get Eq. (6) solid here with convolution first.

46eb2e83e27f.zh: Stride 管跳幾格，width 管看多寬，kernel 深度必須對齊輸入通道，padding 決定要不要補邊；valid 就是不補。輸出邊長用式 (6) 一次算完。
46eb2e83e27f.en: Stride controls how many cells you skip, width controls how wide you look, kernel depth must match the input channels, and padding decides whether to pad the border; valid means no padding. Eq. (6) gives the output side length in one go.

1c7688d5b196.zh: 一句話收尾： 窗戶多大、步伐多寬、邊框補不補，決定壁畫會縮成幾張小照。
1c7688d5b196.en: One-line wrap-up: how big the window is, how wide the step is, and whether you add a frame decide how many little photos the mural shrinks into.

82391e9b98b7.zh: 教授祕笈：同一班成績——最高分對上平均
82391e9b98b7.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the same class's grades—top score versus average

c00d06313ee9.zh: 同學，KP-3 把卷積層拆成三站：卷積、偵測器、池化。濾鏡掃完以後，還要決定「這塊有沒有被點亮」，以及「這塊成績怎麼摘要」。主線比喻從頭到尾只有一個：同一班四個同學的分數，你可以報最高分，也可以報平均——兩種摘要，故事不一樣。
c00d06313ee9.en: Hey everyone, KP-3 split a convolutional layer into three stages: convolution, detector, pooling. After the filter has scanned, you still have to decide "did this patch light up" and "how do we summarize this patch's grades". There's just one main analogy from start to finish: for the scores of the same four classmates, you can report the top score or the average—two summaries, two different stories.

4d387c8c0802.zh: 偵測器（detector）沒有新公式，它就是套上激活函數：超過門檻的訊號會亮起來。Chap. 2 講過的那些 $\sigma$ 在 CNN 裡照樣能用，ReLU 最常見。池化也是一顆小窗在特徵圖上滑，但不做可學習的加權求和，而是對窗內數值算一個統計量：最高分、平均、加權平均、中位數、或 $\ell_2$ 範數。
4d387c8c0802.en: The detector has no new formula; it is just applying an activation function: signals above a threshold light up. All the $\sigma$ from Chap. 2 still work in a CNN; ReLU is the most common. Pooling is also a small window sliding over the feature map, but it doesn't compute a learnable weighted sum; instead it computes a statistic of the values in the window: the top score, the average, a weighted average, the median, or the $\ell_2$ norm.

8c8cd5cc1cbc.zh: 直覺：先看誰被點亮，再把這一小區收成一個數字。 池化參數跟卷積很像，同樣有 stride、width、channels、padding。Stride 小於窗寬，區域會重疊；否則不重疊。窗愈大，摘要愈粗。各通道通常分開池化。Padding 與 KP-7 同一套（zero、constant、replicate、reflect、circular）。
8c8cd5cc1cbc.en: Intuition: first see who lights up, then collapse this little region into one number. Pooling's parameters are much like convolution's: it also has stride, width, channels and padding. If the stride is smaller than the window width, the regions overlap; otherwise they don't. The bigger the window, the coarser the summary. Each channel is usually pooled separately. Padding is the same set as in KP-7 (zero, constant, replicate, reflect, circular).

aab8f9b4462a.zh: 真的算一遍：教科書那張 4×4 成績單
aab8f9b4462a.en: Let's actually compute it: the textbook's 4×4 grade sheet

865122b0e906.zh: 輸入訊號就是全班座位表：
865122b0e906.en: The input signal is the seating chart of the whole class:

afb2ddfb8700.zh: Stride 2、width 2，不重疊的四塊，就是四個小組：
afb2ddfb8700.en: Stride 2, width 2: the four non-overlapping blocks are four small groups:

7130ec30a3d8.zh: 中位數（兩中間數再平均）
7130ec30a3d8.en: Median (average of the two middle numbers)

b7770da6f439.zh: Max 摘要是 $\begin{bmatrix}3&7\\8&6\end{bmatrix}$，average 是 $\begin{bmatrix}2&4.5\\4.25&1\end{bmatrix}$。同一張表，最高分跟平均講的不是同一個故事：左下有個 8 分的明星，max 報 8，平均被 $-1$ 拉到 4.25。
b7770da6f439.en: The max summary is $\begin{bmatrix}3&7\\8&6\end{bmatrix}$, and the average is $\begin{bmatrix}2&4.5\\4.25&1\end{bmatrix}$. Same sheet, but the top score and the average don't tell the same story: the bottom-left has a star with 8 points; max reports 8, while the average gets dragged down to 4.25 by the $-1$.
