d5c48529567c.zh: 改步伐會改座位怎麼分組。Max pooling、stride 1、width 2（窗重疊）得到 $3\times 3$，左上仍是 3，但中間那格變成 $\max(1,7,3,2)=7$。Stride 1、width 3 則收成 $2\times 2$，左上 $\max(2,1,7,2,3,2,8,-1,-5)=8$。先做 zero padding 再 stride 2、width 2 的 max，原文把輸入補成 $6\times 6$ 零框後得到 $\begin{bmatrix}3&7&5\\8&6&6\\7&6&6\end{bmatrix}$——邊框的 0 幾乎當不了最高分，角落的 5、6、7 會被保住。
d5c48529567c.en: Changing the step changes how the seats are grouped. Max pooling, stride 1, width 2 (overlapping windows) gives $3\times 3$; the top-left is still 3, but the middle cell becomes $\max(1,7,3,2)=7$. Stride 1, width 3 collapses it to $2\times 2$, with top-left $\max(2,1,7,2,3,2,8,-1,-5)=8$. For zero padding first and then max with stride 2, width 2, the textbook pads the input with a zero frame to $6\times 6$ and gets $\begin{bmatrix}3&7&5\\8&6&6\\7&6&6\end{bmatrix}$—the 0s in the frame can hardly ever be the top score, so the 5, 6 and 7 in the corners are kept.

7bf18b87db2e.zh: 你大概會覺得 max 永遠比較厲害，因為它留住最亮的特徵。反轉在這裡：平均會把整組氣氛算進去，中位數不怕極端分數，max 則對「有沒有出現過很強的筆畫」敏感。沒有萬能摘要，只有不同的班主任口吻。另一個反轉：偵測器不是再做一次可學習卷積，它只是激活。
7bf18b87db2e.en: You probably think max is always better, because it keeps the brightest feature. Here's the twist: the average takes the mood of the whole group into account, the median isn't afraid of extreme scores, and max is sensitive to "whether a really strong stroke ever appeared". There is no universal summary, only different homeroom teachers' ways of putting it. Another twist: the detector is not another learnable convolution; it's just the activation.

48334e15c3ef.zh: 把成績換成一週氣溫：最高溫、平均溫、中位數，新聞標題會完全不同。結構跟池化同一套。請你對左上那四個數 $2,1,2,3$ 自己驗一次 max、avg、median——三個數字分別是 3、2、2，對得上表，這組口訣後面驗算會用到。
48334e15c3ef.en: Swap the grades for a week of temperatures: the high, the average, and the median would give completely different news headlines. The structure is the same as pooling. Check max, avg and median yourself on the four top-left numbers $2,1,2,3$—the three numbers are 3, 2, 2, matching the table; this set of mnemonics will be used for checking later.

112fb168662e.zh: 第一個誤解：以為池化也在學權重。錯，它是固定的統計量。第二個誤解：把 detector 想成又一層卷積。第三個誤解：四個數的中位數直接取「第 2 個或第 3 個」卻忘記偶數個要再平均；右上正確是 4.5（有的講義誤記 5.5，那是把 4 加 7 了）。
112fb168662e.en: First misconception: thinking pooling also learns weights. Wrong, it is a fixed statistic. Second misconception: thinking of the detector as yet another convolutional layer. Third misconception: taking the median of four numbers directly as "the 2nd or the 3rd one" and forgetting that with an even count you must average them; the correct top-right is 4.5 (some handouts mistakenly record 5.5, which comes from adding 4 and 7).

6dc8ddb037da.zh: 三站順序在 KP-3 就預告了；今天補完後兩站。KP-7 的 stride、width、padding 旋鈕，池化原樣借用。KP-9 會說明：這種局部摘要為什麼能帶來一點平移不變——最高分那格稍微挪一下，小組最高分可能還是同一個明星。
6dc8ddb037da.en: The order of the three stages was previewed in KP-3; today we finish the last two. Pooling borrows KP-7's stride, width and padding knobs as is. KP-9 will explain why this kind of local summary brings a bit of translation invariance—if the top-score cell shifts a little, the group's top score may still be the same star.

a750d1f7181c.zh: Detector 等於激活；pooling 等於對局部做 max、平均、中位數、$\ell_2$ 等摘要。同一張 $4\times 4$，stride 2、width 2 時請把 max $[[3,7],[8,6]]$、avg $[[2,4.5],[4.25,1]]$ 記牢——這組數字後面驗算會用到。
a750d1f7181c.en: Detector equals activation; pooling equals a summary of a local region such as max, average, median, $\ell_2$. For the same $4\times 4$ with stride 2 and width 2, memorize max $[[3,7],[8,6]]$ and avg $[[2,4.5],[4.25,1]]$—these numbers will be used for checking later.

a3a1569c1929.zh: 一句話收尾： 同一班成績，報最高分或報平均——摘要不同，故事就不同。
a3a1569c1929.en: One-line wrap-up: for the same class's grades, report the top score or the average—a different summary tells a different story.

8fa4cc8c1d78.zh: 教授祕笈：拼圖位移後，pooling 仍認得「有這塊」
8fa4cc8c1d78.en: Professor's Secret Notes: shift the puzzle, and pooling still knows "this piece is here"

745410f82f9b.zh: 一句話地圖，一個比喻貫通
745410f82f9b.en: A One-Sentence Map, One Analogy That Ties It All Together

d64bc98bfa67.zh: 主線比喻是「拼圖位移後，pooling 仍認得『有這塊』」。卷積像在桌上找一塊特定形狀的拼圖：它告訴你「這塊在哪個格子」。可多數分類任務根本不在乎它偏左還是偏右半公分——只要確定桌上有這塊就夠了。池化（pooling）就是把鄰近幾格揉成一句摘要：「這一帶有沒有」；拼圖稍微挪一格，桌上四個格子全換了人，摘要卻常常只改一半。整節 Fig. 7–9 就是這件事：局部平移不變，再加上 stride 大於 1 時順便把桌面縮小。
d64bc98bfa67.en: The main analogy is "shift the puzzle, and pooling still knows 'this piece is here'". Convolution is like searching the table for a puzzle piece of a particular shape: it tells you "this piece is in that cell". But most classification tasks don't care at all whether it's half a centimeter to the left or to the right; it's enough to be sure the piece is on the table. Pooling is squashing a few neighboring cells into one summary sentence: "is it somewhere around here". Nudge the puzzle by one cell and all four cells on the table get new occupants, yet the summary often changes only by half. That is what Fig. 7–9 in this whole section are about: local translation invariance, plus shrinking the table along the way when the stride is greater than 1.

ebda5de720cd.zh: 先講一句白話、一個符號都不要：特徵在不在，往往比它精確落在哪個像素重要。 卷積找出的邊緣、筆畫、輪廓，精確座標常常是噪音；真正要的是「圖裡有沒有這個 5」（Fig. 8）。
ebda5de720cd.en: First, one plain sentence with no symbols at all: whether a feature is there often matters more than exactly which pixel it lands on. For the edges, strokes and contours that convolution finds, the exact coordinates are often noise; what you really want is "is there a 5 in this image" (Fig. 8).

b59b9c54e6dd.zh: 為什麼需要它？若每一層都死守像素座標，後面的分類器會把「5 偏右兩個像素」當成另一種東西，泛化很脆。池化把鄰近活化做摘要，因此對局部平移（local translation）近似不變。它還有第二份薪水：下採樣（downsampling）——stride 大於 1 時，特徵圖變疏、後面算得起、接到全連接時參數也比較少。
b59b9c54e6dd.en: Why do we need it? If every layer clings to pixel coordinates, the classifier at the end treats "a 5 shifted two pixels right" as a different thing, and generalization gets brittle. Pooling summarizes neighboring activations, so it is approximately invariant to local translation. It also earns a second paycheck: downsampling. When the stride is greater than 1, the feature map gets sparser, later layers can afford the computation, and there are fewer parameters when it feeds a fully connected layer.

496b8b327add.zh: 記一句對照，後面會用到：平移等價是卷積的性質（KP-6），局部平移不變是池化的性質。要不要不變，看任務。
496b8b327add.en: Remember one contrast, we'll use it later: translation equivariance is a property of convolution (KP-6), local translation invariance is a property of pooling. Whether you want invariance depends on the task.

dee5ca8cfb4e.en: Taking the symbols apart one by one (Fig. 7–9)

923deab5bb48.zh: 設一維訊號 $x$，池化窗寬 $2$、stride $1$（相鄰窗重疊）。第 $i$ 個 max pooling 輸出是
923deab5bb48.en: Take a 1-D signal $x$, pooling window width $2$, stride $1$ (adjacent windows overlap). The $i$-th max pooling output is

655c84788a1d.zh: 輸入往右平移一格得到 $x'$（左邊補 $0$）。Fig. 7 的現象是：$x$ 裡被盯著看的那幾個值全部改寫，但 $\{p_i\}$ 往往只有一部分改、另一部分維持原樣——因為 max 只在乎窗裡有沒有那個大值，不在乎它在窗的左邊還是右邊。
655c84788a1d.en: Shifting the input right by one cell gives $x'$ (padded with $0$ on the left). The phenomenon in Fig. 7: the values of $x$ being watched are all rewritten, but $\{p_i\}$ often changes only in part while the rest stays the same, because max only cares whether the big value is in the window, not whether it sits on the window's left or right.

296fa5f64082.en: The same holds in 2-D: on a $2\times 2$ window, compute

67f7804804db.zh: 或平均池化 $p=(a+b+c+d)/4$。stride $=2$ 時，高、寬大約各砍半（Fig. 9），這就是下採樣。LeNet（KP-2）整座塔就是「卷積抽特徵 → 池化縮小」反覆堆疊。
67f7804804db.en: or average pooling $p=(a+b+c+d)/4$. With stride $=2$, height and width are each roughly halved (Fig. 9); that is downsampling. The whole LeNet tower (KP-2) is "convolution extracts features → pooling shrinks", stacked again and again.

a34cee0fd3c0.zh: 什麼時候不要這味不變性？任務本身把位置當答案——物件在左還是在右、量測距離、對齊關鍵點——池化會把你需要的座標洗掉，變成負擔。
a34cee0fd3c0.en: When don't you want this flavor of invariance? When the task itself treats position as the answer (is the object on the left or the right, measuring distances, aligning keypoints), pooling washes out the coordinates you need and becomes a burden.

af0fc229d657.zh: 數值真的算一遍：四格全變，兩個池化值沒動
af0fc229d657.en: Actually work the numbers: all four cells change, two pooled values don't move

d4f169e921cb.zh: 取長度 $5$ 的訊號與四個重疊的 max 窗（對應 Fig. 7 的「四進四出、只改一半」）：
d4f169e921cb.en: Take a signal of length $5$ and four overlapping max windows (matching Fig. 7's "four in, four out, only half change"):

9b2825c328f4.en: Shift right by one cell: $x'=(0,\,3,\,8,\,2,\,5)$. The first four inputs $3,8,2,5$ versus $0,3,8,2$: all four change. Pool again:

7e17ca986d66.zh: 拼圖挪了一格，桌上的人全換了；摘要卻仍有兩句堅持「這一帶有 8」「這一帶有 5」。這就是局部平移不變，不是魔法，是 max 對窗內位置不敏感。
7e17ca986d66.en: The puzzle moved one cell and everyone on the table changed; yet two summary sentences still insist "there's an 8 around here" and "there's a 5 around here". That is local translation invariance: not magic, just max being insensitive to position within the window.

f82b2641ef70.zh: 下採樣也用真數字。特徵圖 $16\times 16\times 64$，後面接 $10$ 類全連接。不池化：參數 $16\times 16\times 64\times 10=163{,}840$。stride $=2$ 的 $2\times 2$ 池化後變成 $8\times 8\times 64$，參數 $8\times 8\times 64\times 10=40{,}960$，空間與參數都剩四分之一。後面層的格子變少，計算量跟著降——這是 Fig. 9 要你帶走的帳。
f82b2641ef70.en: Downsampling with real numbers too. A feature map of $16\times 16\times 64$ followed by a fully connected layer for $10$ classes. Without pooling: parameters $16\times 16\times 64\times 10=163{,}840$. After $2\times 2$ pooling with stride $=2$ it becomes $8\times 8\times 64$, parameters $8\times 8\times 64\times 10=40{,}960$: both space and parameters are down to a quarter. Later layers have fewer cells, so computation drops too; that is the bill Fig. 9 wants you to take away.

a42f0e8ff261.zh: 直覺會說：「輸入四個數字全改了，後面一定全崩。」Fig. 7 的反轉是：全崩的是像素，不是摘要。 池化故意把「在哪一格」變模糊，換來「有沒有這塊」的穩定。還有第二個反轉：這份穩定不是萬靈丹。辨識數字 5，模糊位置是優點（Fig. 8）；要判斷腫瘤在左肺還是右肺，同一招會把答案洗掉。不變性是設計選擇，不是免費午餐。
a42f0e8ff261.en: Intuition says: "All four input numbers changed, so everything downstream must collapse." The twist of Fig. 7: what collapses is the pixels, not the summary. Pooling deliberately blurs "which cell", in exchange for stability in "is this piece there". And a second twist: this stability is no cure-all. When recognizing the digit 5, blurring position is an advantage (Fig. 8); when deciding whether a tumor is in the left or the right lung, the same trick washes the answer away. Invariance is a design choice, not a free lunch.

cce4204cc308.en: The Way Out: Generalize from Here

503279321a54.zh: 同一套「摘要不怕小位移」換成安檢：傳送帶上的行李箱往前滑了 3 公分，X 光每個像素都變了，但「這一帶有金屬塊」這句話常常還在。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：$x=(4,\,9,\,1,\,7)$，窗寬 $2$、stride $1$ 得三個 max；再右移一格得 $x'=(0,\,4,\,9,\,1)$，哪幾個池化值沒變？提示：先寫出平移前的三個 $\max$，再對 $x'$ 重算。若你發現三個全變，多半是窗對錯格子了。
503279321a54.en: Move the same "summaries don't mind small shifts" idea to airport security: a suitcase on the conveyor belt slides forward 3 cm, every X-ray pixel changes, but the sentence "there's a lump of metal around here" is often still true. Now work it out yourself with new numbers (answer not published): $x=(4,\,9,\,1,\,7)$, window width $2$, stride $1$ gives three maxes; shift right by one to get $x'=(0,\,4,\,9,\,1)$. Which pooled values are unchanged? Hint: first write out the three $\max$ values before the shift, then recompute on $x'$. If you find all three changed, you most likely lined the windows up with the wrong cells.

3f2a98a9c1d9.zh: 誤解「池化＝平移等價」。等價是 KP-6 卷積的事：輸入挪，特徵圖跟著挪。不變是池化的事：輸入挪，摘要可以幾乎不動。兩者方向相反，不能混著背。
3f2a98a9c1d9.en: Misconception: "pooling = translation equivariance". Equivariance is convolution's business in KP-6: the input moves, and the feature map moves with it. Invariance is pooling's business: the input moves, and the summary can barely budge. The two point in opposite directions; don't memorize them mixed together.

a6ce7f8ab9af.zh: 誤解「只有平均池化才有不變性，max 完全沒有」。Fig. 7 用的就是 max；上面例子兩個輸出紋風不動。max 對「最大值在窗裡哪一側」不敏感，平均則是另一種摘要。
a6ce7f8ab9af.en: Misconception: "only average pooling has invariance, max has none at all". Fig. 7 uses max; in the example above, two outputs didn't move an inch. Max is insensitive to "which side of the window the maximum is on"; average is a different kind of summary.

eca5e4208509.zh: 誤解「stride $=1$ 的池化沒意義」。stride $=1$ 仍提供局部摘要與近似不變；stride $\gt 1$ 才額外做縮小。兩種角色可以同時在，也可以分開要。
eca5e4208509.en: Misconception: "pooling with stride $=1$ is pointless". Stride $=1$ still provides a local summary and approximate invariance; stride $\gt 1$ additionally does the shrinking. The two roles can coexist, or you can ask for them separately.

ad0948abcd4a.zh: KP-6：卷積給你平移等價；本節池化把等價「磨」成局部不變。
ad0948abcd4a.en: KP-6: convolution gives you translation equivariance; pooling in this section "grinds" equivariance down into local invariance.

6c949ff2c61b.zh: KP-8：max／平均怎麼算；本節回答為什麼要算、算完有什麼不變性與尺寸後果。
6c949ff2c61b.en: KP-8: how max / average are computed; this section answers why compute them, and what invariance and size consequences follow.

8016877c1807.zh: KP-2：LeNet 反覆「卷積 → 池化」，Fig. 9 的下採樣就是那座塔的縮圖引擎。
8016877c1807.en: KP-2: LeNet repeats "convolution → pooling"; the downsampling in Fig. 9 is that tower's shrinking engine.

ca5a8cc22505.zh: KP-7：輸出尺寸公式對池化同樣適用；stride $=2$ 大約高寬各半。
ca5a8cc22505.en: KP-7: the output-size formula applies to pooling too; stride $=2$ roughly halves height and width.

6b7092e0f813.zh: 池化一句話重講：把鄰近活化收成「有沒有這塊拼圖」的摘要，所以小位移會改寫整塊輸入、卻常常只改一部分池化特徵；多數分類樂見這種局部不變，位置本身是答案時則要小心；stride 大於 1 時再順便縮小特徵圖，讓後面算得起、參數比較少。
6b7092e0f813.en: Pooling restated in one sentence: it gathers neighboring activations into a summary of "is this puzzle piece here", so a small shift rewrites the whole block of input but often changes only some of the pooled features; most classification welcomes this local invariance, but be careful when position itself is the answer; and with a stride greater than 1 it also shrinks the feature map, so later layers can afford the computation and have fewer parameters.

6fa2554b32d1.zh: 「拼圖挪一格，桌上全換人；pooling 只問有沒有這塊，不管它偏哪一格。」
6fa2554b32d1.en: "Nudge the puzzle one cell and the whole table changes hands; pooling only asks whether the piece is there, not which cell it drifted to."

bdd0f5d04d3b.zh: 教授祕笈：先驗把很多權重焊死成 0
bdd0f5d04d3b.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the prior welds many weights shut at 0

e33431b9bede.zh: 主線比喻是「先驗把很多權重焊死成 0」。全連接像允許每一根電線都自己學；卷積與池化一上場，工程師直接拿出焊槍：這根不該存在的線，焊死，永遠是 0，不准學。 這不是初始化碰巧抽到 0，而是架構層級的硬約束——課本叫它無限強先驗（infinitely strong prior）（Fig. 10）。焊完之後，模型只能在「局部、稀疏、可共享」的假設裡找解；後面的動態池化、空間金字塔、全域平均池化，都是同一把焊槍的延伸用法：該為 0 的繼續為 0，該彈性的地方才開一小扇窗。
e33431b9bede.en: The main analogy is "the prior welds many weights shut at 0". A fully connected layer is like letting every single wire learn on its own; once convolution and pooling come on stage, the engineer pulls out a welding torch: this wire shouldn't exist, weld it shut, it's 0 forever, no learning allowed. This is not an initialization that happened to draw 0; it is a hard constraint at the architecture level, which the textbook calls an infinitely strong prior (Fig. 10). After the welding, the model can only look for solutions within the "local, sparse, shareable" assumption; the dynamic pooling, spatial pyramid and global average pooling later on are all extensions of the same welding torch: what should be 0 stays 0, and only where flexibility is needed does a small window get opened.

6a5c9115e84d.zh: 先講白話：有些連線我們根本不讓它存在。 弱先驗只是「比較希望權重小」；較強先驗把分布收得更窄；無限強先驗等於直接規定某些權重 $=0$（Fig. 10 的三級梯子）。
6a5c9115e84d.en: Plain words first: some connections we simply don't allow to exist. A weak prior only "would rather the weights be small"; a stronger prior squeezes the distribution narrower; an infinitely strong prior amounts to directly decreeing that certain weights $=0$ (the three-rung ladder in Fig. 10).

47979d62fb49.zh: 為什麼需要它？高維裡沒有方法能處處表現好，所以要押注稀疏（betting on sparsity）——選一個在稀疏假設下會贏的程式。這也符合奧卡姆剃刀：較簡單的解通常較可能是對的。KP-5 已經用「每個輸出只看一小塊感受野」講過稀疏；本節把它升級成先驗語言，並告訴你池化區不必焊死在固定鄰域、輸入尺寸也不必先砍成同一張圖、結尾不一定要接一座巨型全連接。
47979d62fb49.en: Why do we need it? In high dimensions no method can do well everywhere, so we bet on sparsity: choose a procedure that wins under a sparsity assumption. This also fits Occam's razor: simpler solutions are usually more likely to be correct. KP-5 already explained sparsity with "each output looks only at a small receptive field"; this section upgrades it into the language of priors, and tells you that pooling regions need not be welded to a fixed neighborhood, inputs need not first be cut to the same image size, and the end need not be a giant fully connected layer.

2cf1d71af869.zh: 符號逐個拆（Fig. 10–11 與 GAP）
2cf1d71af869.en: Taking the symbols apart one by one (Fig. 10–11 and GAP)

b7255d72a5d7.zh: 把一層想成矩陣 $W$。全連接的 $W$ 幾乎每格都可學。卷積等價於 $W$ 裡絕大多數格子被焊成 0，剩下的非零塊還要在空間上重複出現（參數共享）。池化更狠：它通常沒有可學權重，摘要規則寫死。
b7255d72a5d7.en: Think of a layer as a matrix $W$. In a fully connected layer almost every cell of $W$ is learnable. Convolution is equivalent to having the vast majority of cells welded to 0 in $W$, and the remaining nonzero blocks must also repeat across space (parameter sharing). Pooling goes further: it usually has no learnable weights at all, and the summary rule is hard-coded.

767447ebae8c.zh: 池化不必永遠對「空間上剛好相鄰」的格子做。動態池化（dynamic pooling）依內容或結構決定誰跟誰一起摘要——例如對顯著點做 K-means，同一群再池化；也可以訓練時學一套固定結構，之後對所有樣本共用。
767447ebae8c.en: Pooling does not always have to act on cells that "happen to be adjacent in space". Dynamic pooling decides by content or structure which features are summarized together, for example running K-means on salient points and pooling within each cluster; one can also learn a fixed structure during training and then share it across all samples.

b06ce94a3fdb.zh: 輸入寬高常常不同。硬裁切或 zero padding 會丟掉資訊。兩條彈性路：
b06ce94a3fdb.en: Input widths and heights often differ. Hard cropping or zero padding throws information away. Two flexible routes:

fed5399f831b.zh: Fig. 11：大圖用較寬的池化核、小圖用較窄的核，讓輸出對齊到同一空間尺寸。
fed5399f831b.en: Fig. 11: a wider pooling kernel for large images, a narrower kernel for small ones, so the output lines up at the same spatial size.

eb878448a2a2.zh: 空間金字塔池化（spatial pyramid pooling, SPP）：最後一層改成固定數量的箱子（bins），箱子隨輸入縮放，網路可以吃任意尺寸。
eb878448a2a2.en: Spatial pyramid pooling (SPP): the last layer becomes a fixed number of bins that scale with the input, so the network can take any size.

818eca72b2d0.zh: 結尾的 全域平均池化（global average pooling, GAP） 把每張特徵圖壓成一個數，再接到類別。巨型全連接被焊掉一大塊，同時強迫「一張特徵圖對應一個語意」。
818eca72b2d0.en: At the end, global average pooling (GAP) squeezes each feature map into one number, which is then connected to the classes. A big chunk of the giant fully connected layer gets welded away, and at the same time it enforces "one feature map corresponds to one semantic concept".

bc3c6a8a0438.zh: 數值真的算一遍：焊掉多少、GAP 省多少
bc3c6a8a0438.en: Actually work the numbers: how much gets welded, how much GAP saves

e257140e5a74.zh: 同一張 $28\times 28$ 圖，輸出也要 $28\times 28$（same padding）。全連接權重個數
e257140e5a74.en: The same $28\times 28$ image, with a $28\times 28$ output as well (same padding). Number of fully connected weights

32ad600499d8.zh: 改成 $5\times 5$ 卷積：每個輸出位置只看 $25$ 個輸入，其餘連線不存在。非零個數
32ad600499d8.en: Switch to a $5\times 5$ convolution: each output position looks at only $25$ inputs, and the other connections don't exist. Number of nonzeros

a92596c68a01.zh: ——大約 96.8% 的權重根本不准學。真正拿去訓練的還只有 $25$ 個共享參數（外加 bias），不是那 $19{,}600$ 個獨立數字。
a92596c68a01.en: That is, about 96.8% of the weights are not allowed to learn at all. And what actually gets trained is only $25$ shared parameters (plus a bias), not those $19{,}600$ independent numbers.

c83eb86fc093.zh: 再看 GAP 對巨型 FC 的帳。最後一層特徵圖 $7\times 7\times 512$，要接到 $1000$ 類：
c83eb86fc093.en: Now look at GAP's bill against the giant FC. The last feature map is $7\times 7\times 512$ and has to connect to $1000$ classes:

9a00099fb26d.zh: GAP 把結尾參數砍到約五十分之一，還順便焊掉「空間每一格各自連到每個類別」那些冗餘線。這不是小技巧，是同一把焊槍打在網路尾巴上。
9a00099fb26d.en: GAP cuts the final-layer parameters to about one fiftieth, and along the way welds off the redundant wires of "every spatial cell connected separately to every class". This isn't a small trick; it's the same welding torch applied to the network's tail.

4ec9e5d126c1.zh: 直覺會說：「權重愈多愈強，焊成 0 不是自己砍手？」反轉是：先驗不是來削弱你的，是來禁止你學錯的自由度。 那些被焊死的連線，本來就對應「右上角像素不該直接決定左下角的邊緣」這種不該存在的故事。無限強先驗看起來獨裁，其實是把 KP-5 的稀疏與共享寫成不能討價還價的憲法。真正要彈性的地方——圖有大有小、池化區可依內容改——課本不是放寬焊槍，而是換一種焊法：焊的是「輸出箱子數量固定」，不是「輸入必須先裁成 $224\times 224$」。
4ec9e5d126c1.en: Intuition says: "More weights means more power, so isn't welding them to 0 just cutting off your own hand?" The twist: the prior isn't there to weaken you; it's there to forbid degrees of freedom you would learn wrong. Those welded connections correspond to stories that shouldn't exist anyway, like "a top-right pixel directly decides an edge in the bottom-left". An infinitely strong prior looks dictatorial, but it really writes KP-5's sparsity and sharing into a non-negotiable constitution. Where real flexibility is needed (images big and small, pooling regions that change with content), the textbook doesn't loosen the welding torch; it welds differently: what gets welded is "the number of output bins is fixed", not "the input must first be cropped to $224\times 224$".

552b18e1975a.zh: 同一套「先焊死再學習」換成公司權限：新進員工不是每個資料夾都能改，大多數路徑直接沒權限（權重 $=0$），只開放他職位該碰的那一小區。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：$32\times 32$ 輸入、same padding 的 $3\times 3$ 卷積，對上全連接 $1024\times 1024$，被焊成 0 的格子有幾個？非零連線有幾個？提示：先算 $32^{2}$，再分別乘 $1024$ 與 $9$。若你算出非零超過十萬，多半是把「共享後的 9 個參數」跟「展開矩陣的非零格」搞混了——題目問的是展開矩陣裡有多少格不是 0。
552b18e1975a.en: Move the same "weld first, then learn" idea to company permissions: a new hire can't edit every folder; most paths have no permission at all (weight $=0$), and only the small area their job needs is opened up. Now work it out yourself with new numbers (answer not published): a $32\times 32$ input and a $3\times 3$ convolution with same padding, versus a fully connected $1024\times 1024$. How many cells are welded to 0? How many nonzero connections are there? Hint: first compute $32^{2}$, then multiply by $1024$ and by $9$ respectively. If you get more than a hundred thousand nonzeros, you have most likely confused "the 9 parameters after sharing" with "the nonzero cells of the unrolled matrix"; the question asks how many cells of the unrolled matrix are not 0.

26d73d5b175c.zh: 誤解「無限強先驗＝初始化成 0」。初始化成 0 還能被梯度改回來；焊死是結構上這條邊不存在，梯度也不會把它救活。
26d73d5b175c.en: Misconception: "infinitely strong prior = initializing to 0". Initializing to 0 can still be changed back by gradients; welding shut means this edge does not exist in the structure, and gradients won't bring it back to life either.

fbf34d4eb97e.zh: 誤解「GAP 只是平均，跟先驗無關」。GAP 等於把「特徵圖每個空間位置連到每個類別」的那些權重整批焊掉，改成先空間平均再做一個瘦線性層。
fbf34d4eb97e.en: Misconception: "GAP is just averaging and has nothing to do with priors". GAP amounts to welding off, in one batch, all the weights that "connect each spatial position of a feature map to each class", replacing them with a spatial average first and then one slim linear layer.

8b397f69c0d3.zh: 誤解「輸入一定要先 resize／crop 成同一張圖」。Fig. 11 調核寬、SPP 用固定 bins，就是為了讓網路吃不同尺寸；裁切是圖省事，不是定理。
8b397f69c0d3.en: Misconception: "inputs must first be resized / cropped to the same image". Fig. 11's tuned kernel width and SPP's fixed bins exist precisely so the network can take different sizes; cropping is for convenience, not a theorem.

8674ff3747b2.zh: KP-5：稀疏連接與參數共享；本節把同一件事叫做無限強先驗（Fig. 10）。
8674ff3747b2.en: KP-5: sparse connectivity and parameter sharing; this section calls the same thing an infinitely strong prior (Fig. 10).

64c5dfc5d8e5.zh: KP-8、KP-9：池化怎麼算、為什麼局部平移較穩；本節補上「池化區可以動態、核寬可以隨圖變」。
64c5dfc5d8e5.en: KP-8, KP-9: how pooling is computed and why it is more stable under local translation; this section adds "pooling regions can be dynamic, kernel width can vary with the image".

5e1ea789f022.zh: KP-12：AlexNet 尾巴三層全連接非常肥；GAP 就是後來用來拆那座肥尾巴的焊槍。
5e1ea789f022.en: KP-12: AlexNet's tail of three fully connected layers is very fat; GAP is the welding torch later used to dismantle that fat tail.

55f1d4fc93cb.zh: KP-14：Inception 的 $1\times 1$ 降維也是在減少不必要的自由度，精神相近、手段不同。
55f1d4fc93cb.en: KP-14: Inception's $1\times 1$ dimensionality reduction also cuts unnecessary degrees of freedom: a similar spirit, different means.

7915ef6ba3a0.zh: 無限強先驗一句話重講：卷積與池化等於把不該存在的權重焊死成 0，強迫模型走稀疏假設；動態池化與 SPP 讓「誰跟誰一起摘要、箱子多大」可以隨內容或輸入尺寸調整；GAP 則把末端巨型全連接再焊瘦，讓每張特徵圖直接對上語意。
7915ef6ba3a0.en: The infinitely strong prior restated in one sentence: convolution and pooling amount to welding the weights that shouldn't exist shut at 0, forcing the model onto the sparsity assumption; dynamic pooling and SPP let "who gets summarized with whom, and how big the bins are" adjust to content or input size; and GAP welds the giant fully connected layer at the end slimmer still, so each feature map maps directly to a semantic concept.

42207842d2f8.zh: 「先驗不是希望你小，是焊槍：不該連的線永遠是 0。」
42207842d2f8.en: "A prior isn't hoping you're small; it's a welding torch: wires that shouldn't connect are 0 forever."

a80df62095eb.zh: 教授祕笈：音量旋鈕太大爆音、太小沒聲
a80df62095eb.en: Professor's Secret Notes: a volume knob too high blasts, too low is silent

b38f700f9e7a.zh: 主線比喻是「音量旋鈕太大爆音、太小沒聲」。卷積核裡的數字就是權重，訓練前一定要先轉到某個音量，反向傳播才有起點可走。旋鈕擰到 11，前向訊號炸成爆音、反向梯度跟著爆炸；轉到幾乎沒聲，訊號與梯度在層與層之間消失。Xavier／Glorot 與 He 就是依層的寬度把旋鈕轉到「剛好聽得見」；嫌隨機太盲，也可以先用資料做 PCA，把常出現的聲紋焊成初始核。整節 §4 講的就是這顆旋鈕怎麼轉。
b38f700f9e7a.en: The main analogy is "a volume knob: too high and it blasts, too low and there's no sound." The numbers in the convolution kernels are the weights; before training you have to turn the knob to some volume, or backpropagation has no starting point. Crank the knob to 11 and the forward signal blasts into distortion, with the backward gradients exploding along with it; turn it down to almost nothing and the signal and gradients vanish from layer to layer. Xavier/Glorot and He turn the knob, based on the layer's width, to "just loud enough to hear"; if random feels too blind, you can also run PCA on the data first and solder the frequently occurring sound patterns in as initial kernels. All of §4 is about how to turn this knob.

69d0b5296c9e.zh: 先講白話：核就是權重，沒賦值，梯度下降無處可站。 優化仍是 Chap. 3 的反向傳播——迭代算法必須有初值。
69d0b5296c9e.en: Plain words first: the kernels are the weights; without values, gradient descent has nowhere to stand. The optimization is still Chap. 3's backpropagation, and an iterative algorithm needs initial values.

2ebb854a7531.zh: 為什麼不能隨便轉？權重可看成一層線性變換的投影矩陣；隨機初始化對應隨機投影（random projection）。Johnson–Lindenstrauss 引理說：隨機投影能以高機率近似保留成對距離。這解釋了為什麼「不太大也不太小的亂數」常常是堪用起點——但「不太大不太小」必須對準激活函數，否則深度一加，音量仍會失控。
2ebb854a7531.en: Why can't you turn it just anyhow? The weights can be seen as the projection matrix of a layer's linear transformation; random initialization corresponds to a random projection. The Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma says random projections approximately preserve pairwise distances with high probability. This explains why "random numbers neither too large nor too small" are often a usable starting point, but "neither too large nor too small" has to be matched to the activation function; otherwise, once the network gets deep, the volume still gets out of control.

ca4c576029fb.zh: 三條路：純高斯／均勻亂數（現代已少當預設）、顧變異數的 Xavier／He、以及非監督的 PCA 核。前兩類是實務主力。
ca4c576029fb.en: Three routes: plain Gaussian/uniform random numbers (now rarely the default), the variance-aware Xavier/He, and unsupervised PCA kernels. The first two are the workhorses in practice.

e5348c4edfae.en: The symbols one by one (random, Xavier/He, PCA)

257fcde335f9.zh: 令一層輸入維度（扇入）為 $n_{\mathrm{in}}$、輸出維度（扇出）為 $n_{\mathrm{out}}$，權重 $W$ 的每個元素獨立抽自均值 $0$、標準差 $\sigma$ 的分布。
257fcde335f9.en: Let a layer's input dimension (fan-in) be $n_{\mathrm{in}}$ and its output dimension (fan-out) $n_{\mathrm{out}}$; each element of the weight $W$ is drawn independently from a distribution with mean $0$ and standard deviation $\sigma$.

bae991a1cc06.zh: Xavier／Glorot 配合 tanh、sigmoid 這類會飽和的激活，把初始變異數設成進出平均：
bae991a1cc06.en: Xavier/Glorot goes with saturating activations such as tanh and sigmoid, and sets the initial variance using the average of input and output:

5052a26bf660.zh: He 配合 ReLU（以及其變體），ReLU 會把負半邊敲掉，變異數要補回來：
5052a26bf660.en: He goes with ReLU (and its variants); ReLU knocks out the negative half, so the variance has to be made up:

08aecd6d00e7.zh: 太大於是爆炸、太小於是消失：前向活化與反向梯度都會在層間被乘上同一批過大或過小的數。
08aecd6d00e7.en: Too large, so it explodes; too small, so it vanishes: both the forward activations and the backward gradients get multiplied, layer after layer, by the same batch of numbers that are too large or too small.

4062e24f000c.zh: 非監督路線：把一層權重切成與步幅 $s$ 對應的 patch；每個 patch 再微平移幾個像素，原樣與平移後一起拉成行向量，送進 PCA。得到 $s\times s$ 的特徵向量矩陣，當作該層初始核——對小平移穩健的方向會被 PCA 優先抓出來。同一流程可逐層重複。
4062e24f000c.en: The unsupervised route: cut a layer's weights into patches corresponding to the stride $s$; each patch is also shifted slightly by a few pixels, and the original and shifted versions are flattened together into column vectors and fed into PCA. The resulting $s\times s$ eigenvector matrix serves as the layer's initial kernels; directions robust to small shifts are picked up first by PCA. The same procedure can be repeated layer by layer.

63f12b82b0b2.zh: 數值真的算一遍：五層連乘，旋鈕差在小數點
63f12b82b0b2.en: Actually run the numbers: five layers multiplied together, the knob differs in the decimal point

9f1586dc2beb.zh: 先看線性五層、$x=1$，每層一個權重 $w$，輸出 $w^{5}$。這是爆音／沒聲最乾脆的帳：
9f1586dc2beb.en: First look at five linear layers with $x=1$ and one weight $w$ per layer: the output is $w^{5}$. This is the bluntest accounting of blasting vs. silence:

191be26eb9d0.en: Blasting; the forward pass has already blown up

9402867240a4.zh: 沒聲，反向梯度也會瘦成灰塵
9402867240a4.en: Silence; the backward gradients also waste away to dust

48f378abdfc0.zh: 深度不是 5 而是 20 時，$5^{20}$ 與 $0.1^{20}$ 更是天文與灰塵，沒有中間值。
48f378abdfc0.en: When the depth is 20 instead of 5, $5^{20}$ and $0.1^{20}$ are even more astronomical and dust-like, with no middle ground.

2a58c82c8ada.zh: 再轉一層真的 CNN 旋鈕。隱藏層 $n_{\mathrm{in}}=n_{\mathrm{out}}=256$：
2a58c82c8ada.en: Now turn the knob on a real CNN layer. Hidden layer $n_{\mathrm{in}}=n_{\mathrm{out}}=256$:

13f3ab1ccddb.zh: 若有人堅持用 $\sigma=1$ 配這層：對 Xavier 來說大了 $1/0.0625=16$ 倍；五層連乘，音量尺度大約是 $16^{5}=1{,}048{,}576$ 倍——這就是爆音的來源。反過來 $\sigma=0.001$ 配 He，相對 $0.0884$ 小了約 $88$ 倍，五層後只剩約 $1.9\times 10^{-10}$，梯度消失不是修辭，是算術。
13f3ab1ccddb.en: If someone insists on using $\sigma=1$ for this layer: compared with Xavier it is $1/0.0625=16$ times too large; multiplied over five layers, the volume scale is roughly $16^{5}=1{,}048{,}576$ times, and that is where the blasting comes from. Conversely, $\sigma=0.001$ against He is about $88$ times smaller than $0.0884$, and after five layers only about $1.9\times 10^{-10}$ is left. Vanishing gradients are not a figure of speech; they are arithmetic.

8420ad520e6a.zh: PCA 那條路用小數字記結構即可：步幅 $s=5$ 的核，收集原 patch 與平移 patch，PCA 吐出 $5\times 5$ 特徵向量——那 25 個數字就是這一層的初始旋鈕位置，而且已經對齊「小平移不該改太多」的聲紋。
8420ad520e6a.en: For the PCA route, small numbers are enough to remember the structure: for a kernel with stride $s=5$, collect the original and shifted patches, and PCA spits out $5\times 5$ eigenvectors. Those 25 numbers are this layer's initial knob settings, already aligned with the sound pattern "a small shift shouldn't change much."

a8775a381b0e.zh: 直覺會說：「權重愈大，訊號愈強，學習愈快。」反轉是：太強跟太弱是同一種病，只是方向相反。 爆音讓激活飽和（tanh 貼在 $\pm 1$，ReLU 雖不飽和但數值溢出），梯度過不來；沒聲讓每層幾乎乘上 0，梯度同樣過不來。Xavier 與 He 不是兩套神秘儀式，差別只在激活吃不吃掉一半變異數：tanh／sigmoid 用進出平均，ReLU 用 $2/n_{\mathrm{in}}$。還有一個容易忽略的反轉：純高斯亂數不是「錯」，只是深度一加就不當預設——JL 保距給你信心，沒給你許可證把 $\sigma$ 轉到 1。
a8775a381b0e.en: Intuition says: "The larger the weights, the stronger the signal, and the faster the learning." The twist: too strong and too weak are the same illness, just in opposite directions. Blasting saturates the activations (tanh sticks at $\pm 1$; ReLU doesn't saturate but the numbers overflow), so the gradient can't get through; silence multiplies each layer by almost 0, so the gradient can't get through either. Xavier and He are not two mysterious rituals; the only difference is whether the activation eats half the variance: tanh/sigmoid use the average of in and out, ReLU uses $2/n_{\mathrm{in}}$. One more easily overlooked twist: plain Gaussian random numbers are not "wrong"; they just stop being the default once the network gets deep. JL distance preservation gives you confidence, not a license to turn $\sigma$ up to 1.

a91df7669877.zh: 同一顆音量旋鈕換成合唱：第一排小聲、第二排再小聲，到第十排觀眾什麼都聽不見；每一排都吼破音，混音台直接爆紅燈。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：$n_{\mathrm{in}}=100$、$n_{\mathrm{out}}=400$，寫出 $\sigma_{\mathrm{Xavier}}$ 與 $\sigma_{\mathrm{He}}$。提示：Xavier 分母是 $500$，He 只看扇入 $100$。若你把 He 寫成 $\sqrt{2/400}$，就是把扇出誤當成 ReLU 的尺度。
a91df7669877.en: Same volume knob, now with a choir: the first row sings softly, the second row softer still, and by the tenth row the audience hears nothing; if every row shouts until their voices crack, the mixing desk goes straight into the red. Now work it out yourself with numbers (answer not given): $n_{\mathrm{in}}=100$, $n_{\mathrm{out}}=400$; write down $\sigma_{\mathrm{Xavier}}$ and $\sigma_{\mathrm{He}}$. Hint: Xavier's denominator is $500$, He looks only at the fan-in $100$. If you wrote He as $\sqrt{2/400}$, you mistook the fan-out for ReLU's scale.

fb0dd0d68d38.zh: 誤解「初始化可以取代訓練」。初值只是起點；損失還是要靠反向傳播往下推。He 不會讓網路免訓。
fb0dd0d68d38.en: Misconception: "initialization can replace training." Initial values are only a starting point; the loss still has to be pushed down by backpropagation. He does not make training unnecessary.

5d2efca9f714.zh: 誤解「Xavier 給 ReLU、He 給 sigmoid」。剛好反了：Xavier／Glorot 配 tanh／sigmoid，He 配 ReLU。
5d2efca9f714.en: Misconception: "Xavier is for ReLU, He is for sigmoid." It's exactly the other way around: Xavier/Glorot goes with tanh/sigmoid, He with ReLU.

f07c93543033.zh: 誤解「$\sigma$ 愈大愈能避免消失」。太大改走爆炸；消失與爆炸是旋鈕兩端，不是「往大轉就安全」。
f07c93543033.en: Misconception: "the larger $\sigma$, the better it avoids vanishing." Too large switches to exploding; vanishing and exploding are the two ends of the knob, and "turning it up is safe" is false.

cd9f2ce275d4.zh: 誤解「PCA 初始化還需要標籤」。它用不加標的 patch（外加微平移），是非監督起點，不是 ImageNet 標註。
cd9f2ce275d4.en: Misconception: "PCA initialization still needs labels." It uses unlabeled patches (plus slight shifts); it is an unsupervised starting point, not ImageNet labels.

7819e1bd1697.zh: Chap. 3／反向傳播：沒有初值就沒有優化變數；旋鈕轉完，KP-3 的鏈式法則才接得上。
7819e1bd1697.en: Chap. 3 / backpropagation: without initial values there are no optimization variables; only once the knob is set can KP-3's chain rule take over.

ce600090e591.zh: KP-5、KP-6：核在空間上共享、對平移等價；亂轉旋鈕不會破壞這些結構，但會讓梯度還沒走到共享的好處就先死掉。
ce600090e591.en: KP-5, KP-6: kernels are shared across space and equivariant to translation; turning the knob carelessly doesn't break these structures, but it makes the gradients die before they ever get to benefit from sharing.

0daae43c65f3.zh: KP-9：PCA 刻意收集微平移 patch，就是在初始化階段預先買「局部位移不該改太多」的保險，跟池化的不變性同一方向。
0daae43c65f3.en: KP-9: PCA deliberately collects slightly shifted patches, which buys the insurance "a local shift shouldn't change much" in advance at initialization, in the same direction as pooling's invariance.

98ca47a8f176.zh: KP-12：AlexNet 全面改用 ReLU，實務上就該配 He，而不是沿用 sigmoid 時代的手感。
98ca47a8f176.en: KP-12: AlexNet switched to ReLU throughout, so in practice it should be paired with He, not with the habits of the sigmoid era.

df9ba0563a11.zh: 權重初始化一句話重講：核值即權重，音量太大爆炸、太小消失；隨機起點有 JL 保距當理論靠山，實務用 Xavier 配飽和激活、He 配 ReLU 把變異數接穩；若要用資料先行，就把原 patch 與微平移 patch 做 PCA，拿 $s\times s$ 特徵向量當初始核。
df9ba0563a11.en: Weight initialization in one sentence: kernel values are the weights; too much volume explodes, too little vanishes. A random starting point has JL distance preservation as its theoretical backing; in practice, Xavier for saturating activations and He for ReLU keep the variance steady. If you want to let the data go first, run PCA on the original and slightly shifted patches and take the $s\times s$ eigenvectors as the initial kernels.

f353f293332f.zh: 「旋鈕太大爆音、太小沒聲；tanh 用 Xavier，ReLU 用 He。」
f353f293332f.en: "Knob too high blasts, too low is silent; Xavier for tanh, He for ReLU."

16e7d0862288.zh: 教授祕笈：ImageNet 大賽把 LeNet 放大
16e7d0862288.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the ImageNet contest scales up LeNet

9164d3d88591.zh: 主線比喻是「ImageNet 大賽把 LeNet 放大」。KP-2 的 LeNet 是 1998 年認手寫數字的小塔：幾層卷積、幾層池化、尾巴一點全連接。2012 年的 AlexNet 幾乎是同一張施工圖，只是場地換成 ILSVRC 這場影像奧運——圖片從 $28\times 28$ 灰階變成 $224\times 224$ 彩色、類別從 10 變成 1000、參數從幾萬變成約 6000 萬。骨架沒變：五層卷積再接三層全連接，一共八層。變的是場地規模、雙 GPU 硬體、ReLU、局部響應正規化，以及重疊池化。後面 VGG、GoogLeNet、ResNet 都在同一座競技場上較勁，所以這一站先把場地與第一個引爆點講清楚。
9164d3d88591.en: The main analogy is "the ImageNet contest scales up LeNet." KP-2's LeNet is the small tower from 1998 that recognized handwritten digits: a few convolutional layers, a few pooling layers, and a bit of fully connected at the tail. 2012's AlexNet is almost the same blueprint, only the arena became ILSVRC, the Olympics of images: images went from $28\times 28$ grayscale to $224\times 224$ color, classes from 10 to 1000, and parameters from tens of thousands to about 60 million. The skeleton didn't change: five convolutional layers followed by three fully connected layers, eight layers in all. What changed were the scale of the arena, the two-GPU hardware, ReLU, local response normalization, and overlapping pooling. VGG, GoogLeNet, and ResNet later all competed in the same arena, so this stop first explains the arena and the first spark.

f7823f621407.zh: 先講白話：不是發明一種全新的層，是把已經會的 CNN 放大到夠嚇人力氣的資料與解析度。
f7823f621407.en: Plain words first: it's not the invention of a brand-new kind of layer; it's scaling an already-known CNN up to data and resolution of frightening size.

4b0ae223a8e4.zh: ImageNet 約 1500 萬 張標註圖、約 22,000 類，從網路上蒐集、用 Amazon Mechanical Turk 人工標註。每年的 ILSVRC 是它的精選子集：約 120 萬 張、1000 類、每類約 1000 張，RGB、$224\times 224$。AlexNet 由 Krizhevsky 在 Hinton 指導下提出（Sutskever 共同作者），拿下 ILSVRC 2012，常被視為深度學習打進電腦視覺的元年。當時單卡約 3 GB 顯存塞不下，網路拆到兩張 GPU。
4b0ae223a8e4.en: ImageNet has about 15 million labeled images in about 22,000 classes, collected from the web and labeled by hand through Amazon Mechanical Turk. The annual ILSVRC is a curated subset of it: about 1.2 million images, 1000 classes, about 1000 per class, RGB, $224\times 224$. AlexNet was proposed by Krizhevsky under Hinton's supervision (with Sutskever as co-author), won ILSVRC 2012, and is often seen as year one of deep learning's entry into computer vision. At the time a single card's roughly 3 GB of memory couldn't hold it, so the network was split across two GPUs.

548550def21d.zh: 激活除了最後 softmax，其餘用 ReLU，收斂比飽和型快。第 1、2 層 ReLU 之後做 LRN；第 1、2、5 層後做 max pooling，核寬 3、stride 2，因此窗會重疊。損失是 1000 類的多項邏輯迴歸。
548550def21d.en: Apart from the final softmax, the activations are all ReLU, which converges faster than saturating ones. LRN follows the ReLU in layers 1 and 2; max pooling follows layers 1, 2, and 5, with kernel width 3 and stride 2, so the windows overlap. The loss is 1000-class multinomial logistic regression.

c400806a9f01.en: The symbols one by one (Fig. 12, Eqs. 7–8)

f593c7009774.en: Size of the eight layers (per the original book):

81e97e380131.zh: 第 1 層：輸入 $224\times 224\times 3$，96 個核 $11\times 11\times 3$，stride 4。

ace291ab3650.zh: 第 8 層：全連接 1000（一類一個）。

17ae30995ae5.zh: 全網約 6000 萬 參數、65 萬個神經元。ILSVRC 2010 上 top-1／top-5 錯誤率 $37.5\%$／$17.0\%$。
17ae30995ae5.en: The whole network has about 60 million parameters and 650,000 neurons. On ILSVRC 2010 the top-1/top-5 error rates were $37.5\%$/$17.0\%$.

ddae056a0b0b.zh: 局部響應正規化（式 (7)）：$a_{x,y}^{i}$ 是核 $i$ 在位置 $(x,y)$ 的 ReLU 輸出，$N$ 是該層核數，同一位置上對鄰近 $n$ 張特徵圖的平方求和，用來當「側抑制」：
ddae056a0b0b.en: Local response normalization (Eq. (7)): $a_{x,y}^{i}$ is the ReLU output of kernel $i$ at position $(x,y)$, $N$ is the number of kernels in the layer, and the squares over the $n$ neighboring feature maps at the same position are summed, acting as "lateral inhibition":

deb2e1801555.zh: 損失（式 (8)）先寫最大化正確類的 softmax 機率，再改成最小化其負值，以配合慣用的「往下優化」：
deb2e1801555.en: The loss (Eq. (8)) is first written as maximizing the softmax probability of the correct class, then turned into minimizing its negative, to match the usual "optimize downhill" convention:

e87fe184a2a0.zh: 其中 $o_{j}$ 是 softmax 前的第 $j$ 個分數。注意：這裡最小化的是 $-\mathbb{P}$，不是後來更常見的交叉熵 $-\log\mathbb{P}$。
e87fe184a2a0.en: Here $o_{j}$ is the $j$-th score before the softmax. Note: what is minimized here is $-\mathbb{P}$, not the later, more common cross-entropy $-\log\mathbb{P}$.

64c963fa261d.zh: 數值真的算一遍：LRN 與三類 softmax
64c963fa261d.en: Actually run the numbers: LRN and a three-class softmax

f9836b295cf1.zh: 先把式 (7) 代入真數字。設某位置五張鄰近特徵圖的 ReLU 輸出為 $1,2,3,2,1$，我們正規化中間那個 $a=3$，平方和
f9836b295cf1.en: First plug real numbers into Eq. (7). Suppose the ReLU outputs of five neighboring feature maps at some position are $1,2,3,2,1$, and we normalize the middle one, $a=3$; the sum of squares is

61cd43208fc3.en: The base of the denominator is $k+\alpha\cdot 19=2+10^{-4}\times 19=2.0019$. Next,

f1354db0c010.zh: 同一位置若鄰近都很安靜、平方和只有自己的 $9$：底數 $2.0009$，$2.0009^{0.75}\approx 1.682$，$b\approx 3/1.682\approx 1.783$。$\alpha$ 很小，所以 LRN 是溫和的側抑制，不是把大值砍半；它要的是「鄰居太吵時你稍微讓一點」。
f1354db0c010.en: If at the same position the neighbors are all quiet and the sum of squares is only its own $9$: base $2.0009$, $2.0009^{0.75}\approx 1.682$, $b\approx 3/1.682\approx 1.783$. $\alpha$ is tiny, so LRN is a gentle lateral inhibition, not a cut of large values in half; what it wants is "when the neighbors are too loud, give way a little."

8c338011c000.zh: 再看式 (8) 的三類玩具版（結構與 1000 類相同）。分數 $o=(2,\,1,\,0)$，正確類是第一類：
8c338011c000.en: Next, a three-class toy version of Eq. (8) (same structure as with 1000 classes). Scores $o=(2,\,1,\,0)$, and the correct class is the first:

3950c4fdc9c2.zh: 訓練就是把 $-\mathbb{P}$ 再往下推（等價於把正確類機率往上推）。放大 LeNet 之後，優化目標的形狀沒變，只是分母從 10 類變成 1000 類。
3950c4fdc9c2.en: Training pushes $-\mathbb{P}$ further down (equivalently, pushes the correct-class probability up). After scaling up LeNet, the shape of the optimization objective doesn't change; only the denominator goes from 10 classes to 1000.

0a3f431c6d90.zh: 直覺會說：「2012 的爆發一定是發明了全新的層。」反轉是：層的種類 LeNet 年代就有了；爆的是場地、深度、ReLU 與硬體。 八層骨架仍是 5 conv + 3 FC，只是 $11\times 11$ 大核、96 張圖、雙 GPU、6000 萬參數把小塔拉成摩天樓。另一個反轉藏在式 (8)：你若自動腦補成交叉熵 $-\log\mathbb{P}$，會以為課本寫錯。原書明確最小化的是 $-\mathbb{P}$；兩者單調相關，梯度尺度不同，實務上後來多半改用 $-\log\mathbb{P}$，但這一站先照著式 (8) 走。
0a3f431c6d90.en: Intuition says: "The 2012 explosion must have come from inventing a brand-new layer." The twist: the kinds of layers already existed in LeNet's day; what exploded were the arena, the depth, ReLU, and the hardware. The eight-layer skeleton is still 5 conv + 3 FC; it's just that the $11\times 11$ large kernels, 96 maps, two GPUs, and 60 million parameters stretched the small tower into a skyscraper. Another twist hides in Eq. (8): if you automatically fill it in as the cross-entropy $-\log\mathbb{P}$, you'll think the textbook made a mistake. The original book explicitly minimizes $-\mathbb{P}$; the two are monotonically related but have different gradient scales. In practice people later mostly switched to $-\log\mathbb{P}$, but at this stop we follow Eq. (8) as written.

fd4a4630dd28.zh: 同一套「把小模型放大到大賽場地」換成從認十種郵票的小網路，改去認一千種鳥——相機解析度變高、資料多了兩個數量級，骨架仍是卷積加全連接，只是層更寬、尾巴更肥。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：分數 $o=(3,\,0,\,0)$，正確類是第一類，求 $\mathbb{P}$ 與 $-\mathbb{P}$。提示：$e^{3}\approx 20.09$。若你算出機率小於 $0.8$，多半是分母少加了兩個 $e^{0}=1$。
fd4a4630dd28.en: The same "scale a small model up to the big contest arena," now as a small network that recognized ten kinds of stamps switching to recognizing a thousand kinds of birds: the camera resolution goes up, the data grows by two orders of magnitude, and the skeleton is still convolution plus fully connected, just with wider layers and a fatter tail. Now work it out yourself with numbers (answer not given): scores $o=(3,\,0,\,0)$, the correct class is the first; find $\mathbb{P}$ and $-\mathbb{P}$. Hint: $e^{3}\approx 20.09$. If you get a probability below $0.8$, you most likely forgot to add the two $e^{0}=1$ terms to the denominator.

5bba52266729.zh: 誤解「ImageNet 就是 ILSVRC」。ImageNet 是約 15M／22k 類的大庫；ILSVRC 是約 1.2M／1000 類、$224\times 224$ 的競賽子集。規模寫反是考古題常客。
5bba52266729.en: Misconception: "ImageNet is ILSVRC." ImageNet is the big collection of about 15M images / 22k classes; ILSVRC is the contest subset of about 1.2M / 1000 classes, $224\times 224$. Swapping the scales is a classic exam trap.

d16d86ac5041.zh: 誤解「AlexNet 十六層全 $3\times 3$」。那是後面的 VGG（KP-13）。AlexNet 第一層是 $11\times 11$、第二層 $5\times 5$，後面才變 $3\times 3$。
d16d86ac5041.en: Misconception: "AlexNet has sixteen layers of all $3\times 3$." That is the later VGG (KP-13). AlexNet's first layer is $11\times 11$, the second $5\times 5$, and only after that does it become $3\times 3$.

6f6eaebc9d67.zh: 誤解「池化窗寬 3、stride 2 是不重疊」。步幅小於窗寬，相鄰窗會重疊；KP-13 的 VGG 才改成 $2\times 2$／stride 2 的不重疊池化。
6f6eaebc9d67.en: Misconception: "a pooling window of width 3 with stride 2 does not overlap." The stride is smaller than the window width, so adjacent windows overlap; it was KP-13's VGG that switched to non-overlapping $2\times 2$ / stride 2 pooling.

375f95190def.zh: 誤解「式 (8) 就是交叉熵」。交叉熵是 $-\log\mathbb{P}$；這裡是 $-\mathbb{P}$。
375f95190def.en: Misconception: "Eq. (8) is cross-entropy." Cross-entropy is $-\log\mathbb{P}$; here it is $-\mathbb{P}$.

41f36b2f9a7e.zh: KP-2：LeNet 的施工圖；本節是同一張圖放大到 ImageNet。
41f36b2f9a7e.en: KP-2: LeNet's blueprint; this section is the same blueprint scaled up to ImageNet.

d394a663ba90.zh: KP-8、KP-9：池化與下採樣；AlexNet 用重疊 max pool，還把 LRN 插在 ReLU 與池化之間。
d394a663ba90.en: KP-8, KP-9: pooling and downsampling; AlexNet uses overlapping max pooling and also inserts LRN between ReLU and pooling.

562b9304dcbf.zh: KP-10：末端 4096-4096-1000 非常肥，這就是後來 GAP 想拆掉的巨型 FC。
562b9304dcbf.en: KP-10: the 4096-4096-1000 tail is very fat; this is exactly the giant FC that GAP later aimed to remove.

01626b889115.zh: KP-11：全面 ReLU，旋鈕該配 He；LRN 則是飽和激活時代留下的側抑制，VGG 後來實驗發現可以拿掉。
01626b889115.en: KP-11: ReLU throughout, so the knob should be paired with He; LRN is lateral inhibition left over from the era of saturating activations, and VGG's experiments later found it could be removed.

86cba39a36c0.zh: KP-13 起：VGG、Inception、U-Net、ResNet 都還在 ILSVRC 這座場地上比賽。
86cba39a36c0.en: KP-13 onward: VGG, Inception, U-Net, and ResNet are all still competing in the ILSVRC arena.

9d7ad987fa66.zh: AlexNet 一句話重講：ImageNet 約 15M／22k 類，ILSVRC 子集約 1.2M／1000 類／$224\times 224$；AlexNet 把 LeNet 放大成八層（5 conv + 3 FC）、雙 GPU、ReLU、式 (7) 的 LRN、重疊池化 3／2、約 60M 參數，損失是式 (8) 的 1000 類多項邏輯迴歸。
9d7ad987fa66.en: AlexNet in one sentence: ImageNet is about 15M images / 22k classes, the ILSVRC subset about 1.2M / 1000 classes / $224\times 224$; AlexNet scales LeNet up to eight layers (5 conv + 3 FC), with two GPUs, ReLU, LRN from Eq. (7), overlapping pooling 3/2, and about 60M parameters, and its loss is the 1000-class multinomial logistic regression of Eq. (8).

e06445378d38.zh: 「場地換成 ImageNet，施工圖還是 LeNet；八層、雙卡、ReLU，把小塔放大。」
e06445378d38.en: "The arena became ImageNet, the blueprint is still LeNet; eight layers, two cards, ReLU, and the small tower scaled up."

dc2a76bee27f.zh: 教授祕笈：三個小 3×3 換一個大 7×7
dc2a76bee27f.en: Professor's Secret Notes: three small 3×3s for one big 7×7

36e0cda4a4ed.zh: 主線比喻是「三個小 $3\times 3$ 換一個大 $7\times 7$」。AlexNet 第一層還在用 $11\times 11$ 這種大窗去掃圖。VGG 來自牛津 Visual Geometry Group，它偏執地問：能不能幾乎全程改用很小的 $3\times 3$？三顆小核疊起來，感受野剛好等於一顆 $7\times 7$，參數卻少一截，中間還多兩次 ReLU。深度換來層次化特徵，大核不必一上場。整節就是這套「小磚塊砌高牆」的施工規範：stride 1、pad 1 保尺寸，縮小交給不重疊的 $2\times 2$ 池化。
36e0cda4a4ed.en: The main metaphor is "three small $3\times 3$s in exchange for one big $7\times 7$." AlexNet's first layer was still sweeping the image with a big $11\times 11$ window. VGG comes from Oxford's Visual Geometry Group, and it stubbornly asked: can we use tiny $3\times 3$ kernels almost all the way through? Stack three small kernels and the receptive field is exactly that of one $7\times 7$, yet with a good chunk fewer parameters and two extra ReLUs in between. Depth buys hierarchical features, so big kernels don't need to come out at all. This whole section is the building code for "laying small bricks into a tall wall": stride 1 and pad 1 keep the size, and shrinking is left to non-overlapping $2\times 2$ pooling.

2f7b20afb209.zh: 先講白話：把網路明顯加深，用一堆小核去學更有層次的特徵。 層數一多，參數暴增、過擬合風險跟著來——VGG 的對策是用更大的訓練集，而不是先把模型砍瘦。
2f7b20afb209.en: Plain words first: make the network significantly deeper and use a pile of small kernels to learn more hierarchical features. More layers means the parameters explode and the risk of overfitting comes along. VGG's answer is to use a larger training set, rather than first slimming the model down.

751790eba6d2.zh: 輸入 $224\times 224\times 3$，先減掉 RGB 各通道均值，讓資料零中心。卷積幾何幾乎寫死：stride 一律 1；$3\times 3$ 的 padding 為 1，剛好補回掃過時少掉的一圈，空間尺寸維持不變。降解析度不靠卷積，靠池化。少數地方會插 $1\times 1$ 做通道方向的線性變換，但主角仍是 $3\times 3$。
751790eba6d2.en: The input is $224\times 224\times 3$; first subtract the mean of each RGB channel to zero-center the data. The convolution geometry is practically hard-coded: the stride is always 1; the padding of the $3\times 3$ is 1, which exactly restores the ring lost during the sweep, so the spatial size stays unchanged. Resolution is reduced not by convolution but by pooling. In a few places a $1\times 1$ is inserted for a linear transformation along the channel direction, but the star is still $3\times 3$.

ff515e3fe660.zh: 跟 AlexNet 一個關鍵差別：多數 VGG 版本不用 LRN。實驗上它在 ILSVRC 沒幫忙，乾脆拿掉。
ff515e3fe660.en: One key difference from AlexNet: most VGG versions do not use LRN. Experimentally it didn't help on ILSVRC, so it was simply dropped.

d4ac6c82269a.zh: 符號逐個拆（感受野、尺寸、配方）
d4ac6c82269a.en: Symbols one by one (receptive field, size, recipe)

e2024d6d684c.zh: 一顆 $k\times k$、stride 1 的核，感受野邊長就是 $k$。再疊一顆 $3\times 3$，感受野每邊加 $2$。因此
e2024d6d684c.en: A $k\times k$ kernel with stride 1 has a receptive field of side length $k$. Stack one more $3\times 3$ and the receptive field grows by $2$ per side. Therefore

612ed1f24696.zh: 三層 $3\times 3$ 的感受野等於一層 $7\times 7$。參數呢？設進出通道都是 $C$，大核要 $7\times 7\times C\times C=49C^{2}$；三顆小核只要 $3\times 9C^{2}=27C^{2}$。少的那 $22C^{2}$ 不是免費的：中間多了兩次非線性，特徵可以先拆再組合。
612ed1f24696.en: The receptive field of three $3\times 3$ layers equals that of one $7\times 7$ layer. And the parameters? With $C$ channels in and out, the big kernel needs $7\times 7\times C\times C=49C^{2}$; the three small kernels need only $3\times 9C^{2}=27C^{2}$. The $22C^{2}$ saved does not come for free, though: there are two extra non-linearities in between, so features can be taken apart first and then recombined.

c8c152a6946d.en: Spatial size: with stride $1$, padding $1$ and a $3\times 3$ kernel

92b863cd923b.zh: Max pooling 視窗 $2$、stride $2$，相鄰窗不重疊，長寬各砍半。卷積堆完接三層全連接：4096、4096、1000（對應 ILSVRC 的 1000 類）。隱藏層全 ReLU，輸出 softmax。
92b863cd923b.en: Max pooling uses window $2$ and stride $2$, so adjacent windows do not overlap and the height and width are each halved. After the convolution stack come three fully connected layers: 4096, 4096, 1000 (for ILSVRC's 1000 classes). All hidden layers use ReLU; the output uses softmax.

270190082972.zh: 訓練配方：帶動量的 mini-batch SGD，batch size $256$，動量 $0.9$，權重衰減 $5\times 10^{-4}$，初始學習率 $10^{-2}$，驗證準確率平台期就除以 $10$。
270190082972.en: Training recipe: mini-batch SGD with momentum, batch size $256$, momentum $0.9$, weight decay $5\times 10^{-4}$, initial learning rate $10^{-2}$, divided by $10$ whenever validation accuracy plateaus.

20b7a7d6dab3.zh: 數值真的算一遍：$C=64$ 時小核省下什麼
20b7a7d6dab3.en: Actually working the numbers: what small kernels save at $C=64$

a6e555af3e23.zh: 尺寸也用真數字走一層。輸入 $224\times 224$，一次 $3\times 3$（pad 1、stride 1）仍是 $224\times 224$；一次 $2\times 2$ stride 2 池化變成 $112\times 112$。VGG 典型會做五次這種「保尺寸卷積 + 砍半池化」，$224/2^{5}=7$，尾巴特徵圖 $7\times 7$——再展平進 4096。這就是為什麼小核要配「尺寸不變的卷積」：深度全用在通道與感受野上，空間縮小留給池化，帳才算得清。
a6e555af3e23.en: Let's walk the size through one stage with real numbers too. Input $224\times 224$: one $3\times 3$ (pad 1, stride 1) still gives $224\times 224$; one $2\times 2$ stride-2 pooling gives $112\times 112$. VGG typically does this "size-preserving convolution + halving pooling" five times, $224/2^{5}=7$, so the final feature map is $7\times 7$, which is then flattened into the 4096 layer. That's why small kernels are paired with "size-preserving convolutions": depth goes entirely into channels and receptive field, spatial shrinking is left to pooling, and the bookkeeping stays clean.

ba585769bba0.zh: 動量 $0.9$、學習率 $10^{-2}$ 也不只是口訣：平台期除以 10 之後變成 $10^{-3}$，再平台再變成 $10^{-4}$。太大不穩、太小爬不動，跟 KP-11 的旋鈕是同一類故事，只是這裡轉的是更新步長。
ba585769bba0.en: Momentum $0.9$ and learning rate $10^{-2}$ aren't just a mantra either: after dividing by 10 at a plateau it becomes $10^{-3}$, and at the next plateau $10^{-4}$. Too large is unstable, too small can't make progress: the same kind of story as the knob in KP-11, except that here the knob being turned is the update step size.

7c75df7f04f7.zh: 直覺會說：「要看比較大的範圍，就該用比較大的核——AlexNet 第一層 $11\times 11$ 不是這樣嗎？」反轉是：大範圍可以靠深度疊出來，不必一層吃成大餅。 三個 $3\times 3$ 已經看到 $7\times 7$ 的鄰居，參數更少、中間還能 ReLU 兩次。第二個反轉：VGG 並沒有靠 LRN 或更花俏的正規化去撐深度，多數版本把 AlexNet 的 LRN 拿掉；它拿深度與資料量硬扛過擬合，而不是先把模型砍瘦。
7c75df7f04f7.en: Intuition says: "To see a larger area, you should use a larger kernel; isn't that what AlexNet's $11\times 11$ first layer does?" The twist: a large area can be built up through depth; you don't have to swallow it all in one layer. Three $3\times 3$s already see the $7\times 7$ neighborhood, with fewer parameters and two ReLUs in between. Second twist: VGG did not rely on LRN or fancier normalization to support its depth; most versions removed AlexNet's LRN. It fought overfitting with depth and data volume, rather than by first slimming the model down.

1b47b854c2f8.zh: 同一套「小磚塊砌出大窗」換成用三扇小窗看出去，視野等於一扇落地窗，但中間可以掛兩層窗紗（ReLU）濾光。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：兩層 $3\times 3$ 的感受野是多少？$C=128$ 時，兩層 $3\times 3$ 對上一層 $5\times 5$，各多少參數？提示：兩層 $3\times 3$ 感受野是 $5$；參數分別是 $18C^{2}$ 與 $25C^{2}$。若你算出小核比較貴，多半是把層數乘反了。
1b47b854c2f8.en: Take the same idea of "small bricks building a big window" and picture looking out through three small windows: the view equals one floor-to-ceiling window, but you can hang two layers of sheer curtains (ReLU) in between to filter the light. Now swap in numbers and compute it yourself (answer not given): what is the receptive field of two $3\times 3$ layers? At $C=128$, how many parameters do two $3\times 3$ layers have, versus one $5\times 5$ layer? Hint: the receptive field of two $3\times 3$ layers is $5$; the parameter counts are $18C^{2}$ and $25C^{2}$ respectively. If you find the small kernels cost more, you most likely multiplied the layers the wrong way around.

7c763553f154.zh: 誤解「padding 1 會讓特徵圖變大」。對 $3\times 3$、stride 1，pad 1 剛好補回邊界，尺寸不變；變大通常是 pad 給更多，或搞成轉置卷積。
7c763553f154.en: Misconception: "padding 1 makes the feature map bigger." For $3\times 3$ with stride 1, pad 1 exactly restores the border, so the size is unchanged; getting bigger usually means padding more, or mixing it up with transposed convolution.

7a3f1f6171d9.zh: 誤解「VGG 的池化跟 AlexNet 一樣重疊」。AlexNet 是窗 3／stride 2；VGG 是窗 2／stride 2，不重疊。
7a3f1f6171d9.en: Misconception: "VGG's pooling overlaps like AlexNet's." AlexNet uses window 3 / stride 2; VGG uses window 2 / stride 2, non-overlapping.

ac86d49c39b9.en: Misconception: "the end is 120-84-10." That's LeNet (KP-2). VGG is 4096-4096-1000.

c138f8be0e2a.zh: 誤解「深度網路一定要 LRN」。VGG 的實驗結論剛好相反：在 ILSVRC 上沒幫助，所以不用。
c138f8be0e2a.en: Misconception: "deep networks must have LRN." VGG's experiments concluded exactly the opposite: it didn't help on ILSVRC, so it isn't used.

9613a9df3e15.zh: KP-7：輸出尺寸公式；本節 pad 1、stride 1 是它最乾淨的特例，$H$ 映回 $H$。
9613a9df3e15.en: KP-7: the output size formula; this section's pad 1, stride 1 is its cleanest special case, mapping $H$ back to $H$.

01097287786c.zh: KP-12：AlexNet 用大核、重疊池化、LRN；VGG 幾乎逐項改成小核、不重疊池化、沒有 LRN。
01097287786c.en: KP-12: AlexNet uses large kernels, overlapping pooling and LRN; VGG changes almost every item to small kernels, non-overlapping pooling and no LRN.

a07c1e030bb2.zh: KP-9：縮小空間仍靠池化，不是靠 stride 很大的卷積。
a07c1e030bb2.en: KP-9: spatial shrinking still relies on pooling, not on convolutions with a large stride.

e851e280092b.zh: KP-14：Inception 會把 $5\times 5$ 留下來當多尺度的一條路，但先用 $1\times 1$ 減肥——跟 VGG「乾脆不用大核」是兩種省錢哲學。
e851e280092b.en: KP-14: Inception keeps the $5\times 5$ as one path for multiple scales, but slims down with $1\times 1$ first; that and VGG's "just don't use big kernels" are two different philosophies of saving money.

da9c81f2abd6.zh: VGG 一句話重講：幾乎全程 $3\times 3$（stride 1、pad 1 保尺寸），三顆小核換一顆 $7\times 7$ 的感受野卻更省參數；不重疊 $2\times 2$ max pool 負責砍半；減 RGB 均值；三層 FC 4096-4096-1000；ReLU；通常沒有 LRN。 用深度換感受野，不必一上來就上大核。
da9c81f2abd6.en: VGG in one sentence: $3\times 3$ almost everywhere (stride 1, pad 1 to keep the size); three small kernels in exchange for the receptive field of one $7\times 7$ with fewer parameters; non-overlapping $2\times 2$ max pool does the halving; subtract the RGB mean; three FC layers 4096-4096-1000; ReLU; usually no LRN. Trade depth for receptive field instead of going for big kernels right away.

b0b117465b99.zh: 「三個 $3\times 3$ 換一個 $7\times 7$：視野一樣大，磚比較便宜，中間還多兩次 ReLU。」
b0b117465b99.en: "Three $3\times 3$s for one $7\times 7$: the same field of view, cheaper bricks, and two extra ReLUs in between."

5e84e3182fb1.zh: 教授祕笈：先 1×1 瘦身再做貴的 5×5
5e84e3182fb1.en: Professor's Secret Notes: slim down with 1×1 before the expensive 5×5

747ac9d2436b.zh: 主線比喻是「先 $1\times 1$ 瘦身再做貴的 $5\times 5$」。想同時看小細節與稍大的範圍，最直的做法是 $1\times 1$、$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 並列再開一條池化——這是早期 Inception（Fig. 13）。可是 $5\times 5$ 掃在很厚的通道上，像讓一個很胖的人去做很貴的手術。最終版（Fig. 14）先用便宜的 $1\times 1$ 把通道壓瘦，再讓 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 上場；池化之後也接一刀 $1\times 1$，免得通道愈堆愈腫。GoogLeNet 把這種模組一層層疊起來，名字向 Google 與 LeNet 雙關致敬，拿下 ILSVRC 2014。
747ac9d2436b.en: The main metaphor is "slim down with $1\times 1$ first, then do the expensive $5\times 5$." If you want to see small details and slightly larger areas at the same time, the most direct approach is to run $1\times 1$, $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ in parallel and add a pooling path: that's the early Inception (Fig. 13). But a $5\times 5$ sweeping over very thick channels is like having a very heavy person undergo a very expensive surgery. The final version (Fig. 14) first squeezes the channels with a cheap $1\times 1$, then lets the $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ take the stage; after pooling it also adds a $1\times 1$ cut, so the channels don't keep swelling. GoogLeNet stacks these modules layer upon layer; its name is a double tribute to Google and LeNet, and it won ILSVRC 2014.

5e0138941f60.zh: 先講白話：多尺度還是要，但大核太貴，先減肥再動刀。 把網路容量做大，不外乎加深度或加寬度，痛點永遠是兩個：過擬合，以及計算量暴增。Inception 的解法是讓網路更稀疏——呼應 KP-10 的押注稀疏與奧卡姆剃刀：能用小結構表達的，就不要無謂地又寬又密。
5e0138941f60.en: Plain words first: you still want multiple scales, but big kernels are too expensive, so slim down before operating. To increase a network's capacity, you basically add depth or add width, and the pain points are always the same two: overfitting, and an explosion in computation. Inception's solution is to make the network sparser, echoing KP-10's betting on sparsity and Occam's razor: whatever a small structure can express should not be made needlessly wide and dense.

e27162542df7.zh: 淺層裡，相關神經元往往在空間上擠成團，這種局部團塊用 $1\times 1$ 就能做通道方向的線性變換。空間相關範圍較廣時才需要較大的核。課本因此只允許小核：$1\times 1$、$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$，外加 $3\times 3$ max pooling。愈靠近輸出、特徵愈抽象，需要更大的感受野，所以較深層會配比較多的 $3\times 3$ 與 $5\times 5$——也因此更需要前面那刀瘦身。
e27162542df7.en: In shallow layers, correlated neurons tend to cluster together spatially, and such local clusters can be handled by a $1\times 1$ as a linear transformation along the channel direction. Only when the spatial correlation spans a wider area are larger kernels needed. The textbook therefore allows only small kernels: $1\times 1$, $3\times 3$, $5\times 5$, plus a $3\times 3$ max pooling. The closer to the output, the more abstract the features and the larger the receptive field they need, so deeper layers get more $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$, and that is exactly why the slimming cut in front is needed even more.

912fc5a2ed63.zh: 前處理與 VGG 同類：$224\times 224\times 3$ 減 RGB 均值。模組內外卷積都用 ReLU。全貌見 Fig. 15。
912fc5a2ed63.en: The preprocessing is the same kind as VGG's: subtract the RGB mean from $224\times 224\times 3$. Convolutions inside and outside the modules all use ReLU. See Fig. 15 for the full picture.

d3f67aaa0f57.zh: 早期模組（Fig. 13）四條路並列，最後在通道維串接：
d3f67aaa0f57.en: The early module (Fig. 13) has four paths in parallel, concatenated along the channel dimension at the end:

d5702f5237f2.zh: 最終模組（Fig. 14）多了降維位置，這是整節的關鍵：
d5702f5237f2.en: The final module (Fig. 14) adds positions for dimensionality reduction, which is the key to this whole section:

6d35119e35bd.zh: 做昂貴的 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 之前，先 $1\times 1$ 壓通道。
6d35119e35bd.en: Before the expensive $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$, a $1\times 1$ first squeezes the channels.

a06a926bafa1.zh: max pooling 之後也接 $1\times 1$，避免 pooling 把通道數原封不動堆太胖。
a06a926bafa1.en: After max pooling there is also a $1\times 1$, so pooling doesn't pass the channel count through unchanged and pile it up too fat.

f25b653e38fd.zh: $1\times 1$ 核不看鄰居，它看的是同一個位置上各通道的線性組合——像在通道方向做一層小全連接，參數是 $C_{\mathrm{in}}\times C_{\mathrm{mid}}$，比 $5\times 5\times C_{\mathrm{in}}\times C_{\mathrm{out}}$ 便宜一個數量級。
f25b653e38fd.en: A $1\times 1$ kernel doesn't look at neighbors; what it looks at is a linear combination of the channels at the same position, like a small fully connected layer along the channel direction. Its parameters number $C_{\mathrm{in}}\times C_{\mathrm{mid}}$, an order of magnitude cheaper than $5\times 5\times C_{\mathrm{in}}\times C_{\mathrm{out}}$.

bc093614398e.zh: 數值真的算一遍：瘦身前後差十倍
bc093614398e.en: Actually working the numbers: a tenfold difference before and after slimming

e039cdf04782.zh: 設輸入通道 $C_{\mathrm{in}}=192$，想用 $5\times 5$ 產出 $C_{\mathrm{out}}=32$ 張特徵圖。不做 $1\times 1$：
e039cdf04782.en: Suppose there are $C_{\mathrm{in}}=192$ input channels and we want a $5\times 5$ to produce $C_{\mathrm{out}}=32$ feature maps. Without $1\times 1$:

4be6f122c50d.zh: 同一個空間位置、同一張輸出圖，視野仍是 $5\times 5$；變的是大核不再直接啃 192 個通道。把這套帳乘上 GoogLeNet 裡一串 Inception、再乘上 $3\times 3$ 那一條路，就是「最終版相對早期設計」為什麼能堆得更深卻算得起。
4be6f122c50d.en: Same spatial position, same output map, and the field of view is still $5\times 5$; what changes is that the big kernel no longer chews through 192 channels directly. Multiply this bookkeeping by the chain of Inception modules in GoogLeNet, and again by the $3\times 3$ path, and you get why "the final version compared with the early design" can be stacked deeper and still be affordable to compute.

c55365dc966b.zh: 池化後的 $1\times 1$ 用小數字也能看懂：pooling 不改通道數，192 張圖池完還是 192 張；若直接跟別條路串接，尾巴會腫。先 $1\times 1$ 收到 32 張，串接時才不會把後面每一層的 $C_{\mathrm{in}}$ 再炸一次。
c55365dc966b.en: The $1\times 1$ after pooling is easy to see with small numbers too: pooling doesn't change the channel count, so 192 maps are still 192 maps after pooling; if they were concatenated with the other paths directly, the tail would swell. A $1\times 1$ first gathers them into 32 maps, so the concatenation doesn't blow up the $C_{\mathrm{in}}$ of every later layer yet again.

bcf64a74bfac.zh: 直覺會說：「$1\times 1$ 核小到看不見鄰居，塞進來只會浪費層數。」反轉是：它本來就不是來擴大感受野的，是來減肥與混通道的。 感受野交給旁邊的 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$；$1\times 1$ 負責在動刀前把通道從 192 收到 16。第二個反轉：深層反而配置更多大核，不是更少——因為抽象特徵需要更大感受野。大核變多，才更要先瘦身，否則 Fig. 14 那刀就白設計了。
bcf64a74bfac.en: Intuition says: "A $1\times 1$ kernel is too small to see any neighbors; putting it in just wastes layers." The twist: it was never meant to enlarge the receptive field; it's there to slim down and mix channels. The receptive field is left to the $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ beside it; the $1\times 1$'s job is to reduce the channels from 192 to 16 before the operation. Second twist: deeper layers actually get more big kernels, not fewer, because abstract features need a larger receptive field. With more big kernels, slimming first matters even more; otherwise the cut designed into Fig. 14 would be pointless.

1d0566b66423.zh: 同一套「先瘦身再做貴運算」換成先把高解析底片縮成小樣張，確認構圖再拿去放大輸出——貴的是後面那步，前面那步很便宜。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：$C_{\mathrm{in}}=256$、$C_{\mathrm{mid}}=32$、$C_{\mathrm{out}}=64$ 的 $3\times 3$ 路，有 $1\times 1$ 與沒有 $1\times 1$ 各多少參數？提示：沒有時是 $3\cdot 3\cdot 256\cdot 64$；有時先加 $256\cdot 32$。若兩筆只差幾百，多半是漏乘了 $9$。
1d0566b66423.en: Swap the same idea of "slim down first, then do the expensive operation" for shrinking a high-resolution negative into a small proof sheet, checking the composition, and only then sending it off for an enlarged print: the expensive step is the later one, the earlier one is cheap. Now swap in numbers and compute it yourself (answer not given): for a $3\times 3$ path with $C_{\mathrm{in}}=256$, $C_{\mathrm{mid}}=32$, $C_{\mathrm{out}}=64$, how many parameters are there with a $1\times 1$ and without a $1\times 1$? Hint: without it, it's $3\cdot 3\cdot 256\cdot 64$; with it, first add $256\cdot 32$. If the two figures differ by only a few hundred, you most likely forgot to multiply by $9$.

837eb1058a0a.zh: 誤解「$1\times 1$ 只是擺好看」。它是通道方向的線性變換，也是降維器；拿掉之後 Fig. 14 相對 Fig. 13 的優勢立刻消失。
837eb1058a0a.en: Misconception: "the $1\times 1$ is just for show." It is a linear transformation along the channel direction and also a dimensionality reducer; remove it and Fig. 14's advantage over Fig. 13 disappears at once.

db6a6379d8d9.zh: 誤解「Inception 把所有核改成 $7\times 7$」。它明確只允許 $1\times 1$、$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 加 pooling；$7\times 7$ 是 VGG 用三顆 $3\times 3$ 去取代的那個大核，不是 Inception 的並列選單。
db6a6379d8d9.en: Misconception: "Inception changes all kernels to $7\times 7$." It explicitly allows only $1\times 1$, $3\times 3$, $5\times 5$ plus pooling; $7\times 7$ is the big kernel that VGG replaces with three $3\times 3$s, not an item on Inception's parallel menu.

d33568a2e7b8.zh: 誤解「深層應該多用 $1\times 1$、少用大核」。原文相反：愈深愈需要大感受野，$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 比例提高，所以才更需要 $1\times 1$ 控計算量。
d33568a2e7b8.en: Misconception: "deep layers should use more $1\times 1$ and fewer big kernels." The original text says the opposite: the deeper you go, the more you need a large receptive field, so the proportion of $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ goes up, and that is why $1\times 1$ is needed all the more to control the computation.

d7721ed5434a.zh: 誤解「GoogLeNet 輸入是 $32\times 32$ 灰階」。與 VGG 相同，是 $224\times 224\times 3$ 減均值。
d7721ed5434a.en: Misconception: "GoogLeNet's input is $32\times 32$ grayscale." Like VGG, it is $224\times 224\times 3$ with the mean subtracted.

3babaabfc28c.zh: KP-10：無限強先驗與押注稀疏；Inception 用多路小結構代替又寬又密的一層，是同一哲學的模組版。
3babaabfc28c.en: KP-10: the infinitely strong prior and betting on sparsity; Inception replacing one wide, dense layer with several small parallel structures is the modular version of the same philosophy.

1f176ab6572e.zh: KP-12：名字向 LeNet 致敬，場地仍是 ILSVRC；2014 的第一名換成這套模組塔。
1f176ab6572e.en: KP-12: the name honors LeNet, and the venue is still ILSVRC; in 2014 first place went to this tower of modules.

a349660913b2.zh: KP-13：VGG 用深度疊 $3\times 3$ 換大感受野；Inception 用並列多尺度，再用 $1\times 1$ 買單。兩種省大核的方法可以一起記。
a349660913b2.en: KP-13: VGG stacks $3\times 3$s in depth to buy a large receptive field; Inception runs multiple scales in parallel and pays for it with $1\times 1$. Remember the two ways of avoiding big kernels together.

f90544a48632.zh: KP-16：ResNet／DenseNet 後來用捷徑解決「疊太深訓不動」；Inception 先解決的是「疊太寬算不起」。
f90544a48632.en: KP-16: ResNet/DenseNet later used shortcuts to solve "stacked too deep to train"; what Inception solved first was "stacked too wide to compute."

184876925f86.zh: Inception 一句話重講：早期模組是 $1\times 1$、$3\times 3$、$5\times 5$、pool 並列；最終版在貴的 $3\times 3$、$5\times 5$ 之前以及 pooling 之後加 $1\times 1$ 降維；GoogLeNet 把模組疊起來，ReLU，224 輸入先減均值。 多尺度還是要，先瘦身再動刀。
184876925f86.en: Inception in one sentence: the early module runs $1\times 1$, $3\times 3$, $5\times 5$ and pool in parallel; the final version adds $1\times 1$ dimensionality reduction before the expensive $3\times 3$ and $5\times 5$ and after pooling; GoogLeNet stacks the modules, uses ReLU, and subtracts the mean from the 224 input first. You still want multiple scales; slim down before operating.

9c082a969af4.zh: 「先 $1\times 1$ 瘦身，再做貴的 $5\times 5$；並列看多尺度，通道不要養太胖。」
9c082a969af4.en: "Slim down with $1\times 1$ first, then do the expensive $5\times 5$; look at multiple scales in parallel, and don't let the channels grow too fat."

fe2ab3e93347.zh: 教授祕笈：U 型醫院——左邊診斷、右邊重建，跳接把細節接回
fe2ab3e93347.en: Professor's Secret Notes: the U-shaped hospital — diagnose on the left, rebuild on the right, skip connections bring the details back

c96e9536afc8.zh: 主線比喻是「U 型醫院：左邊診斷、右邊重建，跳接把細節接回」。U-Net 出自生醫影像分割，名字來自對稱的 U 形（Fig. 16）。左邊收縮路徑像門診：一層層往下看、通道加倍，問「這塊大概是什麼組織」（語境）。右邊擴張路徑像手術房：一層層把圖放大、通道減半，問「邊界到底在哪一個像素」（定位）。兩邊中間拉病歷：跳接（skip connection）把左邊還沒被池化洗掉的細節，串接到右邊對應層。分割兩個都要——只知道「大概是細胞」卻對不齊邊緣，或邊緣很銳但看不懂語境，這家醫院都算失敗。
c96e9536afc8.en: The main analogy is "the U-shaped hospital: diagnose on the left, rebuild on the right, skip connections bring the details back". U-Net comes from biomedical image segmentation, and its name comes from the symmetric U shape (Fig. 16). The contracting path on the left is like the outpatient clinic: it looks downward layer by layer, doubling the channels, and asks "roughly what kind of tissue is this patch?" (context). The expansive path on the right is like the operating room: it enlarges the image layer by layer, halving the channels, and asks "exactly which pixel is the boundary on?" (localization). Between the two sides, medical records are passed across: the skip connection concatenates the details on the left that pooling hasn't yet washed away into the corresponding layer on the right. Segmentation needs both — knowing only that "it's probably a cell" but failing to line up the edges, or having very sharp edges but not understanding the context, either way the hospital counts as a failure.

b2ffd0d3de09.zh: 先講白話：左邊抓上下文，右邊做精準定位，中間把細節接回來。 分類網路可以把圖愈收愈小、最後吐一個類別；分割必須吐回跟輸入一樣大的標籤圖，每個像素一票。
b2ffd0d3de09.en: First in plain words: the left side captures context, the right side does precise localization, and the middle brings the details back. A classification network can shrink the image smaller and smaller and finally spit out one class; segmentation must output a label map as large as the input, one vote per pixel.

02f1da6e2b22.zh: 收縮路徑走典型 CNN 節奏：連續兩次 $3\times 3$ 卷積，每次後接 ReLU，再用 stride 2 的 $2\times 2$ max pooling 下採樣，通道加倍把容量補回。擴張路徑幾乎是鏡子：同樣兩次 $3\times 3$+ReLU，但不用 pooling，改用 $2\times 2$ 反卷積（deconvolution）——也叫轉置卷積或 up-convolution（Fig. 17）。每上採樣一次，通道減半。
02f1da6e2b22.en: The contracting path follows the typical CNN rhythm: two $3\times 3$ convolutions in a row, each followed by a ReLU, then downsampling with a stride-2 $2\times 2$ max pooling, doubling the channels to make up the capacity. The expansive path is almost a mirror: likewise two $3\times 3$+ReLU, but no pooling; instead it uses a $2\times 2$ deconvolution — also called a transposed convolution or up-convolution (Fig. 17). At each upsampling, the channels are halved.

0c5071ea7618.zh: 原始 U-Net 用不補邊（unpadded）卷積，每做一次 $3\times 3$ 空間會縮小，左右對不齊，所以跳接前要先 crop。現代實作可以改用 padding，讓尺寸從頭對齊。輸出與輸入空間尺寸相同，最後 $c$ 個通道（一類一通道）接 softmax，損失是逐像素 cross-entropy。原作 batch size 為 1（生醫圖塊很大），動量 $0.9$。後繼者包括把 U 改成 Y 形的 Y-Net。
0c5071ea7618.en: The original U-Net uses unpadded convolutions: each $3\times 3$ shrinks the spatial size, so left and right don't line up, and you must crop before the skip connection. Modern implementations can use padding instead, so the sizes line up from the start. The output has the same spatial size as the input; the final $c$ channels (one per class) go into a softmax, and the loss is per-pixel cross-entropy. The original work used batch size 1 (biomedical image tiles are large) and momentum $0.9$. Successors include Y-Net, which turns the U into a Y shape.

19baf578f511.en: Breaking down the symbols one by one (contracting, expanding, crop)

aad93bc94622.zh: 不補邊的 $3\times 3$、stride 1，邊長 $H$ 變成 $H-2$。連續兩次：
aad93bc94622.en: An unpadded $3\times 3$ with stride 1 turns side length $H$ into $H-2$. Twice in a row:

45acac7150eb.zh: 再 $2\times 2$ stride 2 池化，大約再半。轉置卷積把邊長乘回約兩倍。跳接是 concatenate（不是 ResNet 那種相加）：左邊對應層的特徵圖與右邊上採樣結果在通道維接起來，讓重建層同時看到「診斷語境」與「當前放大後的粗圖」。
45acac7150eb.en: Then a $2\times 2$ stride-2 pooling roughly halves it again. The transposed convolution multiplies the side length back by about two. The skip connection is a concatenation (not the addition used by ResNet): the feature map from the corresponding layer on the left and the upsampled result on the right are joined along the channel dimension, so the reconstruction layers see both the "diagnostic context" and the "coarse image just enlarged".

ccd71963cc32.zh: 因為左邊每做兩次 unpadded conv 就比右邊對應的上採樣圖多一圈邊界，串接前要把左邊較大的那張 crop 成一樣大。padding 版則可省這刀。
ccd71963cc32.en: Because every two unpadded convs on the left leave it with one more ring of border than the corresponding upsampled map on the right, the larger map on the left must be cropped to the same size before concatenation. The padded version can skip this cut.

e9a7d85447e0.zh: 最後一層 $c$ 通道，像素 $(x,y)$ 的類別 $\ell$ 機率為 softmax；整張圖的損失是所有像素交叉熵的和或平均。這是逐像素分類，不是 KP-12 那種一張圖一個 1000 維向量。
e9a7d85447e0.en: The last layer has $c$ channels; the probability of class $\ell$ at pixel $(x,y)$ is a softmax; the loss for the whole image is the sum or average of the cross-entropies over all pixels. This is per-pixel classification, not one 1000-dimensional vector per image as in KP-12.

05efb832ef0a.zh: 數值真的算一遍：10 格進、兩次卷積剩 6、池化成 3
05efb832ef0a.en: Actually running the numbers: 10 cells in, 6 left after two convolutions, 3 after pooling

ce2036933e15.zh: 用小醫院走一層，避免 572 這種原作輸入把算術淹沒。左邊一張 $10\times 10$ 特徵圖：
ce2036933e15.en: Let's walk through one floor with a small hospital, so that an input like the original's 572 doesn't drown the arithmetic. On the left, one $10\times 10$ feature map:

872e381f87d3.zh: 右邊從 $3\times 3$ 用 $2\times 2$ 轉置卷積放大到 $6\times 6$。左邊跳接點若取「第二次卷積後」的 $6\times 6$，兩邊剛好對齊，不必 crop。若跳接取的是第一次卷積後的 $8\times 8$，就要從 $8$ 裁到 $6$，每邊各切掉 $1$ 格——這就是原作 Fig. 16 那些裁切的縮寫版。
872e381f87d3.en: On the right, a $2\times 2$ transposed convolution enlarges $3\times 3$ to $6\times 6$. If the left skip point is the $6\times 6$ map "after the second convolution", the two sides line up exactly and no crop is needed. If the skip is taken from the $8\times 8$ map after the first convolution, it must be cropped from $8$ to $6$, cutting $1$ cell from each side — this is a scaled-down version of the cropping in the original Fig. 16.

cc69ce72179a.zh: 通道也用真數字。設入院 $64$ 通道，池化後加倍成 $128$；右邊上採樣再減半回 $64$，與左邊 $64$ 通道 concat 得到 $128$，再兩次 $3\times 3$ 收到下次要用的寬度。容量在左邊往下走時用通道補、右邊往上走時用跳接把細節補回來，不是靠把全連接塞進每個像素。
cc69ce72179a.en: Use real numbers for the channels too. Say we are admitted with $64$ channels, which double to $128$ after pooling; on the right, upsampling halves them back to $64$, which concatenated with the $64$ channels on the left gives $128$, and then two $3\times 3$ convolutions bring it down to the width needed next. Capacity is made up with channels as the left side goes down, and with skip connections bringing the details back as the right side goes up — not by stuffing a fully connected layer into every pixel.

590452775da3.zh: 原作更大的帳只是同一規則重複：輸入 $572$，兩次 unpadded $3\times 3$ 變 $568$，池化……最後輸出 $388$。差距全部來自「每次 $3\times 3$ 吃掉一圈邊界」，不是 softmax 改變了空間大小。
590452775da3.en: The original's bigger bookkeeping just repeats the same rule: input $572$, two unpadded $3\times 3$ give $568$, pooling …… final output $388$. The difference comes entirely from "each $3\times 3$ eats one ring of border", not from softmax changing the spatial size.

2faaa9f0c9b7.zh: 直覺會說：「分割就是分類做很多次，把圖縮到很小再硬放大就好。」反轉是：縮小會把邊界細節弄丟，放大補不回來。 左邊診斷愈往下語境愈好、地圖愈糊；若沒有跳接把左邊的病歷接回右邊，手術房只能在糊圖上猜輪廓。第二個反轉：跳接前要 crop，不是因為 pooling 的 stride 必須是 3，而是因為原始設計堅持 unpadded conv。改 padding 就能少裁，但「細節必須從收縮路徑接回來」這條醫院規矩不變。
2faaa9f0c9b7.en: Intuition says: "Segmentation is just classification done many times; shrink the image down very small and then force it back up." The twist is: shrinking loses the boundary details, and enlarging can't bring them back. The further down the left-side diagnosis goes, the better the context and the blurrier the map; without skip connections passing the left side's medical records to the right, the operating room can only guess outlines on a blurry image. The second twist: cropping before the skip is needed not because pooling's stride must be 3, but because the original design insists on unpadded conv. Switching to padding means less cropping, but the hospital rule "details must be brought back from the contracting path" doesn't change.

3e5e90783c5f.zh: 同一家 U 型醫院換成修老照片：左邊愈縮愈能看出「這是一張證件照」（語境），右邊愈放愈要對齊瞳孔邊緣（定位）；中間把縮之前的高頻紋理接回去，才不會修成蠟像。現在換數字自己算一次（答案不公佈）：$8\times 8$ 輸入，兩次 unpadded $3\times 3$ 後邊長多少？再 stride 2 池化呢？若右邊放大回 $4\times 4$，跳接該取左邊哪一張才不用 crop？提示：兩次 $3\times 3$ 吃掉 $4$ 的邊長。若你得到奇數還去對 $4\times 4$，多半是池化前少減了一次。
3e5e90783c5f.en: Take the same U-shaped hospital and use it to restore an old photo: the more the left side shrinks, the better it can tell "this is an ID photo" (context); the more the right side enlarges, the more it must line up the edges of the pupils (localization); in the middle, the high-frequency texture from before shrinking is passed back, so the result doesn't end up looking like a wax figure. Now change the numbers and work it out yourself (answers not provided): with an $8\times 8$ input, what is the side length after two unpadded $3\times 3$? And after stride-2 pooling? If the right side enlarges back to $4\times 4$, which map on the left should the skip take so no crop is needed? Hint: two $3\times 3$ eat $4$ off the side length. If you got an odd number and are still trying to match it to $4\times 4$, you most likely subtracted one time too few before pooling.

60c8aa14b987.zh: 誤解「收縮與擴張做同一件事，畫成 U 只是好看」。左邊語境、右邊定位，分工寫在原文裡。
60c8aa14b987.en: Misconception "contracting and expanding do the same thing; drawing it as a U is just for looks". The left is context, the right is localization; the division of labor is written in the original paper.

1004071efe27.zh: 誤解「跳接是把特徵加起來」。U-Net 是 concat；相加是 KP-16 的殘差捷徑。混用會讓通道數對不上。
1004071efe27.en: Misconception "the skip connection adds features together". U-Net uses concat; addition is the residual shortcut of KP-16. Mixing them up makes the channel counts not match.

8e344418d883.zh: 誤解「放大靠再做一次 stride 2 的 max pooling」。pooling 只會再縮小；放大靠 $2\times 2$ 轉置卷積（Fig. 17）。
8e344418d883.en: Misconception "enlarging is done by another stride-2 max pooling". Pooling only shrinks further; enlarging is done by a $2\times 2$ transposed convolution (Fig. 17).

d28f709460ee.zh: 誤解「輸出是 1000 維向量」。戰場是生醫分割，輸出與輸入同空間尺寸、$c$ 個類別通道。
d28f709460ee.en: Misconception "the output is a 1000-dimensional vector". The battlefield is biomedical segmentation; the output has the same spatial size as the input, with $c$ class channels.

c3cce752653e.zh: KP-9：池化提供下採樣與局部不變；分割卻仍需要位置，所以右邊必須把解析度接回來，左邊細節用跳接救命。
c3cce752653e.en: KP-9: pooling provides downsampling and local invariance; segmentation still needs position, though, so the right side must bring the resolution back, and skip connections rescue the details from the left.

a6a7fe697c82.zh: KP-13：成對的 $3\times 3$+ReLU 與 VGG 同一套小核哲學；U-Net 把它同時用在下樓與上樓。
a6a7fe697c82.en: KP-13: the paired $3\times 3$+ReLU follows the same small-kernel philosophy as VGG; U-Net uses it both going downstairs and going upstairs.

aff75f14dd59.zh: KP-2：典型 CNN 在全連接前把空間收掉做分類；U-Net 沒有把空間收成一個向量，它要逐像素的答案。
aff75f14dd59.en: KP-2: a typical CNN collapses the spatial dimensions before the fully connected layers to classify; U-Net doesn't collapse space into a single vector, because it wants a per-pixel answer.

4e2f071fe4b5.zh: KP-16：ResNet 的 shortcut 是加回 $x$；U-Net 的 skip 是把編碼器特徵 concat 到解碼器。都叫跳接，接法不同。
4e2f071fe4b5.en: KP-16: ResNet's shortcut adds $x$ back; U-Net's skip concats encoder features into the decoder. Both are called skip connections, but they connect differently.

0e667de2adf8.zh: U-Net 一句話重講：左收縮抓語境、右擴張做定位，中間 concat 跳接把細節接回；原始版因 unpadded $3\times 3$ 要 crop；放大靠 $2\times 2$ 轉置卷積；輸出與輸入同尺寸，$c$ 通道 softmax 加交叉熵，戰場是醫學分割。
